# Psalms

תהילים

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms)

פיוטים המביעים קשת רגשות - תקווה ודכדוך, שבח ותחנונים לאלוהים - ומיוחסים לדוד המלך ולאישים אחרים.

Poems of despair, hope, gratitude, and supplication to God, attributed to David and others.

Sections: Chapter-Verse

Location: Tanakh/Writings

Originally from [Sefaria](https://www.sefaria.org) via [TorahLM.org](https://torahlm.org) — see [licensing](https://torahlm.org/sefaria_license).

Version (He): Miqra according to the Masorah (Segments: 2527, License: CC-BY-SA)

Versions (En):
  - The Koren Jerusalem Bible (Segments: 2527, License: CC-BY-NC)
  - The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein (Segments: 2525, License: CC-BY)


## Chapter 1

###### Psalms 1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:1)


אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר**׀** לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֢ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of scorners.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The praises of a man (are) that he did not walk in the counsel of the wicked, and [(in consequence)] did not stand in the path of sinners, and [(in consequence)] did not sit in the seat of scoffers.


###### Psalms 1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:2)


כִּ֤י אִ֥ם־בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But his delight is in the Tora of the Lord; and in his Tora he meditates day and night.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But in the Torah of the L rd is his desire [(whence it is seen that sitting with scoffers leads to neglect of Torah study)], and in his Torah he meditates day and night.


###### Psalms 1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:3)


וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֢וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י־מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ**׀** יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season; its leaf also shall not wither; and in whatever he does he shall prosper.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he shall be as a tree planted by the water courses, which gives its fruit in its time, and whose leaves do not wither [(Even his "externals" are of significance — The casual converse of Torah scholars is meaningful and requires study)], and all that he does prospers.


###### Psalms 1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:4)


לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Not so the wicked: but they are like the chaff which the wind drives away.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Not so, the wicked. But [they are] like the chaff scattered by the wind.


###### Psalms 1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:5)


עַל־כֵּ֤ן**׀** לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Therefore, [("For the L rd knows, etc.", verse 6)] the wicked will not stand up [i.e., prevail] in judgment [(on the Day of Judgment)], nor will sinners [be written down] in the congregation of the righteous:


###### Psalms 1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/1:6)


כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord knows the way of the righteous: but the way of the wicked shall perish.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the L rd knows the way of the righteous [(and keeps it constantly before His eyes)], and the [(hateful)] way of the wicked will go lost.



## Chapter 2

###### Psalms 2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:1)


לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ־רִֽיק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why are the nations in uproar, and the people mutter a vain thing?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why did nations rumble [and gather against David (viz. II Samuel 5:17)] and peoples plot vanity?


###### Psalms 2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:2)


יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ**׀** מַלְכֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־יָ֑חַד עַל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Why did] kings of the land and princes take counsel together against the L rd and against His anointed one, [saying]:


###### Psalms 2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:3)


נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת־מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let us break their bonds asunder, and cast away their cords from us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"Let us break their bonds and cast off our thongs!"


###### Psalms 2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:4)


יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג־לָֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He who sits in the heavens laughs: the Lord has them in derision.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The Dweller in heaven laughs; the L rd mocks them.


###### Psalms 2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:5)


אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then shall he speak to them in his wrath, and terrify them in his burning anger.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then He speaks to them in His wrath, and in His fury He confounds them:


###### Psalms 2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:6)


וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר־קׇדְשִֽׁי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I have set my king upon Żiyyon, my holy hill.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"But I have anointed [David] My king [to reign] over Zion, My holy mount!"


###### Psalms 2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:7)


אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל־חֹ֥ק יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר־אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will tell of the decree: the Lord has said to me, Thou art my son; this day have I begotten thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I [David] shall speak as ordained: The L rd has said of me [through Nathan, Gad, and Samuel]: "You are My son" [(the chief of Israel, who are called "My first-born son," viz. [Exodus 4:22]: "My first-born son is Israel," and they will endure through you, viz. II Samuel 3:18)]; "I, this day [(that I have enthroned you over them)] have begotten you" [(to be called My son for their sake, viz. I Chronicles 14:2, II Samuel 7:14, Psalms 89:27)].


###### Psalms 2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:8)


שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Ask of me, and I shall give thee nations for thy inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"Ask of Me [i.e., Pray to Me whenever you go to meet the foe], and I shall make nations your inheritance, and the ends of the earth your holding.


###### Psalms 2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:9)


תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You will break them with a rod of iron [the sword]; as a potter's vessel will you shatter them."


###### Psalms 2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:10)


וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be wise now therefore, O kings: be warned, O judges of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
So now, O kings, be wise; be chastened, you judges of the earth.


###### Psalms 2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:11)


עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Serve the L rd in fear, and you will rejoice, [in thus having served Him,] in quaking [i.e., when quaking overtakes those who have rebelled against Him (viz. Isaiah 33:14)].


###### Psalms 2:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/2:12)


נַשְּׁקוּ־בַ֡ר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַ֤ף**׀** וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כׇּל־ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Worship in purity, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, for in a little while his anger will blaze. Blessed are all who put their trust in him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Gird yourselves in purity [of heart] lest He grow wroth and you lose the way [viz. 1:6]. For in a moment His wrath will flare [against the wicked, and, in that moment, there will be made manifest] the praises of all who trust in Him [viz. 1:1].



## Chapter 3

###### Psalms 3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:1)


מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בׇרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י**׀** אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Psalm of David, when he fled from Avshalom his son.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A psalm of David, when he fled before Avshalom, his son.


###### Psalms 3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:2)


יְ֭הֹוָה מָה־רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, how many are my enemies become! many are they who rise up against me:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, how many are my enemies! Great ones [(in Torah, in wisdom, in wealth, and in stature)] have risen against me.


###### Psalms 3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:3)


רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֢ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
many there be who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Great ones have said of my soul: There shall be no salvation for him from G d forever [(because of the episode of Bathsheva)].


###### Psalms 3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:4)


וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗י וּמֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But Thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But you, O L rd, are a shield for me, my honor, and the lifter of my head.


###### Psalms 3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:5)


ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קׇדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I cried to the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When I call with my voice to the L rd, He shall answer me from His holy mountain, for all time.


###### Psalms 3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:6)


אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I lie me down and sleep; I awake; for the Lord sustains me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I lay down and slept [in sorrow]. I awoke [from my sorrow, secure] that the L rd would sustain me.


###### Psalms 3:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:7)


לֹֽא־אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Therefore,] I shall not fear the multitude of people [who are with Avshalom], who, roundabout, have beset me.


###### Psalms 3:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:8)


ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי־הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for Thou hast smitten all my enemies upon the cheek; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Arise, O L rd! Save me, my G d! For You have [ever] smitten the cheek of all my foes [i.e., You have mortified them]; You have [ever] broken the teeth [i.e., the strength] of evildoers.


###### Psalms 3:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/3:9)


לַֽיהֹוָ֥ה הַיְשׁוּעָ֑ה עַֽל־עַמְּךָ֖ בִרְכָתֶ֣ךָ סֶּֽלָה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Salvation belongs to the Lord: Thy blessing be upon Thy people. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
It is the L rd's part to save; Your people's, to bless You forever.



## Chapter 4

###### Psalms 4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינ֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor of the singing [(on the platform by the Levites)], a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:2)


בְּקׇרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי**׀** אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חׇ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: Thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When I call, answer me, O G d, who accords me righteousness. In affliction, You [ever] broadened [the way] for me, [so now] be gracious unto me and heed my prayer.


###### Psalms 4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:3)


בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? you love vanity, and seek after falsehood. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Sons of man [(Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who are called "man")], how long [will you turn] My honor to shame? will you love emptiness? will you [continue to] seek deceit?


###### Psalms 4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:4)


וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקׇרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But know that the Lord has set apart the godly man as his own: the Lord will hear when I call to him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But know that the L rd has set aside the saintly one for Himself; the L rd shall hear when I call to Him.


###### Psalms 4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:5)


רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Tremble, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Tremble [in fear of the L rd] and you shall not sin. Affirm in your hearts upon your beds [(that the L rd exhorted thus)], and be forever stilled [of deceit].


###### Psalms 4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:6)


זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝בִטְח֗וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Slaughter offerings of righteousness [i.e., perform righteous deeds], and trust to the L rd [to bestow good upon you].


###### Psalms 4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:7)


רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֢נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
There are many who say, Who will show us good? Lord, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Many [(who see the gentiles in their prosperity)] say: "Who would show us [such] good! Raise up over us the light of Your countenance, O L rd!"


###### Psalms 4:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:8)


נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast put more gladness in my heart than they have whose corn and wine are increased.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[But, I do not envy them, for] You placed joy in my heart from the time that their corn and their wine increased! [viz.: "If so, (i.e., so much good) for those who anger Him, how much more so (in the world to come), for those who do His will!"]


###### Psalms 4:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/4:9)


בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֢ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will both lie down and sleep, in peace: for Thou, Lord, alone, makest me to dwell in safety.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[If Israel were] at peace together [(with me)], I would lie down and sleep [secure]. You, O L rd, [(no guard required)], alone, secure would make me dwell [viz. Deuteronomy 33:28].



## Chapter 5

###### Psalms 5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל־הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician for flutes, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, on the nechiloth [a type of instrument], a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:2)


אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה׀יְהֹוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִיגִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Give ear to my words, O L rd, [(when I have the strength to pray before You — and, when I do not)], understand my meditations [i.e., the agitations of my heart].


###### Psalms 5:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:3)


הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה**׀** לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hearken to the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for to Thee I will pray.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hear the sound of my cry, my King and my G d, for to You shall I pray.


###### Psalms 5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:4)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶעֱרׇךְ־לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My voice shalt Thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning I will direct my prayer to Thee; and will wait expectantly.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, in the morning You hear my voice [(entreating You to exact retribution of the wicked [(the morning being their time of judgment (viz. 101:8)]. In the morning I set forth [my prayer] before You, and I hope [(for Your judgment against them)].


###### Psalms 5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:5)


כִּ֤י**׀** לֹ֤א אֵֽל־חָפֵ֘ץ־רֶ֥שַׁע׀אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou art not a God That hast pleasure in wickedness: nor shall evil dwell with Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(And it is fitting that I pray thus)] for You are not a G d that desires wickedness — evil shall not abide with You.


###### Psalms 5:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:6)


לֹֽא־יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ ה֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The boastful shall not stand in Thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wanton cannot stand before Your eyes; You have hated all doers of wrong.


###### Psalms 5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:7)


תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֢י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב׀יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou dost destroy them that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You shall destroy the speakers of lies. The L rd shall abominate the man of blood and deceit [(Esav and his seed)].


###### Psalms 5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:8)


וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־הֵֽיכַל־קׇ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But as for me, I will come into Thy house in the multitude of Thy love: and in the fear of Thee I will worship towards Thy holy temple.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I, in the abundance of Your lovingkindness [(in revealing to us Your wondrous vengeance upon them)] shall come to Your house [to thank You]. I shall bow down to the sanctuary of Your holiness in fear of You.


###### Psalms 5:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:9)


יְהֹוָ֤ה**׀** נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י (הושר) [הַיְשַׁ֖ר] לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lead me, O Lord, in Thy righteousness because of my enemies; make Thy way straight before my face.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, lead me in Your righteousness for the sake of [the undoing of] those who eye me [for evil]. Make Your path straight before me.


###### Psalms 5:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:10)


כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֢ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר־פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִיקֽוּן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For there is no sincerity in their mouth; in their heart is malice; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For there is no rightness in his mouth [(They appear to be friends, but they are foes)]. Their innards [i.e., their thoughts] are deceit. Their throats are an open pit [(to swallow the toil of others)]. They smooth over their tongues [with flattery].


###### Psalms 5:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:11)


הַ֥אֲשִׁימֵ֨ם**׀** אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֢וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי־מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Condemn them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out for the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Incriminate them, O G d; let them fall by their counsels [against Israel]. In the abundance of their offenses, cast them off. For they have rebelled against You.


###### Psalms 5:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:12)


וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כׇל־ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But let all those that put their trust in Thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because Thou dost defend them: and let those who love Thy name be joyful in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [then] all who take shelter in You will rejoice forever. They will sing and You will shelter them. And the lovers of Your name shall exult in You [(when they see that You bless the tzaddik, Yaakov and his seed)].


###### Psalms 5:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/5:13)


כִּֽי־אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֢ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou, Lord, dost bless the righteous; Thou dost encircle him with favour as with a shield.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You, O L rd, shall bless the tzaddik. As [with] a breastplate will You gird him with favor.



## Chapter 6

###### Psalms 6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician on strings upon the Sheminit, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor of the singing, on the sheminith [an eight-stringed lyre], a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:2)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וְֽאַל־בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy anger, nor chasten me in Thy hot displeasure.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, do not rebuke me in Your anger, and do not afflict me in Your wrath.


###### Psalms 6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:3)


חׇנֵּ֥נִי יְהֹוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל־אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones shudder;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Be gracious unto me, O L rd, for I languish. Heal me, O L rd, for my bones are confounded.


###### Psalms 6:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:4)


וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד (ואת) [וְאַתָּ֥ה] יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עַד־מָתָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and my soul is much affrighted. And Thou, O Lord, how long?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And my soul [too] is greatly confounded — and you, O L rd, how long [(will You look on and not heal)]?


###### Psalms 6:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:5)


שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me on account of Thy steadfast love.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Turn, O L rd, from Your wrath; rescue my soul [from my sickness]. Save me, for the sake of Your lovingkindness.


###### Psalms 6:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:6)


כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־לָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For in death there is no remembrance of Thee: in She᾽ol who shall give Thee thanks?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For in death there is no remembering You. Who will praise You in the pit?


###### Psalms 6:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:7)


יָגַ֤עְתִּי**׀** בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכׇל־לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am weary with my groaning: all the night I make my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have grown weary with my sighs. [With my tears] I sully my bed each night. With my tears I wet my couch.


###### Psalms 6:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:8)


עָשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑י עָ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכׇל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My eye is wasted because of grief; it grows weak because of all my enemies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My eye is dimmed with anger; it is aged by [the "darts" of] all my tormentors.


###### Psalms 6:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:9)


ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כׇּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
— Depart from me, all doers of wrong; for the L rd has heard the sound of my cry!


###### Psalms 6:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:10)


שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הֹוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord receives my prayer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd has heard my plaint; the L rd shall accept my prayer.


###### Psalms 6:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/6:11)


יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ**׀** וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כׇּל־אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All my enemies will be ashamed and much affrighted: they will turn back and be confounded in a moment.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All of my foes [will call to their gods and] they will be shamed and sorely confounded. [Then] they will turn [and call to the L rd] — and they will be shamed in an instant! [(for having called upon Him only as an “afterthought” [viz. 18:42])]



## Chapter 7

###### Psalms 7:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:1)


שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֥ר לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Shiggayon of David, which he sang to the Lord, concerning the words of Kush the Benyeminite.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A shigayon ["mistake"] of David, which he sang to the L rd concerning Kush [Saul] the son of Yemini. [(David here acknowledges that he was "mistaken" in asking the L rd to be delivered into the hand of his foe in requital of his offenses against Saul [viz. Sanhedrin 95a])]


###### Psalms 7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:2)


יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכׇּל־רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord my God, in Thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, my G d; I have taken refuge in You. Help me against all my pursuers and save me.


###### Psalms 7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:3)


פֶּן־יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Lest he tear my soul as a lion; lest he break me and there be none to save me.


###### Psalms 7:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:4)


יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־יֶשׁ־עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, my G d, if I did this [(what follows)], if there is wrong in my hands,


###### Psalms 7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:5)


אִם־גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צֽוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
if I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (indeed, I have rescued him that without cause is my enemy:)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I repaid the man of my peace [(Saul, being at peace with me)], with evil, and stripped my foe (of his garment) for naught — [(I cut off the edge of his tunic to show him that I could have killed him and did not! [viz. I Samuel 24:4])] —


###### Psalms 7:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:6)


יִ֥רַדֹּֽף־אוֹיֵ֨ב**׀** נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י**׀** לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; and let him tread down my life to the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
then let the foe [Yishbi in Nov (II Samuel 21:16)] pursue my soul and overtake me, and let him trample me to the earth all of my days, and [let him lower] my honor, so that it reside forever in the dust.


###### Psalms 7:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:7)


ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Arise, O Lord, in Thy anger, lift up Thyself against the fury of my enemies: and awake for me: Thou hast commanded judgment.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Arise, O L rd, in Your wrath [(against my foes, such as Yishbi, etc., that I not be delivered into their hands)], be exalted by [executing] Your wrath against my foes, and awaken in me [the strength to execute] the judgment that You have commanded.


###### Psalms 7:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:8)


וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסֽוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let the congregation of the peoples compass Thee about: and for their sakes return Thou on high.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if a congregation of nations [i.e., idolators] surround You [(imploring Your aid, pay them no heed, but)] return [to Your place] on high.


###### Psalms 7:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:9)


יְהֹוָה֮ יָדִ֢ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שׇׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord shall judge the peoples. Judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity that is in me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, judge the peoples [with the afflictions intended for me.] Judge me [i.e., Israel], O L rd, according to my righteousness [i.e., my righteous acts] and according to the innocence that is upon me.


###### Psalms 7:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:10)


יִגְמׇר־נָ֬א רַ֨ע**׀** רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֢ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּוֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God tries the hearts and reins.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let their evil put an end to the evildoers, and establish the righteous one, searching [and knowing, as You do,] the hearts and reins [of men] — G d is "the Righteous One" [(and He knows who is righteous and who is not)].


###### Psalms 7:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:11)


מָגִנִּ֥י עַל־אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My defence is of God, who saves the upright in heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My defense is in G d, for He helps the just of heart.


###### Psalms 7:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:12)


אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכׇל־יֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God is a righteous judge; and a God who has indignation every day.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d is a righteous judge, and the Almighty waxes wroth every day [(when He sees the deeds of the wicked)].


###### Psalms 7:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:13)


אִם־לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If a man does not turn, then he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If he [the wicked one] does not repent, He will whet His sword; He will tread His bow and ready it.


###### Psalms 7:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:14)


וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He has also prepared for him the instruments of death; he makes arrows for the pursuers.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And He has prepared for him the instruments of death. His arrows for the pursuers [of the righteous] has He wrought.


###### Psalms 7:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:15)


הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, he travails with iniquity, and has conceived mischief, and brings forth falsehood.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He [the wicked one] labors in wickedness, and conceives wrong, and begets falsehood [i.e., he is betrayed by his own creations].


###### Psalms 7:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:16)


בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He has made a pit, and has dug it out, and has fallen into the ditch which he made.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The pit that he dug, that he excavated [for another] — he [himself] will fall into the pit that he has made.


###### Psalms 7:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:17)


יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קׇ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
His wrong will return to his head; his violence will descend upon his pate.


###### Psalms 7:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/7:18)


אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall praise the L rd when [he executes] His righteousness [i.e., His judgment against the wicked], and I will sing the name of the L rd, the Most High.



## Chapter 8

###### Psalms 8:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician upon the Gittit, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, on the gitith [a type of instrument], a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 8:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:2)


יְהֹוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord our Lord, how majestic is Thy name in all the earth; who hast set Thy glory above the heavens.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, our Master, how mighty is Your name in all the earth [(beyond the poor capacity of the earthlings)]. Your glory [i.e., Your Shechinah] were [more fitly] reposed on the heavens! [But, in Your great humility —]


###### Psalms 8:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:3)


מִפִּ֤י עוֹלְלִ֨ים**׀** וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֢דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength because of Thy enemies, that Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
out of the mouths of babes and sucklings You have founded strength [i.e., You reposed Your Shechinah in the sanctuary and ordained that the Levites and the Cohanim ("babes" relative to Your grandeur) ascribe strength and glory unto You], for [the discomfiture of] Your foes [(to make known to them that we are Your people)], to put an end to [the reviling of] the foe and the avenger [(who taunt us as being no better than other nations)].


###### Psalms 8:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:4)


כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which Thou hast ordained;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When I see Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars which You have established —


###### Psalms 8:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:5)


מָה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
what is man, that Thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that Thou visitest him?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
What is man that You are mindful of him, and the son of man that You remember him!


###### Psalms 8:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:6)


וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Yet Thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and Thou dost crown him with glory and honour.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Yet You have placed him but little beneath the angels [(empowering Moses to split the sea; Joshua, to make the sun stand still, etc.)], and You have crowned him with honor and glory.


###### Psalms 8:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:7)


תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝֗ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have given him dominion over the work of Your hands — all have You placed beneath his feet!


###### Psalms 8:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:8)


צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
all sheep, and oxen, and also the beasts of the field;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Flocks and herds — all! And also the beasts of the field.


###### Psalms 8:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:9)


צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אׇרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea; whatever passes through the paths of the seas.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The birds of heaven and the fish of the sea — he [man] crosses the paths of the seas.


###### Psalms 8:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/8:10)


יְהֹוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָה־אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord our Lord, how majestic is Thy name in all the earth!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, our Master, how mighty is Your name in all the earth!



## Chapter 9

###### Psalms 9:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:1)


לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician on the death of Labben, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, "the brightening of the youth," a psalm of David [(a song for the future, when the "youth" of Israel will be "brightened," when Israel's righteousness will emerge in retrospect and their salvation draw near with the destruction of Esav and his seed)].


###### Psalms 9:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:2)


אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה בְּכׇל־לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כׇּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will relate all Thy marvellous works.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall thank the L rd with all my heart; I shall relate all Your wonders [(the final redemption, which is equivalent to all of the foregoing miracles, viz. Jeremiah 23:7)].


###### Psalms 9:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:3)


אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will be glad and rejoice in Thee: I will sing praise to Thy name, O Thou most High:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall rejoice and exult in You — I shall sing Your name [as] exalted [above all praise],


###### Psalms 9:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:4)


בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
when my enemies are turned back, when they stumble and perish at Thy presence.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
when my foes are turned back, when they stumble and go lost before You.


###### Psalms 9:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:5)


כִּֽי־עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou didst sit on the throne giving righteous judgment.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You have wrought my cause and my judgment. You have sat on the throne [of judgment], a righteous judge.


###### Psalms 9:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:6)


גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[In my cause] You have rebuked "nations" [("The first of nations is Amalek" (Numbers 24:20)]; You have destroyed the wicked one [Esav]; You have wiped out their name forever [viz. Exodus 17:14].


###### Psalms 9:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:7)


הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב**׀** תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The enemies are come to an end, in perpetual ruins: for Thou hast destroyed the cities; their memorial is perished.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The foe has been destroyed, [for] the swords [of hatred are against him] forever. And You have uprooted [their] cities [(never to be rebuilt, viz. Malachi 1:4)]; their memory is lost [forever].


###### Psalms 9:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:8)


וַֽ֭יהֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the Lord shall endure forever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L rd shall sit [on His throne] forever [(His name complete and His throne complete)], His throne established in judgment, [as opposed to the incomplete state (Exodus 17:16)],


###### Psalms 9:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:9)


וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he will judge the world in righteousness, he will minister judgment to the people in uprightness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[whereas, before "the end of days,"] He would judge the world with righteousness [i.e., mercy]; nations, with justness [i.e., at a time when they were relatively just, e.g., at night, when they were sleeping].


###### Psalms 9:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:10)


וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהֹוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord also will be a stronghold for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [at the final redemption] the L rd will be a fortress to the crushed [Israel], a fortress in times of affliction.


###### Psalms 9:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:11)


וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they that know Thy name will put their trust in Thee: for Thou, Lord, hast not forsaken those who seek Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And those who know Your name will trust in You; for You have not forsaken Your seekers, O L rd.


###### Psalms 9:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:12)


זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Żiyyon: declare among the peoples his doings.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They will sing to the L rd [when He returns] to dwell in Zion. They will relate His deeds among the peoples.


###### Psalms 9:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:13)


כִּֽי־דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא־שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת (עניים) [עֲנָוִֽים]׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For he avenges blood, he remembers it: he does not forget the cry of the humble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the Seeker of blood(s) remembers them [the blood(s) that have been spilt in Israel]; He has not forgotten the cries of the humble.


###### Psalms 9:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:14)


חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עׇ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be gracious to me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer from those who hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Now, in exile,] be gracious unto me, O L rd. See my afflictions at the hands of my foes, my Lifter [(by Your redemption)] from the gates of death.


###### Psalms 9:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:15)


לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כׇּֽל־תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת־צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
that I may relate all Thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Żiyyon. I will rejoice in Thy salvation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
So that I speak all of Your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion and rejoice in Your salvation.


###### Psalms 9:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:16)


טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת־ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The nations are sunk down in the pit that they have made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And this is what I will relate (viz. verse 12):] Nations have sunk in the pit that they have made. In this [very] net that they concealed is their foot ensnared.


###### Psalms 9:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:17)


נ֤וֹדַ֨ע**׀** יְהֹוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֢ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is known by the judgment which he executes: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. (A Higgayon. Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd is known by the judgment He performs. By the work of his hands, the wicked one is ensnared — Higayon [a psalm of meditation], Selah.


###### Psalms 9:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:18)


יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כׇּל־גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked shall be turned back to She᾽ol, all the nations that forget God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wicked shall return to the pit, all the nations who forget G d.


###### Psalms 9:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:19)


כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת (ענוים) [עֲ֝נִיִּ֗ים] תֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For not forever shall the poor one be forgotten; the hope of the humble [shall not be] lost forever.


###### Psalms 9:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:20)


קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אַל־יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Arise, O Lord; let man not prevail: let the nations be judged in Thy sight.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Arise, O L rd, [quickly, to do this]; let man [i.e., the wicked one] not [long] prevail [in his greatness]. Let nations be judged for [inciting] Your wrath [in the destruction of Your Temple].


###### Psalms 9:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/9:21)


שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Put them in fear, O Lord: the nations will then know themselves to be but men. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Place, O L rd, dominion over them. Let the nations know that they are mortals [(and not gods)], forevermore.



## Chapter 10

###### Psalms 10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:1)


לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why standest Thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest Thou Thyself in times of trouble?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why, O L rd, do You stand at a distance? Why do You hide [Your eyes] to times of affliction?


###### Psalms 10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:2)


בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ**׀** בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked in his pride hotly pursues the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The evil-doer, in his pride, pursued the poor. They [the poor] are seized in the plots that they [the wicked] contrived.


###### Psalms 10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:3)


כִּֽי־הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ׀יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the wicked boasts of his heart’s desire, and the greedy wretch curses and renounces the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
["Why, O L rd, do You stand at a distance?"] For [now that You do,] the evil-doer vaunts himself [in having attained all] the lust of his soul, and the robber blesses [himself, saying that] he has despised the L rd [and will not be held accountable for it].


###### Psalms 10:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:4)


רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כׇּל־מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked, through the pride of his countenance thinks, He will not seek out: all his thoughts are, God is not.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The evil-doer, in the height of his vanity, [says to himself:] He [the L rd] will not inquire [into my deeds]. All of his thoughts are: There is no Judge.


###### Psalms 10:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:5)


יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דְרָכָ֨ו**׀** בְּכׇל־עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כׇּל־צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
His ways are always strong; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he hisses at them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
His ways prosper at all times. Your judgments [i.e., afflictions] are removed from him. All of his enemies — he whiffs them away.


###### Psalms 10:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:6)


אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־בְרָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He says in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He says in his heart: I will never fall. In all [of my] generations, evil will not [befall me].


###### Psalms 10:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:7)


אָלָ֤ה**׀** פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
His mouth is full of [false] oaths, deceit, and guile. Vanity and wickedness is beneath his tongue.


###### Psalms 10:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:8)


יֵשֵׁ֤ב**׀** בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places he murders the innocent: his eyes stealthily watch for the helpless.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He sits in the ambush of the courtyard and kills the clean one in concealment. His [Esav's] eyes lurk against Your host [Israel].


###### Psalms 10:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:9)


יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר**׀** כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמׇשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He lies in wait secretly like a lion in his den: he lies in wait to catch the poor: he catches the poor, when he draws him into his net.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He lurks in concealment as a lion in his lair. He lurks to snatch the poor one. He snatches the poor one, pulling him into his net.


###### Psalms 10:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:10)


(ודכה) [יִדְכֶּ֥ה] יָשֹׁ֑חַ וְנָפַ֥ל בַּ֝עֲצוּמָ֗יו (חלכאים) [חֵ֣ל כָּאִֽים]׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The helpless collapse: they bow down, and fall into his power.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He crouches, he bends low, and there fall by his winks the host of the broken.


###### Psalms 10:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:11)


אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל־רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He says in his heart, God has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He says in his heart that G d has forgotten, that He has concealed His countenance, [and that] He never sees.


###### Psalms 10:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:12)


קוּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח (עניים) [עֲנָוִֽים]׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up Thy hand: forget not the humble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Arise, O L rd, G d, lift up Your hand. Do not forget the humble.


###### Psalms 10:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:13)


עַל־מֶ֤ה**׀** נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע׀אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִדְרֹֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why does the wicked man renounce God? he says in his heart, Thou wilt not avenge.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why does the evil-doer despise G d in his heart? [Because] he says in his heart that You do not seek out [his deeds].


###### Psalms 10:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:14)


רָאִ֡תָה כִּי־אַתָּ֤ה**׀** עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס**׀** תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֢ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֵ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה**׀** הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast seen it; for Thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with Thy hand: the helpless man commits himself to Thee; Thou art the helper of the fatherless.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[But] You have seen [his deeds (and yet do not [immediately] retaliate)]. For [it is Your way] to look on at the wrong and the wrath [of the evil-doers] and to give [them power] with Your [own] hand [to prosper in their wickedness]. Your host [Israel] leaves [the burden of punishment] to You, [knowing that] You have [always] aided the orphan.


###### Psalms 10:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:15)


שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל־תִּמְצָֽא׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Break Thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till Thou find none left.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Break the arm of the wicked [Esav], and when You inquire after his [Israel's] evil, You will not find (it) [i.e., When the evil-doers of Israel see that the wicked of Esav are broken, they will leave off doing evil.]


###### Psalms 10:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:16)


יְהֹוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is King for ever and ever: the nations are perished out of his land.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd will be King forever, [after] the nations go lost from His land.


###### Psalms 10:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:17)


תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהֹוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אׇזְנֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, Thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt strengthen their heart, Thou wilt cause Thy ear to hear:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The desire of the humble You have heard, O L rd; ready their hearts, let Your ears listen [to their prayers].


###### Psalms 10:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/10:18)


לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל־יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that none shall any longer terrify innocent men from the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To execute judgment on behalf of the orphan and the broken [i.e., Israel], so that he [Yishmael and Esav] no longer break the afflicted from the earth.



## Chapter 11

###### Psalms 11:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהֹוָ֨ה**׀** חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י (נודו) [נ֝֗וּדִי] הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, of David. In the Lord I put my trust: how can you say to my soul, Flee like a bird to your mountain?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, [a psalm] of David. In the [land of the] L rd have I taken shelter [viz. I Samuel 26:19]. How would you [my enemies] say to my soul: "Wander from your mountain [Eretz Yisrael], O bird"?


###### Psalms 11:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:2)


כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For, behold, the wicked [(Doeg and the other slanderers, who stirred up hatred between David and Saul)] have drawn their bow [i.e., their tongues]. They have set their arrows upon the string to shoot in the darkness [i.e., in secret] at the just of heart [David and the priests of Nov].


###### Psalms 11:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:3)


כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה־פָּעָֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For when the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the foundations [of the earth, i.e., the priests of the L rd] have been destroyed [by you]. The righteous one [David] — What has he done? [i.e., You will bear the burden of their death, not I].


###### Psalms 11:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:4)


יְהֹוָ֤ה**׀** בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קׇדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהֹוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֢יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord in his holy temple, the Lord whose throne is in heaven, whose eyes behold, whose eyelids try, the children of men:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Though] the L rd is in the sanctuary of His holiness; [though] the throne of the L rd be in the heavens, His eyes see [what transpires on earth]; His lids scan the sons of men.


###### Psalms 11:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:5)


יְהֹוָה֮ צַדִּ֢יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
the Lord tries the righteous: but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And do not say that because I am smitten and pursued by you the L rd must have abandoned me, for] the L rd tries the righteous one; and the wicked one and the lover of violence, His soul despises [(and He stores up punishment for them in Gehinnom)].


###### Psalms 11:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:6)


יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גׇפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Upon the wicked he shall rain coals, fire and brimstone, and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And in Gehinnom] He shall rain down coals upon the wicked. Fire and brimstone and a burning wind is the portion of their cup.


###### Psalms 11:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/11:7)


כִּֽי־צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הֹוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord is righteous, he loves righteousness; the upright shall behold his face.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the L rd, being righteous, loves the righteous [and] those whose faces see [i.e., countenance] uprightness.



## Chapter 12

###### Psalms 12:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician upon the Sheminit, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, on the eight-stringed lyre, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 12:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:2)


הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הֹוָה כִּֽי־גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי־פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Help, Lord; for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Help me, O L rd, for the saintly one has ceased [from the world], for the faithful have ended from the sons of men [(All of them spy upon me and reveal my hiding places to Saul)].


###### Psalms 12:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:3)


שָׁ֤וְא**׀** יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They speak vanity every one with his fellow: with flattering lips and with a double heart they speak.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Falsely does one man speak with another, with smoothed-over lips. With [one] heart [do they think] and [with another] heart speak.


###### Psalms 12:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:4)


יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaks proud things:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the L rd cut off all smoothed-over lips; the tongue that speaks great things [in order to deceive].


###### Psalms 12:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:5)


אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמְר֨וּ**׀** לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who have said, With our tongue we will prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
["Let the L rd cut off"] those who say: With our tongues will we prevail; our lips are with us; Who can overmaster us?


###### Psalms 12:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:6)


מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאֶנְקַ֢ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ־לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the violence done to the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says the Lord; I will set him in safety at whom they hiss.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Because of the spoil of the poor [(at their hands)], because of the groans of the impoverished, shall I now arise, says the L rd. "I will come to [your] aid," shall He say to him [(the afflicted one)].


###### Psalms 12:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:7)


אִ֥מְר֣וֹת יְהֹוָה֮ אֲמָר֢וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The words of the Lord are pure words: silver refined in a furnace upon the ground, purified seven times.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The words of the L rd [(unlike those of men)] are pure words [(clear and enduring)], silver refined in [a crucible made of] the upper crust [(i.e., the finest)] of the earth, seven times purified.


###### Psalms 12:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:8)


אַתָּֽה־יְהֹוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ**׀** מִן־הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, Thou shalt preserve them from this generation forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You, O L rd, shall keep them [the poor]; You shall guard them from [the pursuit of the slanderers of] this generation forever.


###### Psalms 12:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/12:9)


סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked walk on every side, when vileness is exalted among the children of men.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wicked walk roundabout [me to plant snares to entrap me] in [envy of] the exaltation [to kingship] of the basest of men [viz. 118:22].



## Chapter 13

###### Psalms 13:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 13:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:2)


עַד־אָ֣נָה יְ֭הֹוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד־אָ֓נָה**׀** תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How long wilt Thou forget me O Lord? forever? how long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
How long [("How long" is stated four times, on behalf of all of Israel, alluding to the four kingdoms of the exile — Bavel, Paras, Yavan, and Edom)], O L rd, will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?


###### Psalms 13:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:3)


עַד־אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד־אָ֓נָה**׀** יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
How long shall I devise counsel in my soul [to escape] the sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall my foe have ascendancy over me?


###### Psalms 13:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:4)


הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Look, and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Look, and answer me, O L rd my G d, and enlighten my eyes [against my foes], lest I sleep [the sleep of] death.


###### Psalms 13:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:5)


פֶּן־יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכׇלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Lest my foe say: I have prevailed against him; [lest] my oppressors rejoice when I incline [to fall].


###### Psalms 13:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/13:6)


וַאֲנִ֤י**׀** בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I have trusted in Thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Whenever I have trusted in Your lovingkindness, my heart has rejoiced in Your saving. [Now, too,] I shall sing to the L rd, when He bestows His lovingkindness upon me.



## Chapter 14

###### Psalms 14:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/14:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/14:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, [a psalm] of David. The profligate [(Nevuchadnezzar, in destroying the Temple)], says in his heart: "There is no G d" [viz. Isaiah 14:14]. They have destroyed. They have performed abominations. There is none [among them] that does good.


###### Psalms 14:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/14:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/14:2)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֢יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.

There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
