**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Would that [the day drew near of] His sending from Zion the salvation of Israel, when the L rd will return the captivity of His people. [Then] Jacob will regale; Israel will rejoice. [Compare Psalms 53]

A psalm of David. O L rd, who will live in Your tent? Who will dwell in Your holy mountain?

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He that walks uprightly, and acts justly, and speaks the truth in his heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He who walks in innocence and does righteousness and speaks truth in his heart [(his heart being "true" to his mouth)].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He that does not slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his fellow, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
On whose tongue there is no slander, who does his neighbor no evil, and who does not bear [i.e., leave himself open to the] reproach [of having covered up] for [the evil of] his kinsman,

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

כִּ֣י כׇל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For all of His judgments are before me [(I have always kept them before my eyes)], and His statutes are not removed from me.


###### Psalms 18:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:24)


וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I was whole-hearted with Him and kept myself from my [(purported)] transgression.


###### Psalms 18:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:25)


וַיָּֽשֶׁב־יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore the Lord recompenses me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the L rd recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the purity of my hands before His eyes.


###### Psalms 18:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:26)


עִם־חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
With the merciful Thou wilt show Thyself merciful; with an upright man Thou wilt show Thyself upright;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(You recompense "measure for measure")]: With the saintly one [(Abraham)], You are saintly; with the whole-hearted man [(Isaac)], You are whole-hearted.


###### Psalms 18:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:27)


עִם־נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
with the pure Thou wilt show Thyself pure; and with the perverse Thou wilt show Thyself subtle.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
With the faithful one [(Jacob)], You are faithful — and with the devious one [(Pharaoh)], You are devious.


###### Psalms 18:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:28)


כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה עַם־עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You help the humble people, and You lower the eyes of the haughty.


###### Psalms 18:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:29)


כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חׇשְׁכִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You light my lamp; the L rd my G d brightens my darkness.


###### Psalms 18:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:30)


כִּֽי־בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For by Thee I run through a troop; and by my God I leap over a wall.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For by You [i.e., trusting in You] do I run upon a troop; by my G d do I scale the wall [(viz. Midrash Tehillim 18:24)].


###### Psalms 18:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:31)


הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֢ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל**׀** הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a shield to all those who trust in him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The way of G d is whole. The word of the L rd is pure [(He promises and does)]. He is a shield to all who trust in Him.


###### Psalms 18:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:32)


כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For who is a god other than the L rd? And who is a rock beside our G d?


###### Psalms 18:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:33)


הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
It is God that girds me with strength, and makes my way perfect.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The G d who girds me for war and makes my way whole [(by removing all obstacles from it)].


###### Psalms 18:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:34)


מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He makes my feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me upon my heights.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He makes my feet like [those of] hinds and sets me on my heights.


###### Psalms 18:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:35)


מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of brass is bent in my arms.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He teaches my hands for war, and a copper bow is bent by my arms.


###### Psalms 18:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:36)


וַתִּתֶּן־לִי֮ מָגֵ֢ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast also given me the shield of Thy salvation: and Thy right hand has supported me and Thy condescension has made me great.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have given me the shield of Your salvation. Your right hand has sustained me, and You have heightened Your humbleness for me [i.e., on my behalf].


###### Psalms 18:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:37)


תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have broadened my steps beneath me and my ankles have not slipped.


###### Psalms 18:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:38)


אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־אָ֝שׁ֗וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn back till they were consumed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall pursue my foes and overtake them, and I shall not turn back until I have destroyed them.


###### Psalms 18:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:39)


אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have crushed them so that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall crush them so that they cannot rise; they shall fall under my feet.


###### Psalms 18:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:40)


וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou hast girded me with strength to the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those who rose up against me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have girded me with valor for the war; You have subdued my adversaries beneath me.


###### Psalms 18:41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:41)


וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast also made my enemies turn their backs on me; that I might destroy those who hate me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have given me the nape of my foes [(in flight)], and I shall crush my enemies.


###### Psalms 18:42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:42)


יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They cried, but there was none to save them: to the Lord, but he answered them not.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They cry out [to their idols], to no avail; [and then] to the L rd, but He does not answer them.


###### Psalms 18:43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:43)


וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵי־ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then did I beat them small like the dust before the wind: I did cast them out like the dirt in the streets.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; as mud in the streets did I spill them out.


###### Psalms 18:44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:44)


תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֢יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou deliverest me from the strivings of the people; Thou makest me the head of nations: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Deliver me from the contentions of the people [(that I not be punished for miscarriage of justice and exploitation of Jews)]. Make me the head of nations [(where there is no such liability)]; let a people unknown to me serve me.


###### Psalms 18:45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:45)


לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves to me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
At ear's report [i.e., by word of my emissaries alone] shall they submit to me; the sons of strangers shall prevaricate to me [in fear].


###### Psalms 18:46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:46)


בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The strangers shall fade away, and come trembling out of their close places.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The sons of strangers shall wither and recoil [in fear] in their cells.


###### Psalms 18:47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:47)


חַי־יְ֭הֹוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord lives; and blessed is my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd lives [(who does all this for me)], and my Rock will be [forever] blessed. The G d of my salvation will [ever] be exalted.


###### Psalms 18:48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:48)


הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
It is God who avenges me, and has subdued peoples under me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The G d who grants [me the power to take] vengeance [of my foes] and ravages peoples in my stead [i.e., instead of their ravaging me].


###### Psalms 18:49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:49)


מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He delivers me from my enemies: indeed, thou liftest me up above those who rise up against me: Thou deliverest me from the violent man.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You deliver me from my foes. You raise me above those who rise against me. You rescue me from the man of violence.


###### Psalms 18:50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:50)


עַל־כֵּ֤ן**׀** אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀יְהֹוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore will I give thanks to Thee, O Lord, among the nations, and sing praises to Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall, therefore, praise You among the nations, O L rd, and to Your name shall I sing.


###### Psalms 18:51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/18:51)


מַגְדִּל֮ יְשׁוּע֢וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד**׀** לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Great deliverance he gives to his king; and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He magnifies the salvation of His king and performs lovingkindness with His anointed one, with David and his seed, forever.



## Chapter 19

###### Psalms 19:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 19:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:2)


הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד־אֵ֑ל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗יו מַגִּ֥יד הָרָקִֽיעַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The heavens declare the glory of the Almighty and the firmament speaks of His handiwork [(the stars, etc. viz. (Genesis 1:17): "And G d set them in the firmament of the heavens, etc.")]


###### Psalms 19:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:3)


י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּֽעַת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Day to day utters speech, and night to night expresses knowledge.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[The renewal of the creation from] day to day [causes men to] utter words [of praise to the L rd], and [this renewal, from] night to night [causes them to] indite knowledge.


###### Psalms 19:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:4)


אֵֽין־אֹ֭מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
There is no speech nor are there words; their voice is not heard.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[In truth,] they [the heavens, etc.] have no utterance and no words; their voice is not heard —


###### Psalms 19:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:5)


בְּכׇל־הָאָ֨רֶץ**׀** יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם־אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Still,] their line extends over all the earth, so that [even at] the end of the world their words [(the words of men, extolling the wonders they behold, are heard)]. For the sun He made a tent therein [(in the heavens)].


###### Psalms 19:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:6)


וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoices like a strong man to run a race.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it [the sun] is like a groom going forth from his canopy [(to shine upon the earth)], rejoicing as a hero in running upon the path.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:7)


מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם**׀** מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵחַמָּתֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit to the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from his heat.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From the end of the heavens does it issue forth, and its circuit is upon their poles; and none are hidden from its heat.

תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהֹוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Tora of the Lord is perfect, restoring the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[But "the great sun,"] the Torah of the L rd is [even more] perfect; it restores the soul [(from the paths of death to those of life)]. The testimony of the L rd [(vis-à-vis its learners)] is faithful, making the simple wise.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:9)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The commandments of the L rd are just; they rejoice the heart. The mitzvoth of the L rd are clear; they enlighten the eyes.

The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever: the judgments of the Lord are true and are righteous altogether.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The fear of the L rd is pure; it endures forever. The judgments of the L rd are true; they are righteous together [(a cohesive whole)].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They are more desirable than gold and than much fine gold, and sweeter than honey and the drippings of the honeycomb.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:12)


גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שׇׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Moreover by them is Thy servant enlightened: and in keeping of them there is great reward.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your servant, too, was scrupulous in observing them, because of the great [good that is stored up for those who fear You.]


###### Psalms 19:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:13)


שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי־יָבִ֑ין מִֽנִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Who can discern errors? cleanse Thou me from secret faults.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[But, though I took great care,] who can understand [i.e., completely guard against] unwitting [transgressions] — Cleanse me of [such] hidden things.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:14)


גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים**׀** חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Keep back Thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be clear of much transgression.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From willful sins, too, spare You servant, so that they not rule over me [(by their enticements)]. Then I shall be entirely pure; for I shall [(through my own resources of will)] be clean of great [(rebellious)] offense, [(so that by Your shielding me from the first two varieties of sin, I shall emerge completely sinless.)]


###### Psalms 19:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/19:15)


יִ֥הְיֽוּ־לְרָצ֨וֹן**׀** אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in Thy sight, O Lord, my rock, and my redeemer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May the utterances of my mouth conciliate You, and the musings of my heart before You, O L rd, my Rock and my Redeemer.



## Chapter 20

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm for David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:2)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May the Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Ya῾aqov defend thee!

[(David would send Yoav and all of Israel to war, and he would pray for them in Jerusalem)]: Let the L rd answer you on a day of duress; Let the name of the G d of Jacob [(i.e., the G d who kept His assurance to Jacob [viz. Genesis 28:13]) defend you.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:3)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Żiyyon!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let Him send your help from His sanctuary, and let Him uphold you from Zion.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May he remember all thy offerings, and accept with favour thy burnt offering! (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let Him remember all of your meal-offerings [(your prayers in battle)], and may your burnt-offerings [(the same)] be ever acceptable.

יִֽתֶּן־לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכׇל־עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא׃

May he grant thee thy heart’s desire, and fulfil all thy counsel!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May He grant you the desires of your heart, and may He fulfill all of your counsel.


###### Psalms 20:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:6)


נְרַנְּנָ֤ה**׀** בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

May we rejoice in Thy salvation, and in the name of our God set up our banner! Let the Lord fulfil all thy petitions!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:7)


עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀יְהֹוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:8)

These [nations place their faith] in chariots, and those, in horses, but we shall invoke the name of the L rd our G d.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They are bowed down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They bow down and fall, and we rise up and triumph.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/20:10)


יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Save, Lord; O King, who hears us on the day when we call.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, save! O King, answer us on the day we call!

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musicians, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.

His glory is great in Thy salvation: honour and majesty Thou dost lay upon him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

כִּֽי־תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃

For Thou dost make him most blessed forever: Thou makest him exceeding glad with Thy countenance.

כִּֽי־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃

For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the steadfast love of the most High he shall not be moved.

Thy hand shall find out all Thy enemies: Thy right hand shall seize those that hate Thee.

Thou shalt make them like a fiery oven in the time of Thy anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

Make their [Esav's] fruit go lost from the earth, and their seed from the sons of men.


###### Psalms 21:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/21:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/21:12)


כִּי־נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־יוּכָֽלוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For they intended evil against Thee: they imagined a mischievous device, but they will not succeed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For they [(Titus and his cohorts)] have plotted evil against You [(to kill You!)]; they have devised a scheme that they cannot [execute].


###### Psalms 21:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/21:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/21:13)


כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou shalt make them turn their back; Thou shalt aim Thy bowstrings against the face of them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You will make them a portion [(to be divided among Israel [viz. Isaiah 23:18])]. With Your bowstrings You will direct [Your arrows] at their faces.


###### Psalms 21:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/21:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/21:14)


ר֣וּמָה יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָ֗ה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be Thou exalted, Lord, in Thy own strength: we will sing and praise Thy power.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Rise up, O L rd, in Your might [(against those who rise against You)] and we shall sing and chant Your strength.



## Chapter 22

###### Psalms 22:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:1)

To the chief Musician upon Ayyelet-hashshaĥar, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, on ayeleth hashachar [a type of instrument], a psalm of David.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me? why art Thou so far from helping me, from the words of my loud complaint?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(On Israel's destined exile:)] My G d, my G d, why have You forsaken me [(Israel)]! You are far from my salvation [and from] the words of my outcry.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O my God, I cry in the daytime, but Thou hearest not; and in the night season, and I have no rest.

But Thou art holy, O Thou That art enthroned upon the praises of Yisra᾽el.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Our fathers trusted in Thee: they trusted, and Thou didst deliver them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They cried to Thee, and were delivered: they trusted in Thee, and were not confounded.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

כׇּל־רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י־חָ֥פֵֽץ־בּֽוֹ׃

saying, He trusts in the Lord that he will deliver him! Let him deliver him, seeing he delights in him.

I was cast upon Thee from the womb: Thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

But be not Thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste Thee to help me.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:24)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:25)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:26)

###### Psalms 22:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/22:28)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

[Then] there will bow down before Him [in Gehinnom] all [the wicked] who descend to the dust, but He will not revive his [(the wicked one's)] soul [to deliver him from Gehinnom].

Their seed shall serve him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming generation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[What he wrought for] the seed who served Him will be related [in praise of] the L rd to the [last] generation.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, that he has done this.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They [(the early generations)] will come and relate to the people born [after them] that He wrought [salvation for them].

Lift up your heads, O you gates; and lift them up, you everlasting doors; that the King of glory may come in.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Who is the man that fears the L rd? He shall teach him [to walk] in the way that He chooses [(the way of good)].

The counsel of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will reveal to them his covenant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The secret of the L rd is for those who fear Him, and His covenant, [(of Torah)], to make it known to them.

My eyes are ever towards the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My eyes are always to the L rd; for He shall release my feet from the net.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Turn Thee to me, and be gracious to me; for I am desolate and afflicted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Turn to me, and be gracious to me, for I am [but] one [(carrying [as king] the sins of the many, who depend upon my prayer for their deliverance)] and I am poor [in merit].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring me out of my distresses.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The woes of my heart have widened; release me from my toils.

רְאֵ֣ה עׇ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכׇל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Behold my afflictions and my burdens, and, [considering them], forgive all of my sins.

רְאֵֽה־אֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with a cruel hatred.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
See how my foes have increased, how they hate me for violence [(of which I am guiltless)].


###### Psalms 25:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/25:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/25:20)


שׇׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Guard my soul and rescue me. Let me not be shamed, for I have trusted in You.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; because I wait for Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[My] innocence and uprightness will guard me, for I have hoped in You.


###### Psalms 25:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/25:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/25:22)


פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָרוֹתָֽיו׃{פ}

Redeem Yisra᾽el, O God, out of all his troubles.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Redeem, O G d, [all of] Israel, from all of its afflictions.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Examine me, O L rd, and prove me; test my reins and my heart.

For Thy loyal love is before my eyes: and I have walked in Thy truth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

I have not sat with vain persons, neither do I enter the company of dissemblers.

that I may sound the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all Thy wondrous works.

My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations I will bless the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[A psalm] of David. The L rd is my light and my help. Whom shall I fear? The L rd is the strength of my life. Who shall affright me?

When the wicked, my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

אַחַ֤ת**׀** שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְהֹוָה֮ אוֹתָ֢הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית־יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵֽיכָלֽוֹ׃

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Teach me Thy way, O Lord, and lead me in an even path, because of my enemies.

Teach me, O L rd, Your ways, and lead me in a straight path for the sake of [the undoing of] those who eye me [for evil].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me not over to the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Were it not that I believed I should see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And they would already have destroyed me] had I not believed in seeing the good of the L rd in the land of the living.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thy heart: and wait on the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hope to the L rd; be strong, and let your heart take courage, and [(if your prayer is not answered, then, again,)] hope to the L rd.

Of David. To Thee I will cry, O Lord; my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if Thou be silent to me, I become like those who go down into the pit.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[A psalm] of David. To you, O L rd, shall I call. My Rock, do not be silent to me; lest You be silent to me and I be reckoned with those who go down to the grave.

Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry to Thee, when I lift up my hands towards Thy holy sanctuary.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Drag me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbours, but there is evil in their hearts.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

Because they give no heed to the works of the Lord, nor to the operation of his hands, he will destroy them, and not build them up.

Blessed be the Lord, because he has heard the voice of my supplications.

Blessed is the L rd, for He has heard the voice of my supplications.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song I will praise him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd is my strength and my shield. In Him did my heart trust, and I was helped, and my heart rejoiced. I shall thank Him with my song:

The L rd is strength to them [Israel] and the strength of the salvation of His anointed one.

A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the Lord, O you mighty, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

A psalm of David. Accord to the L rd — you sons, the mighty [(whence it is derived that "avoth" [the patriarchs ("the mighty ones")] are mentioned in the amidah)]; accord to the L rd honor and strength [(whence it is derived that "strengths" are mentioned in the amidah [after avoth])].

Give to the Lord the glory due to his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Accord to the L rd the glory of His name [(the holiness of His name [(the next blessing in the amidah)])]. Bow down to the L rd in the splendor of holiness. [(The eighteen "L rd"s in this psalm are the basis of shemoneh esreh [the eighteen benedictions])].

The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thunders: the Lord is upon many waters.

The voice of the L rd is upon the waters [the Red Sea (viz. above, 18:4)]. The glory of G d thunders; the L rd upon many waters.

The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The voice of the L rd in strength [(At the giving of the Torah, He attenuated His voice in accordance with the "strength" of Israel to bear it)]; the voice of the L rd in splendor.

The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; yea, the Lord breaks the cedars of the Levanon.

The voice of the Lord divides the flames of fire.

The voice of the L rd cleaves [the tablets with] flames of fire [(hewing out the commandments on them)].

ק֣וֹל יְ֭הֹוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Qadesh.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The voice of the L rd quakes the desert; the L rd quakes the desert of Kadesh [Sinai].

The voice of the L rd will start the hinds [(the stalwart standing nations)] and bare the forests [(i.e., it will strip the nations of their glory)]. And in His sanctuary [(when it is rebuilt)], all will proclaim glory:

The Lord sat enthroned at the flood; and he sits enthroned as King forever.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 30:1

I will extol Thee, O Lord; for Thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

O Lord my God, I cried to Thee and Thou hast healed me.

O L rd, my G d, I cried out to You, and You healed me [i.e., forgave me].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord, Thou hast brought up my soul from She᾽ol: Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃

Sing to the Lord, O his pious ones, and give thanks to his holy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 30:6

אֶ֥הֱב֥וּ אֶֽת־יְהֹוָ֗ה כׇּֽל־חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O love the Lord, all his pious ones: for the Lord preserves the faithful, and plentifully repays him who acts haughtily.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Love the L rd, all His saintly ones! The L rd guards the faithful and requites the excess [(of haughtiness)] of the workers of pride.


###### Psalms 31:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/31:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/31:25)


חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כׇּל־הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be of good courage, and let your heart be strong, all you who hope in the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(Seeing, then, how He has wrought for me)] strengthen and fortify your hearts, all who hope in the L rd.



## Chapter 32

###### Psalms 32:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:1)


לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of David. A maskil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A maskil [(a psalm explicated by an interpreter)] of David. Fortunate is he whose offense has been forgiven and his sin concealed.


###### Psalms 32:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:2)


אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהֹוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blessed is the man to whom the Lord imputes no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Fortunate is the man to whom the L rd does not ascribe transgression, [(on condition of)] there being no deceit in his spirit [(his repentance being pure)].


###### Psalms 32:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:3)


כִּֽי־הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all the day long.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When I was silent [(and did not confess before You)], my bones wore away in my groaning all the day [(in dread of punishment)].


###### Psalms 32:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:4)


כִּ֤י**׀** יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For day and night there weighed upon me [fear of] Your hand [(retribution)]; my marrow turned [dry] as in the scorching of an everlasting summer.


###### Psalms 32:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:5)


חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲ֘וֺנִ֤י לֹֽא־כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I acknowledged my sin to Thee, and my iniquity I have not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the Lord; and Thou didst forgive the iniquity of my sin. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Therefore,] I [always] confess my sin [to You], and I do not cover up my transgression, for I said: [It is good that] I confess my offenses to the L rd, and [(now that I have said to Nathan the prophet: "I have sinned" [with Bathsheva (viz. II Samuel 12:13)])], You have forgiven the transgression of my sin, forever.


###### Psalms 32:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:6)


עַל־זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כׇּל־חָסִ֨יד**׀** אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֢ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For this shall everyone that is godly pray to Thee in a time when Thou mayst be found: then surely the floods of great waters shall not come near him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For this [(what follows)] let every saint pray to You when You are found [(to accept his prayer)]: Only that a flood of many waters [(the malice of his foes)] not reach him [viz. II Samuel 24:14].


###### Psalms 32:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:7)


אַתָּ֤ה**׀** סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֢ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רׇנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou art my hiding place; Thou shalt preserve me from trouble; Thou dost compass me about with songs of deliverance. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You are a [(protective)] covert to me. From the foe You guard me. [With] songs of deliverance You surround me forever.


###### Psalms 32:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:8)


אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨**׀** וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee, with my eye upon thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will enlighten you and teach you to walk in this way. I will wink my eye to you [(meaningfully)]:


###### Psalms 32:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:9)


אַל־תִּהְי֤וּ**׀** כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶתֶג־וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be not like the horse, or the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, that they come not near to thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not be as a horse, as a mule, which does not discern [(whether it is being benefited or maltreated — whose mouth,)] when it is being groomed, must be muzzled with bit and bridle, so that it not approach you [to bite you]!


###### Psalms 32:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:10)


רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָ֫רָשָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּֽיהֹוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Many are the sorrows of the wicked: but he that trusts in the Lord, shall be surrounded by love.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Many pains befall the wicked [— who balk at them], but he who trusts in the L rd is surrounded [only] by lovingkindness [(knowing as he does that all comes from the L rd)].


###### Psalms 32:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/32:11)


שִׂמְח֬וּ בַיהֹוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כׇּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, O you righteous: and shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Rejoice in [the lovingkindness of] the L rd, and regale, you righteous, and sing praise, all you just of heart.



## Chapter 33

###### Psalms 33:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:1)


רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהֹוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous: praise is comely for the upright.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Sing, you righteous, in the L rd; praise [of the L rd] is becoming in the just.

הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Praise the Lord with a lyre: make melody to him with the harp of ten strings.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Praise the L rd with the lyre; with ten-tuned harp, sing to Him.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:3)


שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with loud jubilations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Sing to Him a new song; enhance playing with shouting.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:4)


כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכׇל־מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the word of the Lord is right; and all his work is done in faithfulness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For just is the word of the L rd and all of His work is in faith.


###### Psalms 33:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:5)


אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He loves righteousness and justice; the lovingkindness of the L rd fills the earth.


###### Psalms 33:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:6)


בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הֹוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כׇּל־צְבָאָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
By the word of the L rd the heavens were made, and by the breath of His mouth, all of their hosts.


###### Psalms 33:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:7)


כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאוֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He gathers the waters of the sea together like a rampart: he lays up the depths in storehouses.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He gathers in a heap the waters of the sea; He places the depths in stores [beneath the earth].

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:8)


יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהֹוָה כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All the earth will fear the L rd; all the dwellers of the world will hold Him in dread.


###### Psalms 33:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:9)


כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For he spoke, and it was; he commanded, and it stood fast.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For He spoke — and it was; He commanded — and it arose.


###### Psalms 33:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:10)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nought: he makes the devices of the peoples to be of no effect.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd voids the counsel of the nations; He annuls the thoughts of the peoples.


###### Psalms 33:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:11)


עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The counsel of the L rd shall ever endure; the thoughts of His heart for all generations.


###### Psalms 33:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:12)


אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם**׀** בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Happy is the people whose G d is the L rd, the people He chose as an inheritance for Himself.


###### Psalms 33:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:13)


מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהֹוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord looks down from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd looks from the heavens and sees all the sons of men.


###### Psalms 33:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:14)


מִֽמְּכוֹן־שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
From the place of his habitation he looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From the abode of His dwelling He scans all the dwellers of the earth.


###### Psalms 33:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:15)


הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
he who fashions their hearts alike; who considers all their deeds.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He created their hearts as one — He probes all of their deeds.


###### Psalms 33:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:16)


אֵֽין־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרׇב־חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹא־יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרׇב־כֹּֽחַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The king is not helped by greatness of host, nor the hero saved by greatness of strength.


###### Psalms 33:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:17)


שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A horse is a vain thing for safety: nor shall he save by his great strength.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
False is the horse for saving, and he shall not escape through the greatness of his host.


###### Psalms 33:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:18)


הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הֹוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon those who fear him, upon those who hope in his steadfast love:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The eye of the L rd is to those who fear Him, to those who hope in His lovingkindness.


###### Psalms 33:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:19)


לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
to deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To save their souls from death and to sustain them in hunger.


###### Psalms 33:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/33:20)


נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃
