###### Psalms 35:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:10)


כׇּ֥ל־עַצְמוֹתַ֨י**׀** תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהֹוָ֗ה מִ֥י־כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵחָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּֽזְלֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like Thee, who delivers the poor from him that is too strong for him, and the poor and the needy from him that robs him?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All of my bones will say: O L rd, who is like You? You rescue the afflicted one from him who is stronger than he, and the afflicted and poor one from the one who would rob him.


###### Psalms 35:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:11)


יְ֭קוּמוּן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
False witnesses rise up; they ask me things that I know not.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Thieving witnesses rise against me and demand of me [(to return to them)] what I know nothing of.


###### Psalms 35:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:12)


יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They repay me evil for good; a bereavement to my soul!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They repay me evil for good [and seek] death for my soul.


###### Psalms 35:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:13)


וַאֲנִ֤י**׀** בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י עַל־חֵיקִ֥י תָשֽׁוּב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; and as for my prayer may it return to my own bosom.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I, when they were sick, I would put on sackcloth and afflict my soul with fasting — and would that my prayers [for them] would return unto my bosom [i.e., would be fulfilled in me]!


###### Psalms 35:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:14)


כְּרֵעַ־כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I went about as for my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns for his mother.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I went about [in mourning] as [if they were] a friend, a brother of mine. As a mother mourns [her son], I went bent in darkness.


###### Psalms 35:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:15)


וּבְצַלְעִי֮ שָׂמְח֢וּ וְֽנֶ֫אֱסָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָרְע֥וּ וְלֹא־דָֽמּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But when I stumble they rejoice, and gather themselves together. Wretches whom I have not known tear me in pieces without ceasing.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But in my limpness they rejoiced and gathered against me. [Even] cripples gathered against me. And I did not know [what I had done to them]. If they had torn [my flesh], it would not bleed [(for they had mortified me)].


###### Psalms 35:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:16)


בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣י שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Like profane men, scornful mockers, they grind their teeth against me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For their flattery [of Saul] for carousals of food [and drink, i.e., so that he feed them], they gnashed their teeth at me.


###### Psalms 35:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:17)


אֲדֹנָי֮ כַּמָּ֢ה תִ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my only one from the lions.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their darkness; my spirit from [those who are stronger than] lions.


###### Psalms 35:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:18)


א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise Thee among a numerous people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And then] I will thank You amidst a great throng; amidst a vast multitude will I praise You.


###### Psalms 35:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:19)


אַֽל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִ֣י אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ־עָֽיִן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let not those who are wrongfully my enemies rejoice over me; or those who hate me without cause wink their eye.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let my foes of falsehood [i.e., who testify falsely against me] not rejoice over me; my enemies without cause [not] wink their eyes at me [in mockery].


###### Psalms 35:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:20)


כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמ֗וֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For they seek not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against those who are quiet in the land.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For they cannot speak peace, and they plot subtleties against the crushed of the earth.


###### Psalms 35:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:21)


וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח׀הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For they open their mouths wide against me, and say, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they have widened their mouths against me [in exultation], saying "He'ach!" "He'ach!" Our eyes have seen [(what we lusted for)].


###### Psalms 35:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:22)


רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הֹוָה אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אַל־תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast seen, O Lord: keep no silence: O Lord, be not far from me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do You not see [this], O L rd? Do not be silent, O L rd; do not go far from me.


###### Psalms 35:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:23)


הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Rouse Thyself, and awake to my judgment; to my cause, my God and my Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Awake and arise [O heavenly retinue] to judge my cause — my G d and my L rd, to fight my battle.


###### Psalms 35:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:24)


שׇׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Judge me according to Your righteousness, O L rd, my G d, and let them not rejoice over me.


###### Psalms 35:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:25)


אַל־יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל־יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so we have our desire: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them not say in their hearts: "He'ach, our souls!" Let them not say: "We have swallowed him up!"


###### Psalms 35:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:26)


יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ**׀** יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֢י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together, those who rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour, those who magnify themselves against me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them be shamed and abashed together, those who rejoice in my ill. Let those who vaunt themselves over me be clothed in shame and humiliation.


###### Psalms 35:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:27)


יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֢י צִ֫דְקִ֥י וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהֹוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them shout for joy, and be glad, those who favour my righteous cause: and let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, who has pleasure in the welfare of his servant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let those who desire that G d grant me His righteousness sing and rejoice; and let them always say: "May the L rd be exalted, who desires the peace of His servant."


###### Psalms 35:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/35:28)


וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness; of Thy praise all the day long.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And my tongue will speak Your righteousness; all the day [will I speak] Your praise.



## Chapter 36

###### Psalms 36:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀לְעֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֬ה לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, of David the servant of the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, [a psalm] of the servant of the L rd, of David.


###### Psalms 36:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:2)


נְאֻֽם־פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין־פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Transgression speaks to the wicked within his heart; there is no fear of God before his eyes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In the midst of my heart [i.e., it appears to me that] the offense [i.e., the evil inclination] says to the wicked one that the fear of G d should not be before his eyes.


###### Psalms 36:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:3)


כִּֽי־הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For he flatters himself in his own eyes, that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[It appears to me] that he [the evil inclination] smooths [things over] in his [the wicked one's] eyes for [the L rd] to find his sin [whereby] to hate [him].


###### Psalms 36:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:4)


דִּבְרֵי־פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off being wise, and doing good.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The words of his [the wicked one's] mouth [become] falsehood and deceit; he forbears to be wise to do good.


###### Psalms 36:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:5)


אָ֤וֶן**׀** יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל־מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He devises mischief upon his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he does not abhor evil.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He will think falsehood upon his couch. [G d has set before him two ways — life and death, and] he will set himself upon the way that is not good — he will not spurn evil.


###### Psalms 36:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:6)


יְ֭הֹוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ עַד־שְׁחָקִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy steadfast love, O Lord, is in the heavens; and Thy faithfulness reaches the clouds.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, [because of these wicked ones, You have removed Your lovingkindness from the terrestrial sphere, so that now] Your lovingkindness is in the heavens; Your faithfulness [has been removed from men and has ascended] until the skies.


###### Psalms 36:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:7)


צִדְקָתְךָ֨**׀** כְּֽהַרְרֵי־אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם־וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, Thou preservest man and beast.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your righteousness [is as far removed from men] as the mighty mountains, Your judgments [pronounced upon men reach to] the vast deep. Adam [(men as wise as Adam)] and beast [(men who render themselves as humble as beasts)], You will save, O L rd.


###### Psalms 36:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:8)


מַה־יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How excellent is Thy love, O God! therefore the children of men shelter under the shadow of Thy wings.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
How dear is Your lovingkindness, O L rd [(The wicked are not worthy of it)], and men who take refuge in the shadow of Your wings,


###### Psalms 36:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:9)


יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; and Thou makest them to drink of the river of Thy pleasures.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They will be sated with the fats of Your house, and You will make them drink of the stream of Your pleasures.


###### Psalms 36:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:10)


כִּֽי־עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה־אֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For with Thee is the fountain of life: in Thy light we see light.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For with You is the source of life; in Your light [alone] will we see light.


###### Psalms 36:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:11)


מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O continue Thy steadfast love to those who know Thee; and Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Extend Your lovingkindness to those who know You and Your righteousness to the just of heart.


###### Psalms 36:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:12)


אַל־תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְיַד־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תְּנִדֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not bring with me the foot of pride [(the foot of those wicked ones, at the time of the receiving of reward, that their portion not be together with that of the righteous)], and let the hand of the wicked not move me [(from my place when I come to inherit a double portion of reward [(mine and theirs, viz. Isaiah 61:7)].


###### Psalms 36:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/36:13)


שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and are not able to rise.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
There shall fall the workers of iniquity [i.e., there shall the immensity of their fall dawn upon them, and there] shall they be overthrown and not be able to rise.



## Chapter 37

###### Psalms 37:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:1)


לְדָוִ֨ד**׀** אַל־תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of David. Fret not thyself because of evil doers, nor be envious against the workers of iniquity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[A psalm] of David. Do not compete with evildoers [(to gain success by emulating them)]; do not envy the doers of wrong [(to do as they do)].


###### Psalms 37:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:2)


כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For they shall soon be cut down as grass, and as the green of the grass shall they fade.


###### Psalms 37:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:3)


בְּטַ֣ח בַּ֭יהֹוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכׇן־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Trust in the Lord, and do good; dwell in the land, and enjoy security.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Trust in the L rd [(and do not say: If I do not steal or if I give charity to the poor, how will I support myself?)], and do good [and you will] dwell [long] in the land and graze [(i.e., reap the fruits of)] faith.


###### Psalms 37:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:4)


וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thy heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And take delight in the [providence of the] L rd, and He shall grant you the desires of Your heart.


###### Psalms 37:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:5)


גּ֣וֹל עַל־יְהֹוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Commit thy way to the Lord; trust also in him; and he will bring it to pass.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"Roll" upon the L rd [all of] your ways [i.e., needs], and trust to Him, and He will do [as you desire].


###### Psalms 37:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:6)


וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצׇּהֳרָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he will bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment like the noonday.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He will reveal your righteousness as the light [(by rewarding it)], and your justice as the afternoon.


###### Psalms 37:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:7)


דּ֤וֹם**׀** לַיהֹוָה֮ וְהִתְח֢וֹלֵֽ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל־תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who accomplishes wicked devices.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Wait upon the [salvation of the] L rd, and hope to Him, and do not compete with those who succeed [through evil devices], with those who scheme [evil].


###### Psalms 37:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:8)


הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל־תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ־לְהָרֵֽעַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself: it comes to no good.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Desist from anger [i.e., from things that will bring G d's anger upon you], and leave off wrath; do not compete, only to do evil.


###### Psalms 37:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:9)


כִּֽי־מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For evildoers shall be cut off: but those who wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the evildoers [(whom you see succeeding now)] will be cut off, and the hopers in the L rd — they will inherit the land.


###### Psalms 37:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:10)


וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and thou shalt look well at his place, but he will not be there.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But a little more — and there shall be no wicked one. You shall look upon his place and he shall not be there.


###### Psalms 37:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:11)


וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִֽתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל־רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the humble shall inherit the land and delight in the plenitude of peace.


###### Psalms 37:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:12)


זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked man plots against the just, and grinds his teeth against him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wicked one schemes against the righteous one and grinds his teeth against him.


###### Psalms 37:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:13)


אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק־ל֑וֹ כִּי־רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי־יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd shall laugh at him, seeing that his day [of death] shall come.


###### Psalms 37:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:14)


חֶ֤רֶב**׀** פָּ֥תְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֢וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָֽרֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as are of upright ways.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wicked have unsheathed their swords and drawn their bows to slay the poor and the needy, to slaughter the just of way.


###### Psalms 37:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:15)


חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Their swords shall enter their [own] hearts and their bows shall be broken.


###### Psalms 37:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:16)


טוֹב־מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked men.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Better a few, [who go] to [the aid of] the righteous than the vast multitude of the wicked. [(Amrafel and his hosts waged war to take Lot captive, and they were defeated by Abraham and a handful of his men.)]


###### Psalms 37:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:17)


כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholds the just.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the L rd sustains the righteous.


###### Psalms 37:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:18)


יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הֹוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord knows the days of the innocent: and their inheritance shall be for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd knows the [(deeds of the)] days of the innocent ones, and their inheritance [i.e., their reward] will endure forever.


###### Psalms 37:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:19)


לֹֽא־יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They shall not be shamed on a day of evil and in days of famine they shall be sated.


###### Psalms 37:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:20)


כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים**׀** יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the wicked and the enemies of the Lord shall perish like the glory of the meadows; they shall consume; they shall pass away in smoke.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the wicked will go lost, and the foes of the L rd, like the light [of the morning clouds] on the plain, will vanish; they will vanish in smoke.


###### Psalms 37:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:21)


לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked borrows, but does not pay back: but the righteous man gives with a good grace.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wicked one borrows and does not repay, and the Righteous One is gracious [(to the lender)] and gives [(him what was stolen from him)].


###### Psalms 37:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:22)


כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For His blessed ones shall inherit the earth and His cursed ones shall be cut off.


###### Psalms 37:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:23)


מֵ֭יְהֹוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי־גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The steps of a man are ordered by the Lord: and he delights in his way.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
By the L rd are the steps of man [(one who fears the L rd)] established, and He is desirous of his way.


###### Psalms 37:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:24)


כִּֽי־יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא־יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholds him with his hand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Though he fall, he will not be forsaken, for the L rd upholds his hand.


###### Psalms 37:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:25)


נַ֤עַר**׀** הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם־זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא־רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָֽחֶם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have been young, and now am old; yet I have not seen a just man forsaken, and his seed begging bread.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I [(the heavenly plenipotentiary of the world)] have been young and I have also grown old, and I have never seen a righteous one forsaken and his seed begging bread.


###### Psalms 37:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:26)


כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He lends generously at all times; and his seed is blessed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All the day he [the righteous one] is gracious and lends [(to the poor)], and he who "sows" [charity] will see blessing.


###### Psalms 37:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:27)


ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Depart from evil and do good and dwell [in tranquility] forever.


###### Psalms 37:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:28)


כִּ֤י יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord loves justice, and forsakes not his pious ones; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the L rd loves justice. He will not forsake His saints; they will be guarded forever — but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.


###### Psalms 37:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:29)


צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell in it for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The righteous shall inherit the earth and they shall dwell forever upon it.


###### Psalms 37:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:30)


פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חׇכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue discourses justice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The mouth of the righteous one shall meditate wisdom [(to determine the ruling of the Torah on all matters)] and [(then, after he has done so)], his tongue shall speak justice.


###### Psalms 37:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:31)


תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Tora of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall falter.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The Torah of the L rd is in his heart, and his feet shall not slip.


###### Psalms 37:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:32)


צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The wicked man watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The wicked one eyes the righteous one and seeks to kill him.


###### Psalms 37:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:33)


יְ֭הֹוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor allow him to be condemned when he is judged.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd shall not let him [fall] into his hand, and He will not incriminate him [(the righteous one)] in his judgment [(brought against him by the wicked one)].


###### Psalms 37:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:34)


קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Trust to the L rd and keep His way, and He shall raise you to inherit the land. You shall see the cutting down of the wicked.


###### Psalms 37:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:35)


רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have seen a wicked tyrant rooted like a green denizen [(a long-standing, richly fruitful tree)] —


###### Psalms 37:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:36)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: I sought him, but he could not be found.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Behold,] he is passed away, gone! I seek him, but I cannot find him.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:37)


שְׁמׇר־תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Observe the innocent and see the upright [(to learn from their ways)], for there is a [goodly] end for the man of peace.

וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the transgressors are destroyed together: the end of the wicked is cut off.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But the sinners shall be destroyed together; the end of the wicked is cutting-off.


###### Psalms 37:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:39)


וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהֹוָ֑ה מָ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The help of the righteous is from the L rd, their strength in a time of trouble.


###### Psalms 37:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/37:40)


וַ֥יַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי־חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the Lord will help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they take refuge in him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd helps them and delivers them. He delivers them from the wicked and He saves them — for they have trusted in Him.



## Chapter 38

###### Psalms 38:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:1)


מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Psalm of David, for invocation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A psalm of David, to recite [(in time of affliction)].


###### Psalms 38:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:2)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy wrath: nor chasten me in Thy hot displeasure.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, do not chastise me in Your wrath and [do not] afflict me in Your anger.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:3)


כִּֽי־חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thy arrows stick fast in me, and Thy hand presses me sore.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For Your arrows have descended upon me; Your hand has descended upon me.


###### Psalms 38:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:4)


אֵין־מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין־שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thy anger; nor is there any health in my bones because of my sin.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
There is no whole spot in my flesh in the face of Your ire; there is no peace in my bones in the face of [Your punishment for] my sins.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:5)


כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For my iniquities are gone over my head: like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For my transgressions have risen above my head. Like a heavy burden, they have become too heavy for me [to sustain].


###### Psalms 38:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:6)


הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My wounds stink; they fester because of my foolishness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My wounds have oozed forth and putrefied [my flesh] because of my wrongdoing.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:7)


נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃

I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have become convulsed and terribly bent. I have gone about in darkness all the day.


###### Psalms 38:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:8)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For my loins are filled with burning: and there is no soundness in my flesh.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For my thoughts are full of abashment and there is no whole spot in my flesh.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:9)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am feeble and sore broken: I groan by reason of the disquietness of my heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have become terribly faint and downtrodden, and I cry out from a groaning heart.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:10)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, all my desire is before Thee; and my sighing is not hid from Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, all of my desire is before You and my sigh is not hidden from You.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:11)


לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר־עֵינַ֥י גַּם־הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My heart palpitates, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; and my kinsmen stand afar off.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ**׀** מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כׇּל־הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they who seek after my life lay snares for me: and they who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The seekers of my soul have set traps [against me], and those who seek evil for me have schemed destruction and plotted deceit the entire day.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I was like one unhearing, with no rebuke in his mouth.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:16)


כִּֽי־לְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For in Thee, O Lord, I hope: Thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 38:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:17)


כִּֽי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I said, Lest they should rejoice over me: when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 38:18

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I am ready to stumble, and my pain is continually before me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For I am conversant with calamity and my pain is before me [(awaiting materialization)] always.


###### Psalms 38:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:19)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But my enemies are in vigorous life; and they who hate me wrongfully are many.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They also who render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow what is good.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/38:23)


ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 39

###### Psalms 39:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:1)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, for Yedutun, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, [to be played] upon the yeduthun, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 39:2

אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶ֥שְׁמְרָ֣ה דְרָכַי֮ מֵחֲט֢וֹא בִלְשׁ֫וֹנִ֥י אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה לְפִ֥י מַחְס֑וֹם בְּעֹ֖ד רָשָׁ֣ע לְנֶגְדִּֽי׃

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:3)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, had no comfort, and my pain was stirred up.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 39:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:4)


חַם־לִבִּ֨י**׀** בְּקִרְבִּ֗י בַּהֲגִיגִ֥י תִבְעַר־אֵ֑שׁ דִּ֝בַּ֗רְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My heart was hot within me; while I was musing, the fire burned: then I spoke with my tongue,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [(in my silence)], my heart was hot within me. A fire flamed in my thoughts, and [(compulsively)] I spoke with my tongue:


###### Psalms 39:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:5)


הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה־הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה־חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; I will know how frail I am.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Make known to me, O L rd, my end [i.e., How long will I suffer so?], and what is the extent of my days [(for such suffering)]? Let me know when I will be quit [of it]?


###### Psalms 39:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:6)


הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת**׀** נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כׇּֽל־הֶ֥בֶל כׇּל־אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, Thou hast made my days like handbreadths; and my age is as nothing before Thee: truly every man at his best state is altogether vanity. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have set limits to my days, and my hoariness is as naught before You. Verily, all is vanity; all men are [thus, in vanity,] forever founded.


###### Psalms 39:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:7)


אַךְ־בְּצֶ֤לֶם**׀** יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ־הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא־יֵדַ֥ע מִֽי־אֹסְפָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Surely every man walks in a vain show: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heaps up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Verily, man walks in darkness. Verily, in vanity do they desire. He amasses [grain in the field all the days of the harvest], and he does not know who will gather it in [to the house (It may be that he will die beforehand)].


###### Psalms 39:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:8)


וְעַתָּ֣ה מַה־קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And now, Lord, what do I wait for? my hope is in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And now, [(this being so)], what can I hope, O L rd? My hope to You is this:


###### Psalms 39:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:9)


מִכׇּל־פְּשָׁעַ֥י הַצִּילֵ֑נִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל אַל־תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the base man.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From all of my offenses, save me. Do not make me the shame of the churl [(Esav.) Bring suffering upon him (i.e., the nations), too, so that he cannot say: You are smitten and we are not!] [(This prayer availed to bring the affliction of illness upon the nations.)]


###### Psalms 39:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:10)


נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח־פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am dumb, I open not my mouth; because Thou didst it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I was mute; I did not open my mouth, for You wrought [(i.e., You brought more afflictions upon us than upon the other nations.)]


###### Psalms 39:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:11)


הָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Remove Thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of Thy hand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Remove Your afflictions from me. From the assault [i.e., the blows] of Your hand I perish.


###### Psalms 39:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:12)


בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל־עָוֺ֨ן**׀** יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כׇּל־אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When Thou with rebukes dost correct a man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
With chastisements for sin [(those written in the Torah)] You have afflicted man [i.e., us], and You have rotted his flesh as a moth [rots a garment]. Verily, all man is vanity forever.


###### Psalms 39:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:13)


שִׁ֥מְעָֽה־תְפִלָּתִ֨י**׀** יְהֹוָ֡ה וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י**׀** הַאֲזִינָה֮ אֶֽל־דִּמְעָתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכׇל־אֲבוֹתָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry; keep not silence at my tears: for I am a stranger with Thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hear my prayer, O L rd, and listen to my cry. Do not be silent to my tears. For I am a stranger with You, a sojourner, as all of my fathers.


###### Psalms 39:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/39:14)


הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Look away from me, that I may recover brightness, before I go hence, and am no more.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Leave off from [afflicting] me, that I may recover, before I go and am no more.



## Chapter 40

###### Psalms 40:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:1)


לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד מִזְמֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of David, a psalm.


###### Psalms 40:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:2)


קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined to me, and heard my cry.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I [(Israel)] hoped in the L rd [(in Egypt)], and He inclined [his ear] to me and heard my outcry.


###### Psalms 40:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:3)


וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי**׀** מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֢יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל־סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He brought me up also out of the gruesome pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my footsteps.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And He lifted me from the pit [(of servitude, and from)] the roaring [of the Red Sea], from the thick mire [of the sea-bed]. And He set my feet on a rock; He established my steps.


###### Psalms 40:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:4)


וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י**׀** שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֢ה לֵאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he has put a new song in my mouth, a praise to our God. Many shall see, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And He put in my mouth a new song, praise to our G d. Many will see and fear, and they will trust in the L rd.


###### Psalms 40:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:5)


אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא־פָנָ֥ה אֶל־רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blessed is that man that makes the Lord his trust, and looks not to the proud, nor to such as turn aside to lies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Happy is the man who made the L rd his trust and did not turn to the haughty or to the followers of falsehood [(idolatry)].


###### Psalms 40:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:6)


רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ**׀** אַתָּ֤ה**׀** יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִ֥פְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין**׀** עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Many, O Lord my God, are Thy wonderful works which Thou hast done, and Thy thoughts which are towards us: none can compare with Thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Much have You done, You, O L rd our G d. Your wonders and Your thoughts have been on our behalf. [(For us, You created the world; for us You split the sea, etc.)]. There is none to liken to You. [If I thought] to relate and speak [Your wonders, I could not, for] they are too many to tell.


###### Psalms 40:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:7)


זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה**׀** לֹֽא־חָפַ֗צְתָּ אׇ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou dost not desire sacrifice or meal offering; Thou hast dug open my ears; burnt offering and sin offering hast Thou not required.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Sacrifice and meal-offering You did not desire [(at the giving of the Torah)]. You "hollowed out" ears for me [(to listen to Your voice)]; You did not ask for burnt-offering or sin-offering.


###### Psalms 40:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:8)


אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then said I, Lo, I come with the scroll of the book which is written for me;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then [(at the giving of the Torah)], I said [before You]: Behold, I have come [(to be bound in Your covenant)]. In the scroll of the Book [the Torah], it is [so] written of me [viz. Exodus 24:27].


###### Psalms 40:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:9)


לַ֥עֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I delight to do Thy will, O my God: and Thy Tora is within my heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To do Your will, my G d, did I desire. And Your Torah is [even] in the midst of my reins [i.e., I have not eaten unclean beasts or untithed produce.]


###### Psalms 40:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:10)


בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק**׀** בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I did not refrain my lips, O Lord, Thou knowst.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I brought tidings of righteousness [(The Song at the Sea, The Song of the Well, The Song of Devorah)] in a great throng; I did not spare my lips. O L rd, You know it.


###### Psalms 40:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:11)


צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹֽא־כִסִּ֨יתִי**׀** בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא־כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation: I have not concealed Thy love and Thy truth from the great congregation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I did not conceal Your righteousness in my heart. I spoke Your faith and Your help. I did not hold back [from relating] Your lovingkindness and Your truth to a great throng.


###### Psalms 40:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:12)


אַתָּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Withhold not Thou Thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Thy steadfast love and Thy truth continually preserve me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You, [likewise,] O L rd, do not hold back Your mercies from me. Let Your lovingkindness and Your truth always guard me.


###### Psalms 40:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:13)


כִּ֤י אָפְפֽוּ־עָלַ֨י**׀** רָע֡וֹת עַד־אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For countless ills have encompassed me. My sins overtook me and I could not see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.


###### Psalms 40:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:14)


רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Desire, O L rd, to save me; O L rd, hasten to my aid.


###### Psalms 40:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:15)


יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ**׀** יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be ashamed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be turned backward and put to shame who wish me evil.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them be shamed and confounded together, those who seek to consume my soul. Let them recoil in shame, those who desire my evil.


###### Psalms 40:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/40:16)


יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בׇּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח׀הֶאָֽח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be appalled because of their shame who say concerning me, Aha, aha.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them be confounded when their shame follows, [measure for measure], those who exult over me: "He'ach!" "He'ach!"

###### Psalms 43:1

שׇׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים**׀** וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹֽא־חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ־מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Judge me [i.e., Avenge me], O L rd, and fight my battle against a saintless nation [(Yishmael)]. Deliver me from the man of deceit and wrong.


###### Psalms 43:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:2)


כִּי־אַתָּ֤ה**׀** אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֢ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou art the God of my strength: why dost Thou cast me off? why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You, O L rd, are my strength. Why should You forsake me? Why should I walk in darkness in the toils of the foe?


###### Psalms 43:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:3)


שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־הַֽר־קׇ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O send out Thy light and Thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me to Thy holy hill, and to Thy dwelling places.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Send Your light [(the king, Messiah)] and Your truth [(Elijah the prophet)] — let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to Your dwelling.


###### Psalms 43:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:4)


וְאָב֤וֹאָה**׀** אֶל־מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֢ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then will I go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy: and I will praise thee with the lyre, O God my God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I will come to the altar of G d, to the Almighty, the joy of my regaling; and I will praise You with the harp, O G d, my G d [for having delivered me from my exile].


###### Psalms 43:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/43:5)


מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י**׀** נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֢י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵאלֹהָֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou moan within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why are you bowed down, my soul, and [why do you] make moan over me? Hope in G d, for I will yet thank him, the salvations [i.e., the light] of my countenance and my G d.



## Chapter 44

###### Psalms 44:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician for the sons of Qoraĥ, A Maskil.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of the sons of Korach, a maskil.


###### Psalms 44:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:2)


אֱלֹהִ֤ים**׀** בְּאׇזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us, what work Thou didst in their days, in the times of old:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, we heard it [(the following prophecy)] with our ears, our fathers told us thereof, the deed that You wrought in their days, the days of yore.


###### Psalms 44:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:3)


אַתָּ֤ה**׀** יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
how Thou didst drive out nations with Thy hand, and didst plant them; how Thou didst batter the peoples, and cast them out.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:4)


כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא־הוֹשִׁ֢יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי־יְמִינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃

For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them: but Thy right hand, and Thy arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou didst favourably accept them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For it was not with their sword that they inherited the land, and their arms did not help them. But it was Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your countenance — because You desired them.


###### Psalms 44:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:5)


אַתָּה־ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Ya῾aqov.

בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃

Through Thee will we push down our enemies: through Thy name will we tread those under who rise up against us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
With You [(Your aid)] we will smite our foes. With Your name we will trample those who rise against us.

כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I trust not in my bow, nor shall my sword save me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For I will not trust in my bow, and my sword will not help me.


###### Psalms 44:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:8)


כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In God we have gloried all the day long, and we praise Thy name for ever. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:10

אַף־זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

Yet, Thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and Thou goest not forth with our armies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי־צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they who hate us take plunder for themselves.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten: and hast scattered us among the nations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have made us as sheep to be eaten and scattered us among the nations.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou dost make us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to those round about us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד־רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have made us a parable among the nations, an object of head-nodding [in mockery] among the peoples.

כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My confusion is before me all the day, and the shame of my face has covered me,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My humiliation is constantly before me and the shame of my face covers me


###### Psalms 44:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:17)


מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the voice of him that taunts and blasphemes; by reason of the enemy and avenger.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
because of the voice of the shamer and reviler [(who shames and reviles me)] because of the [pursuit of the] foe and the avenger.

כׇּל־זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All this is come upon us; yet we have not forgotten Thee, nor have we been false to Thy covenant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:19)


לֹא־נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲ֝שֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אׇרְחֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Our heart is not turned back, nor have our steps declined from Thy way;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:20)


כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
though Thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:21)


אִם־שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If we had forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:22)


הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַחֲקׇר־זֹ֑את כִּי־ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
would not God search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:23)


כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כׇל־הַיּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But for Thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are reckoned as sheep for the slaughter.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:24)


ע֤וּרָה**׀** לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן׀אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Awake! Why do You sleep, O L rd? Arise! Do not forsake us eternally.


###### Psalms 44:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:25)


לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עׇנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why dost Thou hide Thy face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why do You hide Your face? [Why do You] forget our pain and tribulation?


###### Psalms 44:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:26)


כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaves to the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 44:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/44:27)


ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Arise for our help, and redeem us for the sake of Thy steadfast love.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
