## Chapter 45

###### Psalms 45:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, to Shoshannim, A Maskil for the sons of Qoraĥ. A Song of loves.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, for shoshanim [(in honor of the Torah scholars, who are likened to shoshanim [lilies] in point of gentleness, beauty, and freshness [of deed])], of the sons of Korach, a maskil, a song of love: [for them, to endear them to men, and to endear their Torah to them.]


###### Psalms 45:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:2)


רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י**׀** דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט**׀** סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My heart overflows with a goodly matter: I relate my verses for the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My heart is astir with a good thing. I say: My work [i.e., this psalm] is for the king [(the Torah scholars, viz. Proverbs 8:11)]. My tongue is the pen of an expert scribe.


###### Psalms 45:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:3)


יׇפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל־כֵּ֤ן בֵּרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God has blessed thee for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You are more beautiful than [all] men, [(who engage in ephemeral pursuits)]. Favor has been poured into your lips [(to teach according to the halachah)]. Therefore, G d has blessed you forever [viz. 29:11].


###### Psalms 45:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:4)


חֲגֽוֹר־חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל־יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty warrior: thy glory and thy majesty.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Buckle your sword upon your thigh, O strong one, [to fight the war of Torah]; [it is] your glory and your beauty.


###### Psalms 45:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:5)


וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨**׀** צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל־דְּבַר־אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה־צֶ֑דֶק וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And in thy majesty ride prosperously on in the cause of truth and for the sake of righteousness; and let thy right hand teach thee terrible things.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And your beauty is to champion the cause of truth and [to conduct yourself in] the humility of righteousness. And it [(your Torah and your truth)] will teach your right hand wonders [(in the war of Torah)].


###### Psalms 45:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:6)


חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy arrows are sharp: the people fall under thee: they sink into the heart of the king’s enemies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your arrows are sharpened (peoples will fall beneath you) against the heart of the king's foes. [i.e., Your disciples are "sharpened" against your "foes" (in halachic discourse). And, in reward for your Torah study, the foes of Israel will be vanquished by them.]


###### Psalms 45:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:7)


כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy throne, of God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of equity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your throne [of justice] reigns forever, [for] the rod of rightness is your rod of kingdom.


###### Psalms 45:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:8)


אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א־רֶ֥שַׁע עַל־כֵּ֤ן**׀** מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵחֲבֵרֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, has anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You loved righteousness and despised evil. Therefore, G d your G d anointed you with oil [of dominion amidst] the rejoicing of your companions.


###### Psalms 45:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:9)


מֹר־וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כׇּל־בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מִֽן־הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All thy garments are fragrant with myrrh, and aloes, and cassia: out of the ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Myrrh and aloes and cassia are [the fragrance of] all your garments. Finer than ivory palaces [are those readied for you in Gan Eden]. [Palaces that are] Mine will give you joy [(in reward)].


###### Psalms 45:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:10)


בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Kings’ daughters are among thy favourites: upon thy right hand stands the queen in gold of Ofir.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The daughters of kings will wait upon you. The queen will stand at your right hand [adorned] with the gold of Ophir.


###### Psalms 45:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:11)


שִׁמְעִי־בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אׇזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ וּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thy ear; forget also thy own people, and thy father’s house;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hearken, daughter [(congregation of Israel)], and see [the way of good], and forget your people [(the nations among which you were raised)], and the house of your father [(the idolatries of your ancestors)].


###### Psalms 45:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:12)


וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יׇפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי־לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
so shall the king desire thy beauty: for he is thy lord; and do homage to him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [(if you do this)], the King will desire your beauty. For He is your lord, and bow down to Him.


###### Psalms 45:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:13)


וּבַֽת־צֹ֨ר**׀** בְּ֭מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And O daughter of Żor, the rich among the people, shall entreat thy favour with a gift.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [even] the daughter of Tyre, the richest of the nations, will court your favor [with tribute and gift].


###### Psalms 45:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:14)


כׇּל־כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת־מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is inwrought with gold.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(The repository of)] all honor is the daughter [i.e., the congregation] of the King, [who conducted herself] inwardly [i.e., with modesty — More [precious] than the golden settings [(in the vestments of the high-priest)] is her raiment.


###### Psalms 45:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:15)


לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֢ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
She shall be brought to the king in embroidered garments: the virgins, her companions that follow her, shall be brought to thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In embroidered [garments] she will be brought [as a gift] to the King [viz. Isaiah 66:20]; virgins in her train [of the gentile nations] shall be brought to You [viz. Zechariah 8:23].


###### Psalms 45:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:16)


תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: they shall enter the king’s palace.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They will be brought in happiness and joy. They will come into the palace of the King.


###### Psalms 45:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:17)


תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑יךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In place of your fathers will be your sons. You will make them princes throughout the land.


###### Psalms 45:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/45:18)


אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכׇל־דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל־כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹד֗וּךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise Thee for ever and ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will invoke Your name in every generation, wherefore peoples will praise you forevermore.



## Chapter 46

###### Psalms 46:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֑רַח עַֽל־עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician for the sons of Qoraĥ, A Song to ῾Alamot.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of the sons of Korach, to be played on the alamoth, a psalm.


###### Psalms 46:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:2)


אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d is to us shelter and strength, help in affliction, ever to be found.


###### Psalms 46:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:3)


עַל־כֵּ֣ן לֹֽא־נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore we will not fear, though the earth change, and though the mountains are moved in the midst of the sea;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Therefore, we will not fear when the earth undergoes an upheaval and the mountains dip into the heart of the sea [viz. Isaiah 51:6 (the sons of Korach having undergone a similar upheaval themselves in the days of Korach, and having survived)].


###### Psalms 46:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:4)


יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִ֥רְעֲשֽׁוּ־הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Its waters will roar and drive the soil before them. The mountains will tremble in His eternal majesty.


###### Psalms 46:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:5)


נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
There is a river, whose streams make glad the city of God, the holiest dwelling place of the most High.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The river [of Gan Eden] — its tributaries will cause the city of G d to rejoice, the holy place of the dwellings of the Most High.


###### Psalms 46:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:6)


אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her at the dawn of day.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d is within her; therefore, she shall not fall. G d will help her towards morning [(the advent of the redemption)].


###### Psalms 46:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:7)


הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Nations raged, kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The nations have moaned, the kingdoms have bent [to fall]; for He has sent forth His voice and the earth has melted.


###### Psalms 46:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:8)


יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Ya῾aqov is our fortress. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[For] the L rd of hosts is with us, our fortress, the G d of Jacob, forever.


###### Psalms 46:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:9)


לְֽכוּ־חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Come, behold the works of the Lord, who has made desolations in the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Go and see the acts of G d, who brings devastation upon the land.


###### Psalms 46:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:10)


מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד־קְצֵ֢ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He makes wars to cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and cuts the spear in sunder; he burns the chariots in the fire.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He removes wars [from us] until the ends of the earth [(All of the nations will be at peace with us.)] He breaks the bow and cuts the spear [of the nations]; he burns the war chariots [of the idolators] in fire.


###### Psalms 46:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:11)


הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּֽי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Leave off [all you idolators, from attacking Jerusalem], and know that I am G d, [who will exact retribution of you]. [By My vengeance,] I will be exalted above the nations, I will be exalted above the earth.


###### Psalms 46:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/46:12)


יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Ya῾aqov is our fortress. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd of hosts is with us, our fortress, the G d of Jacob, forever.



## Chapter 47

###### Psalms 47:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of the sons of Korach, a psalm.


###### Psalms 47:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:2)


כׇּֽל־הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O clap your hands, all you peoples; shout to God with the voice of triumph.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let all the peoples join hands together to shout to G d with a voice of song.


###### Psalms 47:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:3)


כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the L rd is exalted and awesome, a great King over all the earth.


###### Psalms 47:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:4)


יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He subdues peoples under us, and nations under our feet.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He shall plague nations in our stead [(to assuage His wrath in them)] and [place] peoples under our feet.


###### Psalms 47:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:5)


יִבְחַר־לָ֥נוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת־גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Ya῾aqov whom he loves. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He shall choose for us our inheritance, the pride of Jacob [(the Temple)], which is beloved to Him forever.


###### Psalms 47:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:6)


עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a shofar.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Then] G d shall be exalted with teruah [over the burnt-offerings and peace-offerings]; the L rd, with the sound of the shofar.


###### Psalms 47:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:7)


זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises to our King, sing praises.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And we will say:] Sing to G d, sing! Sing to our king, sing!


###### Psalms 47:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:8)


כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כׇּל־הָאָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For God is the King of all the earth: sing a Maskil psalm.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the King of all the earth is G d — sing a maskil.


###### Psalms 47:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:9)


מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב**׀** עַל־כִּסֵּ֬א קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God reigns over the nations: God sits upon the throne of his holiness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[All will say:] G d has reigned over nations; G d has sat on His holy Throne [(which is now complete in its greatness)].


###### Psalms 47:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/47:10)


נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים**׀** נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֢י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י לֵ֭אלֹהִים מָֽגִנֵּי־אֶ֗רֶץ מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The nobles of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Avraham: for the shields of the earth belong to God: he is greatly exalted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And they will say:] The givers of the people have assembled [(those who offered their lives for the sanctity of His name)], the people of the G d of Abraham [(the first "giver," i.e., proselyte)]. For to G d belong the shields of the earth [(and His is the power to shield all who trust in Him)] — He is greatly exalted.



## Chapter 48

###### Psalms 48:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:1)


שִׁ֥יר מִ֝זְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵי־קֹֽרַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Song, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A song, a psalm, of the sons of Korach.


###### Psalms 48:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:2)


גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר־קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Great is the Lord, and highly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd is great [i.e., His greatness will be proclaimed] and greatly praised in the city of our G d [(when it will be rebuilt)], the mountain of His sanctuary.


###### Psalms 48:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:3)


יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֢וֹשׂ כׇּל־הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר־צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth: mount Żiyyon, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Beauteous of prospect, the joy of all the earth — Mount Zion [("beauteous of prospect")], the northern side [of the altar ("the joy of all the earth") — the sin-offerings and guilt-offerings (slaughtered on that side) resulting in the joy of atonement and in good for all the earth] — the city of the great King.


###### Psalms 48:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:4)


אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ נוֹדַ֥ע לְמִשְׂגָּֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God is known in her palaces for a fortress.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[When the L rd reposes there, they will say:] G d is in its citadels; [He is] renowned as [its] Stronghold.


###### Psalms 48:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:5)


כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭מְּלָכִים נ֥וֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For, lo, the kings were assembled, they came on together.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For, behold, the kings have assembled [(for the war of Gog and Magog)] and passed over together [to make war against Jerusalem].


###### Psalms 48:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:6)


הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As soon as they saw, they were astounded; they were affrighted; they rushed away.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They saw [the L rd going forth in battle against them] — and they were astounded. They were confounded and bewildered.


###### Psalms 48:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:7)


רְ֭עָדָה אֲחָזָ֣תַם שָׁ֑ם חִ֝֗יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Fear took hold of them there, and pain, like a woman in travail.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A trembling seized them there, pangs as of a woman in childbirth.


###### Psalms 48:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:8)


בְּר֥וּחַ קָדִ֑ים תְּ֝שַׁבֵּ֗ר אֳנִיּ֥וֹת תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
With the east wind [(the wind of "retribution")], you break the ships of Tarshish [(belonging to Edom)].


###### Psalms 48:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:9)


כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ**׀** כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד־עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: may God establish it for ever. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Just as we heard [(these consolations from our prophets)], thus did we see, in the city of the L rd of hosts, in the city of our G d. The L rd shall establish it forever, Selah.


###### Psalms 48:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:10)


דִּמִּ֣ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ בְּ֝קֶ֗רֶב הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
We have thought of Thy steadfast love, O God, in the midst of Thy temple.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(The prophet resumes His prayer to the L rd:)] We hoped, O G d, for Your kindness [to see Your salvation] in the midst of Your sanctuary.


###### Psalms 48:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:11)


כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
According to Thy name, O God, so is Thy praise to the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As Your name [is great] O G d, so is Your praise [great] over the ends of the earth. Righteousness fills Your right hand.


###### Psalms 48:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:12)


יִשְׂמַ֤ח**׀** הַר־צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let mount Żiyyon rejoice, let the daughters of Yehuda be glad, because of Thy judgments.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Mount Zion will rejoice, the [(other)] daughters [i.e., cities] of Judah will regale for the sake of Your judgments [(of retribution against the nations)].


###### Psalms 48:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:13)


סֹ֣בּוּ צִ֭יּוֹן וְהַקִּיפ֑וּהָ סִ֝פְר֗וּ מִגְדָּלֶֽיהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Walk about Żiyyon, and go round about her: count her towers.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Go around Zion, [You who build her], and encompass it. Count its towers [i.e., determine how many towers she requires].


###### Psalms 48:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:14)


שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם**׀** לְֽחֵילָ֗הֿ פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Mark well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that you may tell it to the generation following.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Set your hearts to [the restoration of] her ramparts; raise up her citadels, so that you can tell [of her grandeur and beauty] to the next generation.


###### Psalms 48:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/48:15)


כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה**׀** אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־מֽוּת׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For such is God, our God, for ever and ever: he will be our guide to the death.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For this G d [(who has wrought all this for us)] is our G d. He will lead us as [one leads] a young child.



## Chapter 49

###### Psalms 49:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of the sons of Korach, a psalm.


###### Psalms 49:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:2)


שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֭את כׇּל־הָעַמִּ֑ים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינוּ כׇּל־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear this, all the peoples; give ear, all the inhabitants of the world:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hear this, all of the peoples [(who trust to their wealth)]; listen, all who dwell upon the [ephemeral] earth.


###### Psalms 49:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:3)


גַּם־בְּנֵ֣י אָ֭דָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ יַ֝֗חַד עָשִׁ֥יר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
both low and high, rich and poor, together.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Both the sons of adam [Abraham, viz. Joshua 14:15] and the sons of ish [Noah, viz. Genesis 6:9], rich and poor alike.


###### Psalms 49:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:4)


פִּ֭י יְדַבֵּ֣ר חׇכְמ֑וֹת וְהָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣י תְבוּנֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My mouth shall speak wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My mouth will speak wisdoms, and the thoughts of my heart are cogent ones.


###### Psalms 49:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:5)


אַטֶּ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֣ל אׇזְנִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will incline my ear to a parable: I will open my riddle to the lyre.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall incline my ear to the parable [(to the words of Torah, viz. I Samuel 24:13)]; I shall open my riddle with the lyre:


###### Psalms 49:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:6)


לָ֣מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣י יְסוּבֵּֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my persecutors compasses me about?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why should I fear in the days of evil [i.e., on the day of reckoning]? — [because] the ["slight"] transgressions that I tread underfoot surround me.


###### Psalms 49:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:7)


הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל־חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עׇ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 49:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:8)


אָ֗ח לֹא־פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לֵאלֹהִ֣ים כׇּפְרֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A man cannot redeem his brother [from death with money]; he will not [be able to] give G d his ransom.


###### Psalms 49:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:9)


וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
for the redemption of their soul is too dear, and he leaves it for ever:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The redemption of their souls is too dear, and he would ever forbear [from attempting to ransom him].


###### Psalms 49:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:10)


וִיחִי־ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
that he might still live for ever, and not see the pit.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Would he [his brother] then live on forever and not see the pit?


###### Psalms 49:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:11)


כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה**׀** חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When he sees that wise men die, that the fool and the brutish person perish together, and leave their wealth to others:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For he sees sages die [(in this world)], the fools and the ignorant alike going lost [(in this world and the next)], and leaving their wealth to others. [(Perforce, then, one would not attempt to ransom his brother from death.)]


###### Psalms 49:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:12)


קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ**׀** לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְד֣וֹר וָדֹ֑ר קָרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Notwithstanding this,] in their hearts [they feel that] their houses will endure forever, their dwellings, from generation to generation, [and] they call [their houses] by their names upon the earth.


###### Psalms 49:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:13)


וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל־יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Nevertheless man abides not in honour: he is like the beasts that perish.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But man does not abide in his glory; he is silenced like the beasts.


###### Psalms 49:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:14)


זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם**׀** בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This is their way in their folly: and their posterity who approve their sayings. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
This, their way, is folly to them, and [those who come] after them, with their mouths relate it forever.


###### Psalms 49:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:15)


כַּצֹּ֤אן**׀** לִ֥שְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥ם וַיִּרְדּ֘וּ־בָ֤ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים**׀** לַבֹּ֗קֶר (וצירם) [וְ֭צוּרָם] לְבַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִזְּבֻ֥ל לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Like sheep they are appointed to She᾽ol; death shall be their shepherd; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their form shall waste away in She᾽ol, leaving behind their dwelling.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Like sheep [(gathered to the corral)], they [the wicked] are consigned to sheol [Gehinnom], [The angel of] death will devour them, and the just will rule over them in the morning [(on the day of Israel's redemption, viz. Malachi 3:21)], and their form will outlast sheol from [providing] habitation for them, [(the sun completing their incineration)].


###### Psalms 49:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:16)


אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִפְדֶּ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִֽיַּד־שְׁא֑וֹל כִּ֖י יִקָּחֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But God will redeem my soul from the power of She᾽ol: for he shall receive me. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But G d will redeem my soul from sheol, for [seeing that I have inclined my ear to the parable (verse 5)], He will take me [in my lifetime to walk in His ways] forever.


###### Psalms 49:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:17)


אַל־תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי־יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּי־יִ֝רְבֶּ֗ה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not fear when a man grows rich, when the honor of his household grows.


###### Psalms 49:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:18)


כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ֭מוֹתוֹ יִקַּ֣ח הַכֹּ֑ל לֹֽא־יֵרֵ֖ד אַחֲרָ֣יו כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
for when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For not in his death will he take it all; his honor shall not follow him [to the grave].


###### Psalms 49:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:19)


כִּֽי־נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּ֣יו יְבָרֵ֑ךְ וְ֝יוֹדֻ֗ךָ כִּי־תֵיטִ֥יב לָֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Though while he lives he blesses his soul: and though men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For he [(the wicked one)] blesses his soul in his life [(saying: "Peace to you, my soul; no harm will befall you" — but others do not say the same about him)]; but [you, if you hearken to My words, all] will praise you, for you will have conferred good upon yourself.


###### Psalms 49:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:20)


תָּ֭בוֹא עַד־דּ֣וֹר אֲבוֹתָ֑יו עַד־נֵ֝֗צַח לֹ֣א יִרְאוּ־אֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
it shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[When you die,] you will come [and see] the generation of his [(the wicked one's)] fathers [being judged in Gehinnom], not to see light forever.


###### Psalms 49:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/49:21)


אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Man that is in honour, and understands not, is like the beasts that perish.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A man who glories [in his wealth] and does not understand [that the true path of life and glory (Torah) has been set before him to choose] — [such a man] will be silenced like the beasts.



## Chapter 50

###### Psalms 50:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:1)


מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל**׀** אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהֹוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא־אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Psalm of Asaf. The mighty one, God, the Lord, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to the going down thereof.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A psalm of Asaf. He spoke and called upon the earth, from the rising of the sun until its setting.


###### Psalms 50:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:2)


מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל־יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Out of Żiyyon, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From Zion, the quintessence of beauty, G d shone forth.


###### Psalms 50:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:3)


יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽאַל־יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝סְבִיבָ֗יו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Our God comes, and does not keep silence: a fire devours before him, and it is very tempestuous round about him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(a prophecy of the future redemption:)] Our G d will come and will not be silent any longer [(over the blood of His servants that has been spilt)]. A fire from before Him will consume [(the nations)], and those around Him will be swept up as in a whirlwind.


###### Psalms 50:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:4)


יִקְרָ֣א אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵעָ֑ל וְאֶל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ לָדִ֥ין עַמּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He calls to the heavens above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He will call to the heavens above [(to visit punishment upon the heavenly plenipotentiaries of the nations)], and to the earth [(to visit punishment upon the kings of the nations)], to take vengeance for His people.


###### Psalms 50:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:5)


אִסְפוּ־לִ֥י חֲסִידָ֑י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־זָֽבַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Gather my pious ones together to me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(And He will say further to heaven and earth:)] Gather unto Me My saintly ones [(from the exile, viz. Song of Songs 4:16)], who entered into My covenant over a sacrifice [i.e., who accepted the Torah with covenant and sacrifice, viz. Exodus 24:8].


###### Psalms 50:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:6)


וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֓ים**׀** שֹׁפֵ֖ט ה֣וּא סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the heavens declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [the angels of] heaven will speak [i.e., vindicate] His righteousness, [saying] that G d judges forever.


###### Psalms 50:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:7)


שִׁמְעָ֤ה עַמִּ֨י**׀** וַאֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ אָנֹֽכִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Yisra᾽el, and I will testify against thee: I am God, thy God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hear, My people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will exhort you. I am G d, your G d.


###### Psalms 50:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:8)


לֹ֣א עַל־זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; and thy burnt offerings are continually before me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will not rebuke you for [remissness in] your sacrifices and [because] your burnt-offerings are [not] constantly before Me.


###### Psalms 50:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:9)


לֹא־אֶקַּ֣ח מִבֵּיתְךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗יךָ עַתּוּדִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will not take a young calf from your house nor goats from your enclosures.


###### Psalms 50:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:10)


כִּי־לִ֥י כׇל־חַיְתוֹ־יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־אָֽלֶף׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For Mine are all the animals of the forest, the behemoth of the thousand mountains.


###### Psalms 50:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:11)


יָ֭דַעְתִּי כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I know all the birds of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I know all the birds of the mountains, and what moves in the field is Mine.


###### Psalms 50:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:12)


אִם־אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא־אֹ֣מַר לָ֑ךְ כִּי־לִ֥י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I grow hungry, I will not tell you thereof, for Mine is the world and its fulness.


###### Psalms 50:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:13)


הַ֭אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְדַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do I eat the flesh of bulls? Do I drink the blood of he-goats? [(I requested sacrifices only that My will be done.)]


###### Psalms 50:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:14)


זְבַ֣ח לֵאלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְעֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Offer to God a thanksgiving; and pay thy vows to the most High:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The sacrifice of G d [i.e., the sacrifice that He desires] is confession [of your sins] and [(only then)] fulfillment of your vows to the Most High [(Only then will they be accepted with favor)].


###### Psalms 50:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:15)


וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then you will call upon Me in the day of affliction, and I will extricate you, and you will thereby honor Me [(that being My honor, saving those who trust in Me)].


###### Psalms 50:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:16)


וְלָ֤רָשָׁ֨ע**׀** אָ֘מַ֤ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים מַה־לְּ֭ךָ לְסַפֵּ֣ר חֻקָּ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֖א בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־פִֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But to the wicked man God says, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldst take my covenant in thy mouth?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But to the evildoer G d says: What cause have you [merely] to speak My statutes, and to carry My covenant [(My Torah)] on your mouth [alone]?


###### Psalms 50:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:17)


וְ֭אַתָּה שָׂנֵ֣אתָ מוּסָ֑ר וַתַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ דְּבָרַ֣י אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Seeing thou hatest instruction, and dost cast my words behind thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And you have hated instruction and cast My words behind your back.


###### Psalms 50:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:18)


אִם־רָאִ֣יתָ גַ֭נָּב וַתִּ֣רֶץ עִמּ֑וֹ וְעִ֖ם מְנָאֲפִ֣ים חֶלְקֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When thou didst see a thief, then thou didst consort with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If you saw a thief, you consented [to be] with him, and [you threw in] your lot with adulterers.


###### Psalms 50:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:19)


פִּ֭יךָ שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ בְרָעָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנְךָ֗ תַּצְמִ֥יד מִרְמָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou givest thy mouth free rein for evil, and thy tongue frames deceit.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You loosed your mouth for evil and attached [i.e., habituated] your tongue to deceit.


###### Psalms 50:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:20)


תֵּ֭שֵׁב בְּאָחִ֣יךָ תְדַבֵּ֑ר בְּבֶֽן־אִ֝מְּךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־דֹּֽפִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou dost slander thy own mother’s son.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You sat down [(in a company of mockers)] to speak against your brother, and to berate the son of your mother [(gratuitously, having no inheritance claim to contest with him)].


###### Psalms 50:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:21)


אֵ֤לֶּה עָשִׂ֨יתָ**׀** וְֽהֶחֱרַ֗שְׁתִּי דִּמִּ֗יתָ הֱיֽוֹת־אֶהְיֶ֥ה כָמ֑וֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ֖ וְאֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
These things hast thou done, and if I kept silence, thou wouldst think that I was altogether such a one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set the matter before thy eyes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
These [things] you did and I kept silent. You thought it was because I was with you [i.e., that I acquiesced in your evil]. But I will remonstrate with you and set [judgment] before you eyes.


###### Psalms 50:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:22)


בִּינוּ־נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Know this, now, O forgetters of G d, lest I snatch [you for judgment in the world to come] and there be no rescue.


###### Psalms 50:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/50:23)


זֹבֵ֥חַ תּוֹדָ֗ה יְֽכַ֫בְּדָ֥נְנִי וְשָׂ֥ם דֶּ֑רֶךְ אַ֝רְאֶ֗נּוּ בְּיֵ֣שַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Whoever offers praise glorifies me: and to him that orders his way aright I will show the salvation of God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
One who sacrifices [(i.e., one who brings a "sacrifice" of repentance and)] confession honors Me. And I set the way [(for sinners to repent to Me)]. I shall show him [(the penitent)] the salvation of G d.



## Chapter 51

###### Psalms 51:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 51:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:2)


בְּֽבוֹא־אֵ֭לָיו נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּ֝֗א אֶל־בַּת־שָֽׁבַע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
when Natan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bat-sheva.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he [David] had come to Bathsheva.


###### Psalms 51:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:3)


חׇנֵּ֣נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be gracious to me, O God, according to Thy steadfast love: according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Be gracious to me, O G d, according to Your lovingkindness. In the abundance of Your mercies erase my offenses.


###### Psalms 51:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:4)


(הרבה) [הֶ֭רֶב] כַּבְּסֵ֣נִי מֵעֲוֺנִ֑י וּֽמֵחַטָּאתִ֥י טַהֲרֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Cleanse me thoroughly from my transgression, and purify me from my sin.


###### Psalms 51:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:5)


כִּֽי־פְ֭שָׁעַי אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְחַטָּאתִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For I am [constantly] cognizant of [and grieved by] my offenses, and [therefore, it is as if] my sin is constantly before me.


###### Psalms 51:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:6)


לְךָ֤ לְבַדְּךָ֨**׀** חָטָאתִי֮ וְהָרַ֥ע בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּדׇבְרֶ֗ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְשׇׁפְטֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Against Thee, Thee alone, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in Thy sight: so that Thou art justified in Thy sentence, and clear in Thy judgment.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To You alone did I sin, [wherefore it is in Your hand to forgive]; and [even] the evil [against Uriah], in Your eyes did I do it [i.e., it was evil only in terms of Your exhortation], [and I sinned only] so that You be found right in Your word [(that I would fail the trial I took upon me, viz. 26:2)], so that You be vindicated in Your judgment.


###### Psalms 51:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:7)


הֵן־בְּעָו֥וֹן חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי וּ֝בְחֵ֗טְא יֶחֱמַ֥תְנִי אִמִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, I was shaped in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[How should I not sin] when I was created in transgression and my mother was warm with me in sin?


###### Psalms 51:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:8)


הֵן־אֱ֭מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַטֻּח֑וֹת וּ֝בְסָתֻ֗ם חׇכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts: therefore teach me wisdom in the inmost heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You desire truth in the reins, [and, in truth, I confess that I have sinned.] Inform me with wisdom in hiddenness [i.e., in my heart].


###### Psalms 51:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:9)


תְּחַטְּאֵ֣נִי בְאֵז֣וֹב וְאֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗נִי וּמִשֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Cleanse me with myrtle [(as one is cleansed from leprosy and from dead-body uncleanliness)], and I will be pure. Wash me and I will be whiter than snow.


###### Psalms 51:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:10)


תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֑ה תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Make me to hear joy and gladness: that the bones which Thou hast broken may rejoice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let me hear rejoicing and happiness [(forgiveness of sin)], and the bones that You have crushed [in Your wrath] will rejoice.


###### Psalms 51:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:11)


הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָ֑י וְֽכׇל־עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣י מְחֵֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hide Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hide Your face from my sins, and erase all my transgressions.


###### Psalms 51:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:12)


לֵ֣ב טָ֭הוֹר בְּרָא־לִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ נָ֝כ֗וֹן חַדֵּ֥שׁ בְּקִרְבִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Create in me a clean heart, O God and renew a steadfast spirit within me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A pure heart, create in me, O G d [(that I not stray again)], and a right spirit engender within me.


###### Psalms 51:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:13)


אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥נִי מִלְּפָנֶ֑יךָ וְר֥וּחַ קׇ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ אַל־תִּקַּ֥ח מִמֶּֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Cast me not away from Thy presence; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not cast me away from Your presence, and do not divest me of Your holy spirit.


###### Psalms 51:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:14)


הָשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֭י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וְר֖וּחַ נְדִיבָ֣ה תִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Restore to me the joy of Thy salvation; and uphold me with a willing spirit.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation [(the Holy spirit, which left me)], and let a noble spirit sustain me.


###### Psalms 51:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:15)


אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים אֵלֶ֥יךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then I will teach transgressors Thy ways; and sinners shall return to Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Then] I will teach offenders Your ways and sinners will return to You [(if they see that You have forgiven me.)]


###### Psalms 51:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:16)


הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִדָּמִ֨ים**׀** אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְשׁוּעָתִ֑י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of Thy righteousness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Save me from blood, O G d the G d of my salvation, [(that I not die by the sword for having killed Uriah)], and my mouth will sing Your praises.


###### Psalms 51:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:17)


אֲ֭דֹנָי שְׂפָתַ֣י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝פִ֗י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord, open my lips; and my mouth shall rehearse Thy praise.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, open my lips [(by forgiving me)] so that my mouth can speak Your praises.


###### Psalms 51:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:18)


כִּ֤י**׀** לֹא־תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶתֵּ֑נָה ע֝וֹלָ֗ה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou desirest not sacrifice; or else I would give it: Thou delightest not in burnt offering.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You do not desire a sacrifice [(a sin-offering is not brought for a witting transgression)], for [(if You did)], I would give it. You do not desire a burnt-offering.


###### Psalms 51:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:19)


זִ֥בְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ ר֤וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The sacrifices of G d are a broken spirit. A broken, crushed heart, O G d, You will not despise.


###### Psalms 51:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:20)


הֵיטִ֣יבָה בִ֭רְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּ֑וֹן תִּ֝בְנֶ֗ה חוֹמ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Do good in Thy favour to Żiyyon: build Thou the walls of Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Favor Zion with Your will [(to build the Temple within it in the lifetime of my son Solomon)]; build the walls of Jerusalem.


###### Psalms 51:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/51:21)


אָ֤ז תַּחְפֹּ֣ץ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֭דֶק עוֹלָ֣ה וְכָלִ֑יל אָ֤ז יַעֲל֖וּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ פָרִֽים׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then shalt Thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon Thy altar.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then You will desire sacrifices of righteousness [(and not sin-linked offerings)] — burnt-offerings and the [(completely)] consumed [(priestly meal-offering)]. Then will fatted calves ascend upon Your altar.



## Chapter 52

###### Psalms 52:1

לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Maskil of David,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a maskil of David.


###### Psalms 52:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:2)


בְּב֤וֹא**׀** דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִי֮ וַיַּגֵּ֢ד לְשָׁ֫א֥וּל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑וֹ בָּ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
when Do᾽eg the Edomite came and told Sha᾽ul, and said to him, David is come to the house of Aĥimelekh.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When Doeg the Edomite came to Saul and said to him: David has come to the house of Achimelech [viz. I Samuel 21, 22].


###### Psalms 52:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:3)


מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭רָעָה הַגִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why boastest thou thyself of evil, O mighty man? the love of God endures for all time.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why would you praise yourself with evil [(the evil that you plot against me by giving me away to Saul)], O strong one [(Doeg, "strong" in Torah)]? [Do you not know that] the lovingkindness of the L rd [(to rescue me from you)] [endures] all the day?


###### Psalms 52:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:4)


הַ֭וּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב לְשׁוֹנֶ֑ךָ כְּתַ֥עַר מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy tongue devises mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your tongue plotted destruction, as a sharpened razor, working deceit.


###### Psalms 52:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:5)


אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִטּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר**׀** מִדַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than speaking righteousness. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You loved evil more than good; falsehood more than speaking righteousness [(which endures)] forever.


###### Psalms 52:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:6)


אָהַ֥בְתָּ כׇֽל־דִּבְרֵי־בָ֗לַע לְשׁ֣וֹן מִרְמָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou lovest all devouring words, a deceitful tongue.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You loved all words of "swallowing" [i.e., slander], the language of deceit.


###### Psalms 52:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:7)


גַּם־אֵל֮ יִתׇּצְךָ֢ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ֨ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy tent, and root thee out of the land of the living. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd, likewise, will raze you for all time. He shall break you and remove you from your tent, and uproot you from the land of the living forever.


###### Psalms 52:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/52:8)


וְיִרְא֖וּ צַדִּיקִ֥ים וְיִירָ֗אוּ וְעָלָ֥יו יִשְׂחָֽקוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the righteous shall behold it and fear [(the L rd even more)], and him [Doeg] shall they mock, [saying]:

For a foe would never shame me and I bore it [(but I would kill him)], and my enemy never vaunted himself against me and I hid [(but now, perforce I must bear it, for you [Doeg/Achitofel] are great in Torah)].


###### Psalms 55:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:14)


וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּעִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
but it was Thou, a man my equal, my companion, and my familiar friend.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You are a man of my standing, my prince and my exalted one.


###### Psalms 55:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:15)


אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
We took sweet counsel together, and walked to the house of God in company.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Together we would "sweeten counsel" [in Torah]. In the house of G d [(the study halls)] we would walk in a throng.


###### Psalms 55:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:16)


(ישימות) [יַשִּׁ֤י מָ֨וֶת**׀**] עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי־רָע֖וֹת בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let death spread its oblivion upon them, and let them go down alive into She᾽ol: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May He incite [the angel of] death against them, for there are evils in their dwellings, in their midst.


###### Psalms 55:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:17)


אֲ֭נִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will call to G d and the L rd will help me.


###### Psalms 55:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:18)


עֶ֤רֶב וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צׇהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Evening, and morning, and at noon, I pray, and cry aloud: and he hears my voice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Evening, morning, and afternoon [(the three daily prayers)], I will plead and moan, and He will hear my voice.


###### Psalms 55:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:19)


פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְשָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁי מִקְּרׇב־לִ֑י כִּֽי־בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many who strove with me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He has always redeemed my soul for peace in my battles, because of the many who were with me [i.e., who prayed for me, viz. I Samuel 18:16].


###### Psalms 55:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:20)


יִשְׁמַ֤ע**׀** אֵ֨ל**׀** וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥֫לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God who is enthroned from olden time, shall hear and afflict them (Sela;) those who dread no changes, and do not fear God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May the Almighty hear [their prayers] and answer them, the Dweller [of the world] from time immemorial. For they [(the wicked ones, who pursue me)] do not give heart to their passing [from the world], and they do not fear G d.


###### Psalms 55:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:21)


שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He has put forth his hands against such as are at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He [Achitofel] stretched out his hands against his ally; he violated his covenant [with me].


###### Psalms 55:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:22)


חָלְק֤וּ**׀** מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקְרָב־לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Smooth were the "butterings" of his mouth, but his heart was for war. His words were softer than oil, but they were curses.


###### Psalms 55:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:23)


הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֢וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And the Holy Spirit answers:] Cast your burden upon the L rd, and He will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous one to falter.


###### Psalms 55:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/55:24)


וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים**׀** תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם׀לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח־בָּֽךְ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But Thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[David responds:] And You, O G d, bring them down to the pit of destruction. May men of blood and deceit not live out half their days — and I will trust in You.



## Chapter 56

###### Psalms 56:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ**׀** עַל־י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּאֱחֹ֨ז אוֹת֖וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּגַֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, upon Yonat-elem-reĥoqim, A Mikhtam of David, when the Pelishtim seized him in Gat.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, "On the Muted Dove [David], Far [from its Land]" — a michtam upon his [(near)] seizure by the Philistines in Gath [viz. I Samuel 21:12].


###### Psalms 56:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:2)


חׇנֵּ֣נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי־שְׁאָפַ֣נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be gracious to me, O God: for men long to swallow me up; all day long the foeman oppresses me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Be gracious to me, O G d, for men [(wish to)] swallow me, and every day battlers press upon me.


###### Psalms 56:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:3)


שָׁאֲפ֣וּ שׁ֭וֹרְרַי כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם כִּֽי־רַבִּ֨ים לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣י מָרֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My enemies daily long to swallow me up, for they are many who fight against me, O Thou most High.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Those who look [i.e., design] against me have sought to swallow me all the day. For many war against me, O Exalted One.


###### Psalms 56:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:4)


י֥וֹם אִירָ֑א אֲ֝נִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶבְטָֽח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When I am afraid, I will trust in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
On the day I fear I shall trust in You.


###### Psalms 56:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:5)


בֵּאלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֢ל דְּבָ֫ר֥וֹ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In God, I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear; what can flesh do to me?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Even if He accosts me] with Elokim [(the attribute of Justice)], I will praise His word. In Elokim (G d) I have trusted and will not fear, for what can flesh do to me?


###### Psalms 56:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:6)


כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖י כׇּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣ם לָרָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All of the day they [(my pursuers)] sadden my words upon me. All of their words are for evil.


###### Psalms 56:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:7)


יָג֤וּרוּ**׀** (יצפינו) [יִצְפּ֗וֹנוּ] הֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, as they wait for my soul.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They lie in wait, in ambush, watching my steps, hoping for me [to pass that way].


###### Psalms 56:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:8)


עַל־אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט־לָ֑מוֹ בְּ֝אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים**׀** הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Shall they escape by iniquity? in Thy anger cast down the peoples, O God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For iniquity [(capturing me)] they expect reward [(from Saul)]. With wrath, [these] peoples [(in whose midst I find myself)] bring down, O G d [(Bring them down from their murderous schemes)].


###### Psalms 56:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:9)


נֹדִי֮ סָפַ֢רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָה דִמְעָתִ֣י בְנֹאדֶ֑ךָ הֲ֝לֹ֗א בְּסִפְרָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou dost count my wanderings: put my tears into Thy bottle: are they not in Thy book?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My wanderings [(in search of refuge)] You have counted. Place [and keep] my tears [before You] in Your flask. Will [You] not [place them] with Your accounting [(along with my other woes)]?


###### Psalms 56:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:10)


אָ֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣י אָ֭חוֹר בְּי֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶֽה־יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When I cry to Thee, then shall my enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then, when my foes are turned back on the day that I call, then I will know that G d is with me.


###### Psalms 56:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:11)


בֵּ֭אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝יהֹוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In God, I will praise his word: in the Lord, I will praise his word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
With Elokim [(the attribute of justice)] I will praise [His] word [(see verse 5)]; with Hashem [(the attribute of mercy)], I will praise [His] word.


###### Psalms 56:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:12)


בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹּ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In Elokim (G d) I have trusted and will not fear. What can man do to me?


###### Psalms 56:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:13)


עָלַ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑יךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will pay Thee my offerings of thanksgiving.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
What I have vowed to You is binding upon me, O G d, and I shall pay [my vows] with thankfulness to You.


###### Psalms 56:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/56:14)


כִּ֤י הִצַּ֪לְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֡י מִמָּוֶת֮ הֲלֹ֥א רַגְלַ֗י מִ֫דֶּ֥חִי לְ֭הִֽתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝א֗וֹר הַחַיִּֽים׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, yea, my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You saved my soul from death; and did [You] not [also guard] my feet from stumbling, to walk before G d in the light of life [(by returning to Eretz Yisrael)]!



## Chapter 57

###### Psalms 57:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבׇרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, Al-tashĥet, a Mikhtam of David, when he fled from Sha᾽ul in the cave.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor — "Do not destroy [me]" — a michtam of David, when he fled from Saul [and hid himself] in the cave.


###### Psalms 57:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:2)


חׇנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים**׀** חׇנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֢יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל־כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me: for my soul trusts in Thee: and in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Be gracious to me, O G d [(that I not be killed)]; be gracious to me [(that I not kill)]. For my soul has sheltered itself with You, and I will seek shelter in the shadow of Your wings until the evil has passed.


###### Psalms 57:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:3)


אֶ֭קְרָא לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will cry to God most high; to God who performs all things for me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will call to G d on high, to the Almighty, who will consummate [His assurance] to me.


###### Psalms 57:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:4)


יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם**׀** וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He will send from heaven, and save me; he scorns him who would swallow me up. (Sela.) God shall send forth his steadfast love and his truth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He will send from heaven and deliver me for all time from the shaming of those who would swallow me. G d will send His lovingkindness and His truth [(the truth of His assurance)].


###### Psalms 57:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/57:5)


נַפְשִׁ֤י**׀** בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֢ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי־אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul is among lions: and I lie down among those who are aflame, the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
