[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:3)


אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress: I shall not be greatly moved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Only He is my Rock and my salvation. He is my Stronghold — I shall not slip greatly [i.e., without rising].


###### Psalms 62:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:4)


עַד־אָ֤נָה**׀** תְּה֥וֹתְת֣וּ עַל־אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֢וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How long will you seek to overwhelm a man? You will be all of you demolished like a leaning wall, or a tottering fence.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
How long will you devise destruction for a man? You would all murder, like an inclined wall, like a tottering fence.


###### Psalms 62:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:5)


אַ֤ךְ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ**׀** יָ֥עֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֢וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם יְקַֽלְלוּ־סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They even devise to thrust him down from his majesty: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Only [for fear of] his rising [(to power and exacting retribution of them)] do they counsel overthrowing [him], speaking lies — blessing with their mouths and cursing in their innards, always.


###### Psalms 62:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:6)


אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul waits in silence only for God; for my expectation is from him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But my heart trusts to G d, for my salvation [has always come] from Him.


###### Psalms 62:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:7)


אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He alone is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Only He is my Rock and my Salvation. He is my Stronghold — I shall not slip.


###### Psalms 62:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:8)


עַל־אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י צוּר־עֻזִּ֥י מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּאלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My salvation and my honor lie with G d. He is the Rock of my strength. My shelter is in G d.


###### Psalms 62:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:9)


בִּטְח֘וּ־ב֤וֹ בְכׇל־עֵ֨ת**׀** עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Trust in him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Trust in Him at all times. [My] people, spill your hearts out before Him [in prayer]; for He is our shelter eternally.


###### Psalms 62:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:10)


אַ֤ךְ**׀** הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי־אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֢ב בְּנֵ֫י־אִ֥ישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַעֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵהֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Men of low degree are mere breath, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than air.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But [trust in] man is vain. [Trust] in man is deceitful. If they were put in the scales, they and their vanities would balance.


###### Psalms 62:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:11)


אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ וּבְגָזֵ֢ל אַל־תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל**׀** כִּֽי־יָנ֑וּב אַל־תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not trust to violence, and do not [trust] vainly to theft. If [their] wealth flourishes, pay it no heed.


###### Psalms 62:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:12)


אַחַ֤ת**׀** דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם־ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God has spoken once: twice have I heard this; that power belongs to God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d has made one pronouncement [(the second commandment of the Decalogue)], from which [("I visit the iniquity of the fathers, etc.")] I have derived these two things: that strength is with G d [to pay a man according to his deeds (both reward and punishment)]


###### Psalms 62:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/62:13)


וּלְךָֽ־אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But love is also Thine, when Thou renderest to every man according to his work.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
and [that] with You, O L rd, is lovingkindness; for You pay [i.e., punish] a man as his deed [(his transgression, i.e., You punish part of it and not all of it [viz. Ezra 9:13])].



## Chapter 63

###### Psalms 63:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:1)


מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Yehuda.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A psalm of David — when he was in the Desert of Judah [(in flight from Saul)].


###### Psalms 63:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:2)


אֱלֹהִ֤ים**׀** אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲֽשַׁ֫חֲרֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨**׀** נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־מָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God, Thou art my God; earnestly I seek Thee: my soul thirsts for Thee, my flesh longs for Thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, You are my G d — I will seek You. My soul thirsts for You [(to come before You in Your house of prayer)]; my flesh pants for You, in a land waste and dry, without water.


###### Psalms 63:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:3)


כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑ךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
to see Thy power and Thy glory, as I have seen Thee in the sanctuary.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As [(I thirsted to see Your strength and Your glory as)] I saw You in the holy [(place of Shiloh, sate my soul now)] to see Your strength and Your glory.


###### Psalms 63:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:4)


כִּי־ט֣וֹב חַ֭סְדְּךָ מֵחַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Because Thy steadfast love is better than life, my lips shall praise Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For [the purpose of all] the goodness of Your lovingkindness in [the bestowal of] life [is that] my lips praise You.


###### Psalms 63:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:5)


כֵּ֣ן אֲבָרֶכְךָ֣ בְחַיָּ֑י בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ אֶשָּׂ֥א כַפָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thus will I bless Thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then [(when I come before You)], I will bless You [all the days of] my life. At [the mention of] Your name, I will lift my palms [(in prayer and in praise)].


###### Psalms 63:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:6)


כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth praises Thee with joyful lips:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As [with] marrow and fatness will my soul be sated, and [with] all manner of song will my mouth praise [G d].


###### Psalms 63:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:7)


אִם־זְכַרְתִּ֥יךָ עַל־יְצוּעָ֑י בְּ֝אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה־בָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
when I remember Thee upon my bed, and meditate on Thee in the night watches.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In truth, I have remembered You upon my sheets, and in the night watches I think upon You.


###### Psalms 63:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:8)


כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Because Thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of Thy wings I will rejoice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Because You were my help, and because of [the shelter of] the shadow of Your wings, I will sing [to You].


###### Psalms 63:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:9)


דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul clings to Thee: Thy right hand upholds me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Because] my soul clung to You, Your right hand sustained me.


###### Psalms 63:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:10)


וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they [(my foes)] seek [to take] my life [(by ambush)] in darkness [i.e., on a day of darkness]; let them come [i.e., fall] into the depths of the earth!


###### Psalms 63:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:11)


יַגִּירֻ֥הוּ עַל־יְדֵי־חָ֑רֶב מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall be given over to the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them drag [i.e., "dispatch"] him [(each one of my foes)] by the sword. Let them [(my foes)] be the portion of foxes.


###### Psalms 63:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/63:12)


וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֢ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כׇּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דוֹבְרֵי־שָֽׁקֶר׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But the king shall rejoice in God; everyone who swears by him shall glory: for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king [(David)] will rejoice in G d. All who swear by Him will glory [(in my salvation)], when the mouths of liars are closed up.



## Chapter 64

###### Psalms 64:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 64:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:2)


שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃

Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

###### Psalms 64:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:3)


תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hide me from the secret council of the wicked; from the tumult of the workers of iniquity:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Conceal me from the counsel of the wicked, from the gathering of workers of iniquity [viz. Daniel 6:7],


###### Psalms 64:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:4)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who have whetted their tongue like a sword, aimed their arrows of bitter words:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
who have sharpened their tongue as a sword, who have readied their arrow [i.e., slander] for a bitter thing.


###### Psalms 64:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:5)


לִירֹ֣ת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
to shoot the innocent man in secret; suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To shoot the innocent one in hiddenness. They shoot suddenly and do not fear.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:6)


יְחַזְּקוּ־לָ֨מוֹ**׀** דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־לָּֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They encourage one another in an evil matter: they speak of laying snares secretly; they say, Who shall see them?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 64:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:7)


יַ֥חְפְּֽשׂוּ־עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: for the inward thought of man, and the heart, is deep.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 64:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/64:8)


וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But God shoots his arrow at them: suddenly their wounds are on them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 64:9

but verily God has heard me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי׃

When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that became a reproach to me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And my crying in my fasting has become a shame to me [(my foes mocking me because of it)].

וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when I make my sackcloth my clothing [(in repentance)], I become a parable to them.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:13)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They who sit in the gate talk of me; and I am the song of drunkards.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The sitters in the gates [(the judges)] talk about me, and I have become the song of the drinkers of strong drink.


###### Psalms 69:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:14)


וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּֽתִי־לְךָ֨**׀** יְהֹוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרׇב־חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But as for me, let my prayer be to Thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the greatness of Thy steadfast love hear me, in the truth of Thy salvation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As for me, let [the time of] my prayer before You, O L rd, be a time of acceptance. O G d, in the abundance of Your lovingkindness, answer me with a true [(enduring)] salvation.


###### Psalms 69:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:15)


הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּ֖עֲמַקֵּי־מָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Rescue me from the mire [(the exile)] and let me not sink. Let me be saved from my foes and from the watery depths.


###### Psalms 69:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:16)


אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי**׀** שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, nor let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the current not sweep me away, and let the depths not swallow me, and let the well [(this strange affliction)] not close its mouth over me [(to swallow me)].


###### Psalms 69:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:17)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear me, O Lord; for Thy love is good: turn towards me according to the multitude of Thy compassion.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Answer me, O L rd, for Your lovingkindness is good. In the abundance of Your mercies, turn to me.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:18)


וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּי־צַר־לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; for I am in trouble: answer me speedily.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And do not conceal Your countenance from Your servant. Because affliction has overtaken me, be quick to answer me.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:19)


קׇרְבָ֣ה אֶל־נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Draw near to my soul, and redeem it: ransom me because of my enemies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Draw near to my soul; redeem it. For the sake of [(gainsaying)] my enemies, redeem me.


###### Psalms 69:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:20)


אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בׇשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כׇּל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou knowst my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: my adversaries are all before Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You know my shame, and my embarrassment, and my humiliation. All of my oppressors are before You.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Insult has broken my heart; and I am sick: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Shame has broken my heart and I have become mortally ill. I look for one who would nod [(his head to me in consolation)], and there is none; [I look] for consolers, and I cannot find any.


###### Psalms 69:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:22)


וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they gave me poison in my food; and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they give me gall for my fare and make me drink vinegar for my thirst.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:23)


יְהִי־שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let their table become a snare before them: and when they are at peace, let it be a trap.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let their table be a trap before them, and their [hoped-for] peace, a snare.


###### Psalms 69:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:24)


תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מׇתְנֵיהֶ֗ם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד׃

Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let their eyes be darkened from sight, and let their thighs always slip.


###### Psalms 69:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:25)


שְׁפׇךְ־עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Pour out Thy indignation upon them, and let Thy fierce anger overtake them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Spill Your ire upon them, and let the fury of Your wrath overtake them.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:26)


תְּהִי־טִירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let their habitation be desolate; let none dwell in their tents.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let their towers be desolate. In their tents let there be no dweller.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:27)


כִּי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל־מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃

For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; and they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 69:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:28)


תְּֽנָה־עָ֭וֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל־יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃

Add iniquity to their iniquity: and let them not be admitted to Thy vindication.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 69:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:29)


יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל־יִכָּתֵֽבוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them be erased from the book of life, and let them not be inscribed with the righteous.


###### Psalms 69:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:30)


וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I am afflicted and in pain: let thy salvation, O God, set me on high.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I, afflicted and [smarting] in pain, let Your salvation, O G d, uplift me.


###### Psalms 69:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:31)


אֲהַלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will praise the name of G d in song and exalt it in thankfulness.


###### Psalms 69:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:32)


וְתִיטַ֣ב לַ֭יהֹוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And it shall please the Lord better than an ox or a bullock that has horns and hoofs.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And this will be better in the eyes of the L rd than the young bull [(sacrificed by Adam)], horning and hooving [(Its horns preceded its hooves when it rose from the earth in creation)].


###### Psalms 69:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:33)


רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The humble shall see this, and be glad: and let your hearts revive, you who seek God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When the humble see [(my salvation)], they will rejoice, [and when] the seekers of G d [see it], their hearts shall live.


###### Psalms 69:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:34)


כִּי־שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶת־אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord hears the poor, and despises not his prisoners.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For [they will see that] the L rd gives ear to the poor ones and does not despise His imprisoned ones.


###### Psalms 69:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:35)


יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכׇל־רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and everything that moves therein.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Heaven and earth will praise Him, the seas and all that creep therein,


###### Psalms 69:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:36)


כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים**׀** י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For God will save Żiyyon, and will build the cities of Yehuda: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
when G d helps Zion and builds the cities of Judah and they sit therein and possess it.


###### Psalms 69:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/69:37)


וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָֽהּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell there.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 70

###### Psalms 70:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:1)


לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, of David, for invocation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, [a psalm] of David, to invoke [(the name of the L rd)].


###### Psalms 70:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:2)


אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Make haste, O God, to deliver me; to help me, O Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, [make haste] to save me; O L rd, hasten to my help.


###### Psalms 70:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:3)


יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֢י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be ashamed and confounded who seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, who desire my hurt.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let those who seek my soul be shamed and abashed. Let those who desire my ill recoil in shame.


###### Psalms 70:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:4)


יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בׇּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח׀הֶאָֽח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be turned back because of their shame who say, Aha, aha.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them be turned back in the [very] circuit of their shaming [of me, measure for measure,] those who exult [in my afflictions, shouting:] "He'ach! He'ach!"


###### Psalms 70:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:5)


יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ**׀** בְּךָ֗ כׇּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let all those who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: and let such as love Thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let all those who seek You rejoice and regale over You; and let those who love Your salvation always say [(when they are saved)]: "Let G d be exalted!"


###### Psalms 70:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/70:6)


וַאֲנִ֤י**׀** עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֢ים ח֫וּשָׁה־לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; delay not, O Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I am poor and indigent, O G d, make haste to [help] me. You are my help and my saviour. O L rd, do not delay!



## Chapter 71

###### Psalms 71:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:1)


בְּךָֽ־יְהֹוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In thee, O Lord, do I take refuge: let me never be put to confusion.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In You, O L rd, have I trusted — let me not be shamed forever!


###### Psalms 71:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:2)


בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אׇ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline Thy ear to me, and save me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In Your righteousness rescue me and release me. Incline Your ear to me and save me.


###### Psalms 71:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:3)


הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י**׀** לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be Thou my strong habitation, to which I may continually resort; which Thou hast appointed to save me; for Thou art my rock and my fortress.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Be to me a rock of shelter [in whose covert] to come always. You have [ever] commanded [(agents)] to help me; for You are my rock and my fortress.


###### Psalms 71:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:4)


אֱֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵֽץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked man, out of the hand of the unrighteous and violent man.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, rescue me from the hand of the wicked one, from the hand of the wrongdoer and the despoiler.


###### Psalms 71:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:5)


כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱ֝הֹוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou art my hope, O Lord God: Thou art my trust from my youth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You are my hope, O L rd, G d; my shelter from my youth.


###### Psalms 71:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:6)


עָלֶ֤יךָ**׀** נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
By Thee have I been sustained from the womb: Thou art he who took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise is continually of Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You were my stay from the womb. From my mother's belly did You take me forth. You have ever been my praise.


###### Psalms 71:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:7)


כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־עֹֽז׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am as a marvel to many; but Thou art my strong refuge.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have been a sign [(a symbol and portent of affliction)] for the multitude, but You are the shelter of my strength [(and I have borne all that has come upon me)].


###### Psalms 71:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:8)


יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let my mouth be filled with Thy praise and with Thy glory all the day.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My mouth shall be filled with Your praise; with Your glory all the day.


###### Psalms 71:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:9)


אַֽל־תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not cast me away now that I have aged [in sin]; with the waning of my strength, do not forsake me.


###### Psalms 71:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:10)


כִּֽי־אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For my enemies speak against me; and they who watch for my soul take counsel together,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For my foes have spoken against me, and those who watch my soul [(to ensnare it)] have taken counsel together,


###### Psalms 71:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:11)


לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
saying, God has forsaken him: pursue and catch him; for there is none to deliver him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
saying: The L rd has abandoned him. Pursue and seize him, for there is none to rescue him.


###### Psalms 71:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:12)


אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי (חישה) [חֽוּשָׁה]׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste to help me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, do not go far from me. My G d, hasten to my help.


###### Psalms 71:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:13)


יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֢י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them be confounded and consumed who are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour who seek my hurt.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the foes of my soul be shamed and cut off. Let those who seek my ill be enveloped in shame and abashment.


###### Psalms 71:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:14)


וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־כׇּל־תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But as for me, I will hope continually, and will praise Thee yet more and more.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I shall always hope [in You], and [(when You help me)] I shall add to all of Your praises.


###### Psalms 71:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:15)


פִּ֤י**׀** יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כׇּל־הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My mouth shall rehearse Thy righteousness and Thy salvation all the day; for I cannot count them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My mouth shall speak Your righteousness, Your salvation all of the day, for I do not know a count [(to the salvations You have wrought for me)].


###### Psalms 71:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:16)


אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will come to celebrate the mighty acts of the Lord God: I will make mention of Thy righteousness, Thine alone.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I come [to praise] the mighty acts of the L rd G d; I mention Your help alone [(for there is no other)].


###### Psalms 71:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:17)


אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth: and I still declare Thy wondrous deeds.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, You have taught me [(by what has passed over me)] from my youth, and until this day I relate Your wonders.


###### Psalms 71:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:18)


וְגַ֤ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה**׀** וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֢ים אַֽל־תַּ֫עַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכׇל־יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have related Thy strength to this generation, and Thy power to everyone that is to come.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And also in old age [(sixty)] and hoary old age [(seventy)] do not forsake me, O G d, so that I can speak of Your [mighty] arm to [that] generation, of Your strength to all those who come [to me],


###### Psalms 71:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:19)


וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy righteousness also, O God, reaches the high heavens, who hast done great things.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
of Your righteousness, O G d, which reaches to the heights, of the great things that You have done [with me]. O G d, who is like You!


###### Psalms 71:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:20)


אֲשֶׁ֤ר (הראיתנו) [הִרְאִיתַ֨נִי**׀**] צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב (תחינו) [תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי] וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God, who is like Thee! Thou who hast shown me many and grievous troubles, restore me to life again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[You,] who have shown me many troubles and ills, will turn back and revive me; and from the depths of the earth You will turn back and raise me.


###### Psalms 71:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:21)


תֶּ֤רֶב**׀** גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Increase my greatness, and turn to comfort me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Increase my greatness and surround me with consolation.


###### Psalms 71:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:22)


גַּם־אֲנִ֤י**׀** אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֢ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I too will praise Thee with the harp, speaking of Thy truth, O my God: to Thee will I sing with the lyre, O Thou Holy One of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I, likewise, shall praise Your truth with the harp, my G d. I shall play to You with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.


###### Psalms 71:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:23)


תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to Thee; and my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My lips will sing [praise] when I play to You [with the lyre], and the soul which You have redeemed.


###### Psalms 71:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/71:24)


גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־בֹ֥שׁוּ כִי־חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought to shame, who seek my hurt.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My tongue, too, all the day, shall speak Your righteousness, for the seekers of my ill have been shamed and abashed.



## Chapter 72

###### Psalms 72:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:1)


לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה**׀** אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־מֶֽלֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Shelomo. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, and Thy righteousness to the king’s son.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[A prayer of David (foreseeing that Solomon will request of the L rd a heart wise in judgment)] For Solomon. O G d, give Your judgments [the wisdom of Your Torah laws] to the king, and Your righteousness [(ruling in accordance with the law)] to the son of the king.


###### Psalms 72:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:2)


יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, and Thy poor with justice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let him judge Your people with righteousness and Your poor ones with justice.


###### Psalms 72:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:3)


יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָע֗וֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills, by righteousness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the mountains [(in his days)] bear peace to the people [i.e., let them be fruitful so that there will be peace in the land], and the hills [(bear peace)] through [the] righteousness [that the people perform].


###### Psalms 72:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:4)


יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט**׀** עֲֽנִיֵּי־עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִ֖ידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May he judge the cause of the poor of the people, may he save the children of the needy, and break the oppressor in pieces.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let him judge the poor of the people; let him help the sons of the indigent; and let him break the despoiler.


###### Psalms 72:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:5)


יִירָא֥וּךָ עִם־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May they fear Thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let them [Israel] fear You [(by learning from him)] with the sun [(i.e., as long as it exists)] and before the moon, throughout the generations.


###### Psalms 72:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:6)


יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל־גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May he come down like rain upon the mown grass: like showers that water the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let it [(his words)] descend [(into their hearts)] as rain upon the shorn grass, as raindrops that drip upon the earth.


###### Psalms 72:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:7)


יִֽפְרַח־בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד־בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In his days let the righteous flourish; and let there be abundance of peace till the moon is no more.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the righteous [(Israel)] flourish in his days, and [(let there be)] an abundance of peace until there is no moon [i.e., forever].


###### Psalms 72:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:8)


וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May he have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And let him reign [(over all the land of Israel)], from sea [the Red Sea] to sea [the Mediterranean], and from the river [the Euphrates] until the ends of the land.


###### Psalms 72:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:9)


לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them who dwell in the wilderness bow down before him, and his enemies lick the dust.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let coteries of nobles kneel before him and his foes lick the dust.


###### Psalms 72:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:10)


מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May the kings of Tarshish and of the isles bring presents: let the kings of Sheva and Seva offer gifts.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the kings of Tarshish [viz. I Kings 10:23] and the [men of the] islands bring gifts [to him]; let the kings of Sheva and Seva present a gift.


###### Psalms 72:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:11)


וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֥וֹ כׇל־מְלָכִ֑ים כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יַעַבְדֽוּהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And may all kings fall down before him; all nations serve him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let all the kings bow down to him; let all the nations serve him [viz. I Kings 10:24].


###### Psalms 72:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:12)


כִּֽי־יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין־עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For he shall deliver the needy when he cries; the poor also, and him who has no helper.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For he will rescue the pauper from outcry, and the poor one who has none to help him.


###### Psalms 72:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:13)


יָ֭חֹס עַל־דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He will spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He shall pity the poor and the indigent, and the souls of the indigent shall he save.


###### Psalms 72:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:14)


מִתּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He will redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From blows and theft he will redeem their souls [(by his judgment and righteousness)], and their blood shall be dear in his eyes.


###### Psalms 72:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:15)


וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ֮ מִזְּהַ֢ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣וֹ תָמִ֑יד כׇּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יְבָרְכֶֽנְהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Long may he live, and may the gold of Sheva be given to him: and let prayer be continually offered for him: let them bless him all the day.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And may he [Solomon] live [long], and may He give him of the gold of Sheva, and may He pray for him [i.e., bless him] always; may He bless him all the day.


###### Psalms 72:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:16)


יְהִ֤י פִסַּת־בַּ֨ר**׀** בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֢אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May there be abundance of corn in the land: may it rustle on the tops of the mountains: may its fruit be like the Levanon: and may they flourish in the city like the grass of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May there be an abundance of grain in the land, on the tops of the mountains. Let its fruit [i.e., its wheat stalks (be so large as to)] rustle as [the cedars of] Lebanon, and may they [Israel] sprout from the city [Jerusalem] as the grass of the earth.


###### Psalms 72:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:17)


יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ**׀** לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ (ינין) [יִנּ֢וֹן] שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May his name endure forever: may his name continue as long as the sun: and may men bless themselves by him: let all nations call him happy!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May his [Solomon's] name be [remembered] forever [(for his wealth and wisdom)]. Before [i.e., all the days of] the sun may his name grow great, and may [men] bless themselves by it [("May you be as wise and wealthy as Solomon!")], and may all the nations praise him.


###### Psalms 72:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:18)


בָּר֤וּךְ**׀** יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Yisra᾽el, who does wondrous things alone.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Blessed be the L rd G d, the G d of Israel, who performs wonders alone [viz. II Chronicles 7:1].


###### Psalms 72:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:19)


וּבָר֤וּךְ**׀** שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀וְאָמֵֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And blessed be the name of His glory forever. And let His glory fill all the earth. Amen and Amen.


###### Psalms 72:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/72:20)


כׇּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן־יִשָֽׁי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The prayers of David the son of Yishay are ended.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All these [psalms] are the prayers of David the son of Yishai.



## Chapter 73

###### Psalms 73:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:1)


מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֖וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Psalm of Asaf. Truly God is good to Yisra᾽el, to such as are of a clean heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A psalm of Asaf. [Though I bewail the afflictions of Israel, I know that] truly, G d is good to Israel, to the pure of heart, [(in the afflictions He brings upon them, their purpose being to make them merit life in the world to come)].


###### Psalms 73:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:2)


וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט (נטוי) [נָטָ֣יוּ] רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן (שפכה) [שֻׁפְּכ֥וּ] אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I — my feet had almost turned [from the path of G d]. In almost no time my feet might have spilled out [of the path].


###### Psalms 73:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:3)


כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For I was envious of the [success of] the perverters [of their paths]; I beheld the peace of the evildoers.


###### Psalms 73:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:4)


כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For there are no pangs at their death; their body is firm.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For there were no bonds [of afflictions] to their deaths, and [they died] strong as a fortress.


###### Psalms 73:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:5)


בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They are not in trouble as other men; nor are they plagued like other men.


###### Psalms 73:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:6)


לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore pride is their necklace; violence covers them like a garment.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Therefore, pride necklaces them; their theft bedecks their buttocks [with fat].


###### Psalms 73:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:7)


יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Their eyes protrude from [an excess of] fat. The hopes of their hearts are exceeded [by what they attain].


###### Psalms 73:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:8)


יָמִ֤יקוּ**׀** וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They deride, and wickedly speak oppression: they speak loftily.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They melt [the hearts of men] and they plot to rob the poor. They speak against the Most High.


###### Psalms 73:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:9)


שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue struts through the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They set their mouths against Heaven and their tongues range the earth.


###### Psalms 73:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:10)


לָכֵ֤ן**׀** (ישיב) [יָשׁ֣וּב] עַמּ֣וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּמֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Therefore his people return here: and abundant waters are drained out by them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Therefore, [(because they see the wicked flourishing)], His people turn hither [(to their deeds)], and the waters of the full [stream (i.e., Torah)] are dregs to them.


###### Psalms 73:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:11)


וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they say, How does God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they say: "How can [we say] that G d knows [i.e., that He has wisdom], and that there is knowledge in the Almighty [i.e., that His Torah is true]?"


###### Psalms 73:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:12)


הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, these are the wicked, always at ease; they increase in riches.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"Now, these [men] are wicked [(and they transgress His Torah)], and yet they live tranquilly [in the] world and amass wealth!"


###### Psalms 73:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:13)


אַךְ־רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑י וָאֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"It was but in vain that I purified my heart and washed my hands in cleanliness."


###### Psalms 73:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:14)


וָאֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לַבְּקָרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
for all the day I have been stricken, and chastised every morning.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"And I have been afflicted all the day, and my chastisement [has renewed itself] every morning."


###### Psalms 73:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:15)


אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֖וֹר בָּנֶ֣יךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I had said, I will speak thus; behold, I should have offended against the generation of Thy children.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I [Asaf] undertook to tell it [(all that His people say)] as [it is], I would render the generation of Your children traitors.


###### Psalms 73:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:16)


וָ֭אֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל (היא) [ה֣וּא] בְעֵינָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So I pondered how I might understand this, but it was too wearisome for me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And when I strove to understand this [(this mode of G d's conduct)], it seemed wrong in my eyes.


###### Psalms 73:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:17)


עַד־אָ֭בוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Until I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their end.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Until I came to the sanctuaries of G d [(in Jerusalem and saw what had happened to Sancheriv)]. Then I understood their [(the sinners')] end [i.e., that it is destruction.].


###### Psalms 73:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:18)


אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗ם לְמַשּׁוּאֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Surely Thou dost set them in slippery places: Thou dost cast them down into destruction.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Only as "smoothings" do You set [all this good] before them [i.e., You make things smooth for them so that they give no thought to repentance], and You cast them into darkness.


###### Psalms 73:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:19)


אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה כְרָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How are they brought into desolation in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Their beholders will say:] How were they made desolate in an instant! They are ended! They are extinguished with horrors!


###### Psalms 73:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:20)


כַּחֲל֥וֹם מֵהָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בָּעִ֤יר**׀** צַלְמָ֬ם תִּבְזֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As a dream when one awakes; so, O Lord, on awaking, Thou shalt despise their image.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As an endless dream [(with no awakening, so was their end [viz. Isaiah 37:36])]. The L rd, in the city [that they violated (Jerusalem)], despised their form [(burning them all)].


###### Psalms 73:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:21)


כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑י וְ֝כִלְיוֹתַ֗י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When my heart was embittered, and I was pricked in my reins;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For [(before I saw their downfall in a vision)], my heart was embittered [(at the success of the wicked)] and my reins were pierced.


###### Psalms 73:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:22)


וַאֲנִי־בַ֭עַר וְלֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
then I was foolish and ignorant: I was like a beast before Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I was a fool, not knowing [i.e., not understanding Your mode of conduct]; I was [like] a beast with You.


###### Psalms 73:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:23)


וַאֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I am continually with Thee: Thou holdest my right hand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But [(in spite of this)] I was always with You [(not deviating from Your fear)]. You held onto my right hand [(to strengthen me in Your fear when I was in danger of slipping [(see verse 2)].


###### Psalms 73:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:24)


בַּעֲצָתְךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְ֝אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou shalt guide me with Thy counsel, and afterwards receive me to honourable state.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You led me in Your counsel, and then, You took me [to Yourself] for glory.


###### Psalms 73:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:25)


מִי־לִ֥י בַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝עִמְּךָ֗ לֹא־חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Whom have I in heaven but Thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Whom do I have in heaven? [(What angel did I choose for a god?)] And I desired no one [else] with You on earth.


###### Psalms 73:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:26)


כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗י וּלְבָ֫בִ֥י צוּר־לְבָבִ֥י וְחֶלְקִ֗י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My flesh and my heart fail: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My flesh and my heart yearn [for You]. G d is the Rock of my heart and my portion forever.


###### Psalms 73:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:27)


כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כׇּל־זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For, lo, they that are far from Thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all those who go astray from Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For those who go far from You will go lost, as You have [always] cut off those who have strayed from You.


###### Psalms 73:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/73:28)


וַאֲנִ֤י**׀** קִ֥רְבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫י־ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י**׀** בַּאדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י לְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר כׇּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽיךָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But as for me, the nearness of God is my good: I have made the Lord God my refuge, that I may relate all Thy works.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And, as for me, the nearness of G d is my good. I have placed my shelter in the L rd G d, to relate all of Your embassies [(the Holy Spirit that enters my heart for revelation)].



## Chapter 74

###### Psalms 74:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:1)


מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף לָמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָנֶ֑צַח יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ בְּצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Maskil of Asaf. O God, why hast Thou cast us off for ever? why does Thy anger smoke against the sheep of Thy pasture?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A maskil of Asaf. Why, O G d, should You leave us forever, should Your wrath fume against the flock of Your grazing?


###### Psalms 74:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:2)


זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְךָ֨**׀** קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ הַר־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה**׀** שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast purchased of old; the tribe of Thy inheritance, which Thou hast redeemed; this mount Żiyyon, wherein Thou hast dwelt.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Remember Your congregation that You acquired of yore [(before the creation of the world [viz. 90:1-2])]. You redeemed the tribe of Your inheritance [and brought them to] Mount Zion, on which You dwell.


###### Psalms 74:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:3)


הָרִ֣ימָה פְ֭עָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח כׇּל־הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lift up Thy feet to the perpetual desolations; the enemy has destroyed everything in the sanctuary.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Raise Your blows for eternal destruction [(of Your foes)], for all of the foe's evil [perpetrated] in the sanctuary.


###### Psalms 74:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:4)


שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶיךָ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ם אֹתֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy enemies roar in the midst of thy meeting place; they set up their signs for signs:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your adversaries have roared in the midst of Your meeting place [(the Temple viz. Exodus 25:22)]; they have made [i.e., construed] their signs [i.e., their divinations for the conquest of Jerusalem (viz. Ezekiel 21:26)] as [true] signs.


###### Psalms 74:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:5)


יִ֭וָּדַע כְּמֵבִ֣יא לְמָ֑עְלָה בִּסְבׇךְ־עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
they are known as swingers of axes upwards in the thick forest:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
It was known [to the foe when he raised his hatchets against the gates of the sanctuary that it was] as if he were bringing [his blows] on High, for the hatchets would become entangled in [and be swallowed up by] the wood [of the gates].


###### Psalms 74:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:6)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and now they break down its carved work altogether with hatchet and with hammers.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But then [(even though he saw this sign of G d's opposition, this did not deter him from razing all of)] its entrances together. With hatchets and hammers they pounded.


###### Psalms 74:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:7)


שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ךָ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They have burned Thy sanctuary with fire, to the ground: they have defiled the dwelling place of Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They have set Your sanctuary aflame. To the ground have they desecrated the abode of Your name.


###### Psalms 74:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:8)


אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כׇל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They have said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They said [i.e., devised] in their hearts, [all of] their rulers together, [to eliminate their Deity first, and then to eliminate the Jews. Know this to be so, for] they burned all the meeting places of G d in the land: [the Philistines, Shiloh; Nevuchadnezzar, the first Temple; Titus, the second Temple].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
We see not our signs: there is no longer a prophet: nor is there among us any that knows how long.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Our signs [(given by the prophets for redemption from the exile)] we have not [yet] seen. There is no longer a prophet [among us], and there is none among us who knows until when [the exile will endure].

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:10)


עַד־מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְךָ֣ לָנֶֽצַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God, how long shall the adversary insult? shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Until when, O G d, shall the oppressor revile, shall the foe blaspheme Your name forever?

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:11)


לָ֤מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְךָ וִימִינֶ֑ךָ מִקֶּ֖רֶב (חוקך) [חֵיקְךָ֣] כַלֵּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why dost Thou withdraw Thy hand, even Thy right hand? out of Thy bosom with it! destroy!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why do You hold back Your hand, Your right hand, [from smiting the foe]? From the midst of Your bosom, discharge [it against them]!


###### Psalms 74:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:12)


וֵ֭אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣י מִקֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
for God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [You, my] G d, are my King of yore, who works salvation in the midst of the land!


###### Psalms 74:13

אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְעׇזְּךָ֣ יָ֑ם שִׁבַּ֥רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou didst divide the sea by Thy strength: Thou didst break the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You crumbled the sea in Your strength. You broke the heads of the sea-serpents [the Egyptians (viz. Ezekiel 29:3)] on the waters.


###### Psalms 74:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:14)


אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְעָ֣ם לְצִיִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou didst crush the heads of livyatan: thou didst give him for food to the desert people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You broke the heads of the leviathan [Pharaoh (viz. Isaiah 27:1)]. You gave it [the wealth of Egypt] as food [i.e., plunder] for the people, the hosts, [of Israel].


###### Psalms 74:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:15)


אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָנָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou didst split open springs and wadis: Thou didst dry up the ever flowing streams.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 74:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:16)


לְךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף־לְךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The day is Thine, the night also is Thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Yours is the day [(the redemption of Israel)]. Yours, too, is the night [(They were with You in the afflictions of the night)]. You founded [for them] light [(Torah)] and sun.


###### Psalms 74:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:17)


אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כׇּל־גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You set up [for them] all the borders of the land of Israel with all manner of good]. Summer and winter — You created them [(and You did not alter their order)].


###### Psalms 74:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:18)


זְכׇר־זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף׀יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Remember this, how the enemy has insulted the Lord, and how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 74:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:19)


אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗יךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O deliver not the soul of Thy turtledove to the wild beast: forget not the congregation of Thy poor for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 74:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:20)


הַבֵּ֥ט לַבְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Look upon the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full, the habitations of cruelty.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Look to the covenant [(with the patriarchs)], for the dark places of the land have become filled with enclaves of violence.


###### Psalms 74:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:21)


אַל־יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the broken one not return shamed [from his prayer before You]. Let the poor and destitute praise Your name [(when You answer their prayers)].


###### Psalms 74:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:22)


קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣ה רִיבֶ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְךָ֥ מִנִּי־נָ֝בָ֗ל כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Arise, O God, plead Thy own cause: remember how the foolish man insults Thee daily.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Arise, O G d, fight Your battle. Remember the profligate's reviling You all the day.


###### Psalms 74:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/74:23)


אַל־תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑יךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗יךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Forget not the voice of Thy enemies: the tumult of those who rise up against Thee increases continually.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
