## Chapter 75

###### Psalms 75:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, Al-tashĥet, A Psalm of Asaf, A Poem.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor — Do not destroy [Israel in the exile] — a psalm of Asaf, a song.


###### Psalms 75:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:2)


ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨**׀** אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְקָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To Thee, O God, we give thanks; we give thanks; for Thy name is near; men declare Thy wondrous works.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
We have thanked You, O G d [(for the good)]; we have thanked You [(for the ill)], and Your name is [always] close [(to us, in our mouths)]. [Your generations] have related Your wonders [always].


###### Psalms 75:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:3)


כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Surely I shall take the appointed time; I will judge with equity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When I take [i.e., celebrate] a festival, [I do not indulge in frivolity, but] I judge what is just [i.e., I take it to heart to praise You in accordance with the nature of that festival].


###### Psalms 75:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:4)


נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְכׇל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When the earth and all its inhabitants are dissolved, I bear up the pillars of it. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[On the day of the giving of the Torah, when] the earth and all its dwellers were melting [with fear, least the condition that You made with the creation — "If Israel does not accept the Torah, you [the creation] shall revert to nothingness" —], I [Israel] established its pillars forever [by saying (Exodus 24:7): "We shall do and we shall hear."]


###### Psalms 75:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:5)


אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭הוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I said to the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly! and to the wicked, Lift not the horn.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I said to the mockers [(the evil ones, who confound Israel)]: Do not mock; and to the wicked: Do not raise your horn [in rebellion against the Almighty].


###### Psalms 75:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:6)


אַל־תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lift not your horn on high: speak not with an insolent neck.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not lift your horn on high; [do not] speak with brazen neck.


###### Psalms 75:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:7)


כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For judgment comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert peaks:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For not from east or west, and not from the desert [(which you cross in caravans in pursuit of wealth)] does lifting come.


###### Psalms 75:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:8)


כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
but God is the judge: he puts one down, and sets up another.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But G d judges [(you for every evil you have done)]. This one [(the proud)] He lowers, and that one [(the lowly)] He exalts.


###### Psalms 75:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:9)


כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־יְהֹוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר**׀** מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֢ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, with foaming wine; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but its dregs, shall all the wicked of the earth drain and drink.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the [poisoned] cup is in the hand of the L rd — strong wine, fully admixed [(for all of the idolators)]. And from this He pours. Only [(the wicked, and not the righteous)] will drain its dregs. All the wicked of the earth will drink [of it].


###### Psalms 75:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:10)


וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Ya῾aqov.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I shall [then] speak forever [(of His vengeance and His might)]. I shall sing to the G d of Jacob.


###### Psalms 75:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/75:11)


וְכׇל־קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And all the horns of the wicked [Esav (viz. Ezekiel 29:14)] will I cut off, [and] the horns [i.e., the glory (viz., Israel)] of the righteous One will be uplifted.



## Chapter 76

###### Psalms 76:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/76:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/76:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm of Asaf, A Poem.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor of the singing, a psalm of Asaf, a song [on the downfall of Sancheriv)]:

נוֹדָ֣ע בִּיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃

In Yehuda is God known: his name is great in Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.

In Shalem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place is in Żiyyon.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
His tabernacle was in Shalem [Jerusalem], and His abode in Zion.

There he broke the flashing arrows, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

At Thy rebuke, O God of Ya῾aqov, he is put to sleep, together with chariot and horse.

מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃

When God arose to judgment, to save all the humble of the earth. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When G d rises in judgment [against His foes, it is] to help all the humble of the earth forever.

כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the wrath of man [(the wicked)] will praise You [i.e., When people see that the wrath of the wicked cannot withstand G d's punishment, they all praise Him]; You constrain the wrath of the remnant [of the wicked (by showing such wrath to be ineffectual against Him)].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Vow, and pay to the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents to him that is to be feared.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Vow and pay [your vows] to the L rd Your G d, all around it [Jerusalem (upon hearing of this salvation, viz. Isaiah 19:18)]. They will bring gifts to the Awesome One,

יִ֭בְצֹר ר֣וּחַ נְגִידִ֑ים נ֝וֹרָ֗א לְמַלְכֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 77

###### Psalms 77:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־[יְדוּת֗וּן] (ידיתון) לְאָסָ֥ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, to Yedutun, A Psalm of Asaf.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, on yeduthun [(the decrees that come upon Israel)] of Asaf, a psalm.


###### Psalms 77:2

קוֹלִ֣י אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קוֹלִ֥י אֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To God I will cry aloud: aloud to God. O, hear me!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[I shall lift] my voice to G d, and I shall cry out. [When I lift] my voice to G d, He shall pay heed to me.


###### Psalms 77:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:3)


בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֢י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י**׀** לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃

On the day of my travail, I sought the L rd. My hand [i.e., my wound] oozes [putrefaction] all the night [of exile] and does not abate. My soul refuses consolation.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:4)

I remember God, and moan: I meditate, and my spirit faints. (Sela.)

Thou holdest fast my eyelids: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 77:7

I call to remembrance my song in the night: I meditate with my heart: and my spirit makes diligent search.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/77:9)


הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדּ֑וֹ גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

Has God forgotten to be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? (Sela.)

Has G d forgotten to be gracious? Has He closed off, in anger, His mercies forever?

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I said, I am sick at heart, for the right hand of the most High has changed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said: It is to frighten me [(into returning to Him)] that the right hand of the Almighty has changed [(from smiting the foe to turning back from doing so)].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember Thy wonders of old.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[When] I think upon the feats of the L rd; when I think upon Your wonders of yore,

I will meditate also on all Thy work, and muse on Thy doings.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I bring to mind all of Your deeds [(that You have performed for us until now)], and I hold converse in Your acts.

אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי־אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּאלֹהִֽים׃

Thy way, O God, is in holiness: who is so great a God as our God?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, Your way is in holiness [i.e., to sanctify Your name in the world by exacting punishment of the wicked]. Who is a great god as G d [is]?

Thou art the God That doest wonders: Thou hast declared Thy strength among the people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast with Thy arm redeemed Thy people, the sons of Ya῾aqov and Yosef. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: Thy arrows also went abroad.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

ק֤וֹל רַעַמְךָ֨**׀** בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Thy way was in the sea, and Thy path in the great waters, and Thy footsteps were not known.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock by the hand of Moshe and Aharon.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 78

###### Psalms 78:1

לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ**׀** דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃

that the generation to come might know them, the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

and that they might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not steadfast with God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

בְּֽנֵי־אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רֽוֹמֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃

They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to follow his Tora;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
they did not keep the covenant of G d and refused to walk in His Torah.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and forgot his works, and his wonders that he had shown them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they forgot His acts and the wonders that He showed them.


###### Psalms 78:12

נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃

Marvellous things he did in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Miżrayim, in the field of Żo῾an.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

###### Psalms 79:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/79:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/79:9)

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/79:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/79:10)

###### Psalms 79:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/79:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/79:11)

וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨**׀** וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְד֥וֹר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃{פ}

###### Psalms 80:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Testimony, A Psalm of Asaf.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, to the roses [(Israel)], a psalm of testimony [and prayer] of Asaf [(Asaf alluding in it to three exiles [viz. the thrice-repeated "Return us; illumine Your face, and we will be saved" (verses 4, 8 and 20)], and also alluding to the afflictions destined to come upon them in the days of the house of Yehu at the hands of the kings of Aram [viz. II Kings 13:7])].


###### Psalms 80:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:2)


רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל**׀** הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Give ear, O shepherd of Yisra᾽el, that leadest Yosef like flock, Thou who art enthroned upon the keruvim, shine forth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O, Shepherd of Israel, hear, [He] who leads Joseph [(Israel)] as [a shepherd leads] the sheep. Dweller [between] the cherubs [on the ark (viz. Exodus 25:22)], appear! [i.e., Manifest Your strength.]


###### Psalms 80:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:3)


לִפְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם**׀** וּבִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥ה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶ֑ךָ וּלְכָ֖ה לִישֻׁעָ֣תָה לָּֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Before Efrayim, and Binyamin, and Menashshe, stir up Thy might, and come to save us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Before Efraim, and Binyamin, and Menasheh [(though they not be worthy)] awake Your strength, for it befits You to save us. [Ephraim: viz. I Kings 20:3; Menasheh: viz. II Kings 13:4 and 25; Binyamin: in the days of Mordecai and Esther.]


###### Psalms 80:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:4)


אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Restore us, O God, and cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, return us [(from the Babylonian exile [Mordecai was one of those exiled to Bavel])]; illumine Your face and we will be saved.


###### Psalms 80:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:5)


יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד־מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, G d of hosts, how long will You fume [(with the afflictions of the Greek kings)] against the prayer of Your people?


###### Psalms 80:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:6)


הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝תַּשְׁקֵ֗מוֹ בִּדְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears; and hast given them tears to drink in great measure.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You fed them tears for bread [(in Egypt)]. [In Bavel] You gave them a third of the tears to drink [(the exile of Bavel lasting seventy years to Egypt's two hundred and ten)].


###### Psalms 80:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:7)


תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝אֹיְבֵ֗ינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָֽמוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou makest us a strife to our neighbours: and our enemies mock as they please.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You made us [an object of] strife to our neighbors [(Greece)], and our foes mock us.


###### Psalms 80:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:8)


אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ וְהָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Restore us, O God of hosts, and cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d of hosts, return us; illumine Your face, and we will be saved [(from Greece)].


###### Psalms 80:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:9)


גֶּ֭פֶן מִמִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַתִּטָּעֶֽהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast brought a vine out of Miżrayim, Thou hast cast out nations, and planted it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The vine [(Israel)] that You uprooted from Egypt — You drove out [the seven] nations and planted it [there].


###### Psalms 80:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:10)


פִּנִּ֥יתָ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵ֥שׁ שׇׁ֝רָשֶׁ֗יהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou didst clear a space for it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You cleared out [its dwellers] before it, and it took root and filled the land.


###### Psalms 80:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:11)


כׇּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑הּ וַ֝עֲנָפֶ֗יהָ אַֽרְזֵי־אֵֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the mighty cedars with its boughs.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Its shade covered the mountains, and its boughs were mighty cedars [i.e., mighty kings].


###### Psalms 80:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:12)


תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣הָ עַד־יָ֑ם וְאֶל־נָ֝הָ֗ר יוֹנְקוֹתֶֽיהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
She sent out her boughs to the sea, and her branches to the river.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
It sent its branches to the sea [(the Mediterranean)] and its shoots to the river [(The width of Eretz Yisrael is from the desert to the Euphrates)].


###### Psalms 80:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:13)


לָ֭מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑יהָ וְ֝אָר֗וּהָ כׇּל־עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Why hast Thou then broken down her fences, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck her fruit?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why do You [now] breach its [the vineyard's] fences and let all of the passersby pluck its fruit?


###### Psalms 80:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:14)


יְכַרְסְמֶ֣נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִיָּ֑עַר וְזִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽנָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The boar out of the wood ravages it, and the wild beast of the field devours it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Why should] the swine of the forest [Esav (Rome) viz. Daniel 7:7)] erode it and the creeping things of the field graze on it?


###### Psalms 80:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:15)


אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב־נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וּ֝פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Return, we beseech Thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d of hosts, return [to us] now. Look from the heavens and see, and remember this vine


###### Psalms 80:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:16)


וְ֭כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑ךָ וְעַל־בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and of the stock which Thy right hand has planted, and the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
and the plot [Eretz Yisrael] planted by Your right hand. And [remember that] over the son [i.e., over Esav, who was a beloved son to his father Isaac], You granted dominance [to the vine of Jacob (viz. Genesis 40:13)].


###### Psalms 80:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:17)


שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָאֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִגַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And that vine is now] burnt in fire [and] cut off, going lost in the rebuke of Your countenance.


###### Psalms 80:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:18)


תְּֽהִי־יָ֭דְךָ עַל־אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑ךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, upon the son of a man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand [(upon Esav, slated for vengeance with Your right hand)], [and] upon the son of man whom You granted dominance [(Jacob) to establish his habitation in the fat of the land].


###### Psalms 80:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:19)


וְלֹא־נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗נוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So shall we not turn back from Thee: revive us and we will call upon Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And do not [cause us] to turn back from You. Give us life [(from the exile)], and [then] we will call upon Your name.


###### Psalms 80:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/80:20)


יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נוּ הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעָה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Restore us, O Lord God of hosts, cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, G d of hosts, return us; illumine Your face and we will be saved. [Here: "L rd, G d of hosts"; verse 8: "G d of hosts"; verse 4: "G d" (each exile being more severe than the preceding one)]



## Chapter 81

###### Psalms 81:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֬ית לְאָסָֽף׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician upon the Gittit, Of Asaf.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, on the gitith [a type of instrument], [a psalm] of Asaf.


###### Psalms 81:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:2)


הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Sing aloud to God our strength: make a joyful noise to the God of Ya῾aqov.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Sing to the G d of our strength; blow [the shofar on Rosh Hashanah] to the G d of Jacob.


###### Psalms 81:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:3)


שְֽׂאוּ־זִ֭מְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹ֑ף כִּנּ֖וֹר נָעִ֣ים עִם־נָֽבֶל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Raise a song, sound the timbrel, the sweet lyre, with the harp.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Lift [your voices in] song, and sound the timbrel, the sweet lyre and the harp.


###### Psalms 81:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:4)


תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝כֵּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blow a shofar at the new moon, at the full moon on our feast day.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Blow the shofar in the renewal [of the moon], at the appointed time for the day of our festival [Rosh Hashanah].


###### Psalms 81:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:5)


כִּ֤י חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For this is a statute for Yisra᾽el, an ordinance of the God of Ya῾aqov.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For it [the blowing of the shofar on Rosh Hashanah] is a statute unto Israel, [a day of] judgment for the G d of Jacob.


###### Psalms 81:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:6)


עֵד֤וּת**׀** בִּיה֘וֹסֵ֤ף שָׂמ֗וֹ בְּ֭צֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׂפַ֖ת לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶשְׁמָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This he ordained in Yosef for testimony, when he went out over the land of Miżrayim. I heard the language of him whom I had not known, saying,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Testimony [(to Rosh Hashanah)] in Yehosef He placed, when he went forth [from prison to rule] over the land of Egypt [(Joseph being released from prison on Rosh Hashanah)]. [Joseph says:] A language I did not know I will [now] understand [(the angel Gabriel teaching him seventy tongues)].


###### Psalms 81:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:7)


הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי מִסֵּ֣בֶל שִׁכְמ֑וֹ כַּ֝פָּ֗יו מִדּ֥וּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands are freed from the basket.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[G d says:] I removed his shoulder from toil; his hands are freed from the [(Egyptian slave labor of the)] cauldron [i.e., cooking].


###### Psalms 81:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:8)


בַּצָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָאֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְךָ בְּסֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחׇנְךָ֨ עַל־מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou didst call in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meriva. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In affliction you [Israel] called, and I rescued you. I answered you [though you called] secretly, in thunder, [(openly manifesting My might)], [though] it was clear to Me [(that you would rebel against Me] at the waters of Merivah, Selah.


###### Psalms 81:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:9)


שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּי וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־תִּֽשְׁמַֽע־לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear, O my people, and I will testify against thee: O Yisra᾽el, if thou wilt hearken to me:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(Having done all this for you, it is fitting that you)] hearken unto Me, My people, and I shall exhort you. [(You are my people)] Israel, if you hearken unto Me.


###### Psalms 81:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:10)


לֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְלֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
there shall be no strange god among thee; nor shalt thou worship any foreign deity.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let there by no strange god unto you, and do not bow down to a foreign god.


###### Psalms 81:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:11)


אָֽנֹכִ֨י**׀** יְ֘הֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ הַֽ֭מַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב־פִּ֝֗יךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵֽהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Miżrayim: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I am the L rd your G d who brought you up from the land of Egypt; open wide your mouth [i.e., ask whatever you like], and I shall fill it.


###### Psalms 81:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/81:12)


וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣י לְקוֹלִ֑י וְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא־אָ֥בָה לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Yisra᾽el would none of me.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My soul desires and longs for the [(destroyed)] courts of the L rd. My heart and flesh sing [i.e., pray for their restoration] to the living G d.


###### Psalms 84:4

Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young. Thy altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God –

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/84:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/84:5)


אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּךָ סֶּֽלָה׃

happy are they who dwell in Thy house: they are ever praising thee. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Happy those who [will yet] dwell in Your house [and] who will praise You again, forever.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are Thy highways,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Happy the man whose strength is in You, who [contemplates the straightening of his] ways in his heart.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who, passing through the valley of Bakha, turn in into a waterspring; moreover, the early rain covers it with blessings.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They go from strength to strength, every one of them appears before God in Żiyyon.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They [("who dwell in Your house, etc.")] will go from strength to strength [(from the study hall to the house of prayer) and] they will appear before G d in Zion.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Ya῾aqov. (Sela.)

מָ֭גִנֵּנוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Behold, O God, our shield, and look upon the face of Thy anointed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Our shield [i.e., the Temple], see [and remember], O G d, and regard the countenance of Your anointed one [(David, i.e., give heart to his efforts towards the building of the Temple)].

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/84:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/84:11)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be at the threshold in the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For better a day in Your courts [(and death the next day)] than [living] a thousand [years elsewhere]. I have chosen to sit on the threshold of the house of my G d rather than dwell [in luxury] in the tents of the wicked.


###### Psalms 84:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/84:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/84:12)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and honour: no good thing will he withhold from those who walk uprightly.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For sun and shield is the L rd G d. The L rd will grant grace and glory. He will not withhold good from those who walk in innocence.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord of hosts, happy is the man who trusts in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd of hosts, happy is the man who trusts in You!

To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of the sons of Korach, a psalm.

Righteousness shall go before him, and walk in the way of his steps.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 86:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:9)


כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֤ם**׀** אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ**׀** וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִ֖יכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; and shall glorify Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All the nations that You made will come and bow down before You, O L rd, and they will give honor to Your name.


###### Psalms 86:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:10)


כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You are great and perform wonders, You, G d, alone. [(Heaven and earth were created before the angels were created, wherefore the nations will honor Your name alone (as the Creator, and not theirs)].


###### Psalms 86:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:11)


ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Teach me Thy way, O Lord; I will walk in Thy truth: make my heart single to fear Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Teach me, O L rd, Your ways, so that I may walk in Your truth. Make my heart one, in fear of Your name.


###### Psalms 86:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:12)


אוֹדְךָ֤**׀** אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכׇל־לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify Thy name for evermore.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall thank You, O L rd my G d, with all of my heart, and I shall extol Your name forever.


###### Psalms 86:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:13)


כִּֽי־חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּד֣וֹל עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For great is Thy steadfast love towards me: and Thou hast delivered my soul from the depths of She᾽ol.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For Your lovingkindness is great upon me, and You have rescued my soul from the nether sheol [(whither adulterers are relegated) by removing my transgression [with Bathsheva, viz. II Samuel 12:13].


###### Psalms 86:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:14)


אֱלֹהִ֤ים**׀** זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָמוּ־עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assembly of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set Thee before them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, evil-doers have arisen against me, and the assembly of the arrogant have sought my soul and not placed You [i.e., Your fear] before their faces.


###### Psalms 86:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:15)


וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל־רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and bountiful in love and truth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And You, O L rd, are a merciful and gracious G d, withholding wrath and profuse in lovingkindness and in truth.


###### Psalms 86:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:16)


פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחׇ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O turn to me, and have mercy upon me; give Thy strength to Thy servant, and save the son of Thy handmaid.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Turn to me and be gracious unto me; give Your strength to Your servant and save the son of Your maidservant [(who humbles himself even more than a bought servant)].


###### Psalms 86:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/86:17)


עֲשֵֽׂה־עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Show me a sign for good; that they who hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because Thou, Lord, hast helped me, and comforted me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Set up for me a sign of good, and let my foes see it and be abashed; for You, O L rd, have [ever] helped me and consoled me.



## Chapter 87

###### Psalms 87:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/87:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/87:1)

A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ, A Poem. His foundation is in the holy mountains.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Of the sons of Korach, a psalm, a song founded on the holy mountains [Zion and Jerusalem].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord loves the gates of Żiyyon more than all the dwellings of Ya῾aqov.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd loves the gates of Zion more than all the habitations of Jacob.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Glories were spoken of you [by G d, Jerusalem] — [that] you are the city of G d forever.

I will make mention of Rahav and Bavel to those who know me: behold Peleshet, and Żor, with Kush, saying, Such a man was born there.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

The Lord shall record, when he registers the peoples, that this man was born there. (Sela.)

In time to come, [when] the L rd inscribes the [idolatrous] peoples [for destruction], He will count [the Jews swallowed up amongst them, and, taking them from their midst, will say:] "This one was born there." [viz. Isaiah 66:21]


###### Psalms 87:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/87:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/87:7)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And singers and dancers alike, shall say, All my springs are in Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom Thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from Thy hand.

עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכׇל־מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃

Thy wrath lies hard upon me, and Thou dost overwhelm me with all Thy waves. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Thou hast put away my acquaintances far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination to them: I am shut up, and I cannot come out.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? and Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

###### Psalms 88:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:15)


לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, why dost Thou cast off my soul? why dost Thou hide Thy face from me?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Why, O L rd, do You abandon my soul [to the foe]? [Why do] You conceal Your countenance from me?


###### Psalms 88:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:16)


עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְגֹוֵ֣עַ מִנֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣יךָ אָפֽוּנָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am afflicted and close to death from my youth up. I suffer Thy terrors, I am numb.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I am afflicted and expiring in suffocation; Your fright has been resident [within me].


###### Psalms 88:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:17)


עָ֭לַי עָבְר֣וּ חֲרוֹנֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝עוּתֶ֗יךָ צִמְּתוּתֻֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy fierce wrath goes over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your ire has passed over me; Your terrors have cut me off.


###### Psalms 88:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:18)


סַבּ֣וּנִי כַ֭מַּיִם כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣י יָֽחַד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They come round about me daily like water; they compass me about together.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They encircle me like water all of the day; they encompass me together.


###### Psalms 88:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/88:19)


הִרְחַ֣קְתָּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי אֹהֵ֣ב וָרֵ֑עַ מְֽיֻדָּעַ֥י מַחְשָֽׁךְ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, my acquaintances are in darkness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have removed from me lover and friend; my companions have darkened [i.e., they have faded from me].



## Chapter 89

###### Psalms 89:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:1)


מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Maskil of Etan the Ezraĥite.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A maskil of Eitan the Ezrachite.


###### Psalms 89:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:2)


חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הֹוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר**׀** אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord for ever: with my mouth I will make known Thy faithfulness to all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall eternally sing the lovingkindnesses of the L rd. Through all the generations I shall make known Your faithfulness [(to Your word)] with my mouth.


###### Psalms 89:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:3)


כִּֽי־אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם**׀** תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I have said, The world is built by love: Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness in the very heavens.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For I said: Forever will [the throne of David] be built up [with] lovingkindness [viz. II Samuel 7:13]. Your faithfulness will be as firmly established as the heavens.


###### Psalms 89:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:4)


כָּרַ֣תִּי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn to David my servant,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(And this is the lovingkindness:)] I have made a covenant for My chosen one; I have sworn to David, My servant.


###### Psalms 89:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:5)


עַד־ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר־וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall establish your children [(for kingdom)] forever. I have built up your throne for all generations, forever.


###### Psalms 89:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:6)


וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה אַף־אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the heavens shall praise Thy wonders, O Lord: Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [(in keeping Your word)], the heavens will acknowledge Your wonder, O L rd], also Your faithfulness [i.e., the faithfulness of Your words] in the congregation of the holy ones [(Israel)].


###### Psalms 89:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:7)


כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהֹוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהֹוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the Lord?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For who in the heavens can be compared to the L rd, can be likened to the L rd among the sons of the mighty?


###### Psalms 89:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:8)


אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־כׇּל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, and had in reverence by all those round about him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He is a mighty G d in the great council of the holy ones [(the angels)] and fearful over all who surround Him.


###### Psalms 89:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:9)


יְהֹוָ֤ה**׀** אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִי־כָמ֖וֹךָֽ חֲסִ֥ין׀יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord God of hosts, O Lord, who is strong like Thee? and Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, G d of hosts, who is like You? [You,] the L rd, are mighty, and Your faithfulness encompasses You.


###### Psalms 89:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:10)


אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof rise up, Thou stillest them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You rule over the pride of the sea. When its waves are uplifted, You lower them.


###### Psalms 89:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:11)


אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast trodden down Rahav like carrion; Thou hast scattered Thy enemies with Thy strong arm.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You broke the Egyptians as the slain [are broken]. With the arm of Your might You scattered Your foes.


###### Psalms 89:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:12)


לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף־לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The skies are Thine, the earth also is Thine: the world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Yours are the heavens. Yours, too, is the earth. The world and all that fills it — You founded them.


###### Psalms 89:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:13)


צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The north and the south, Thou hast created them: Tavor and Ḥermon shall rejoice in Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
North and south, You created them. Tavor and Chermon shall sing in Your name.


###### Psalms 89:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:14)


לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is Thy hand, and high is Thy right hand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your arm [is stretched out] with strength. You strengthen Your hand; You lift up Your right hand.


###### Psalms 89:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:15)


צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne: love and truth shall go before Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[Not strength, however, but] righteousness and justice is the foundation of Your throne. Lovingkindness and truth will precede Your countenance [in the governance of the world].


###### Psalms 89:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:16)


אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר־פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy is the people that know the joyful note: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of Thy countenance.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Happy are the people who know teruah [(the shofar blast) i.e., who know how to conciliate their Creator on Rosh Hashanah with teruah, the matrix of malchuyoth (Dominion), zichronoth (Remembrance) and shofaroth].


###### Psalms 89:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:17)


בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In Thy name they rejoice all the day: and in Thy righteousness they are exalted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In [the salvation of] Your name they will rejoice all the day, and in Your righteousness they will be uplifted.


###### Psalms 89:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:18)


כִּי־תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצוֹנְךָ֗ (תרים) [תָּר֥וּם] קַרְנֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou art the glory of their strength: and in Thy favour our horn shall be exalted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You are the glory of their strength, and in Your conciliation our horn will be exalted.


###### Psalms 89:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:19)


כִּ֣י לַ֭יהֹוָה מָגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For our shield belongs to the Lord; and our king to the Holy One of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For [our estate was thus elevated] when our shields [i.e., our kings] were the L rd's [i.e., G d fearing] and our kings [were dedicated] to the G d of Israel.


###### Psalms 89:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:20)


אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ־בְחָז֡וֹן לַחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל־גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then Thou didst speak in vision to Thy pious one, and didst say, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; have exalted one chosen out of the people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then You spoke in a vision to Your saintly ones [(Nathan the prophet and Gad the seer)], and You said: I have placed saving [(to abet him always)] upon the strong one [David]; I have elevated the select one from among the people.


###### Psalms 89:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:21)


מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קׇדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have found David, My servant; I have anointed him with My holy oil.


###### Psalms 89:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:22)


אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
with whom my hand shall be established: my arm also shall strengthen him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My hand will be established with him [to aid him]; My arm, too, shall strengthen him.


###### Psalms 89:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:23)


לֹא־יַשִּׁ֣יא אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The foe will not [strengthen itself over him to] be as a creditor to him, and a doer of wrong will not afflict him.


###### Psalms 89:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:24)


וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I will beat down his foes before his face, and strike down those who hate him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I shall cut off his oppressors from his face and I shall send a plague upon his foes.


###### Psalms 89:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:25)


וֶ֥אֱֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But my faithfulness and my steadfast love shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My faith and lovingkindness shall be [forever] with him, and through My name his horn shall be exalted.


###### Psalms 89:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:26)


וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall place his hand [i.e., rule] over the seas, and his right hand over the rivers.


###### Psalms 89:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:27)


ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He shall cry to me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He shall call me: "You are my Father, my G d and the rock of my salvation."


###### Psalms 89:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:28)


אַף־אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Also I will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I, likewise, shall grant him greatness, [making him] supreme above the kings of the earth.


###### Psalms 89:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:29)


לְ֭עוֹלָם (אשמור) [אֶשְׁמׇר־]ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will keep my truth with him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

I shall observe My lovingkindness with him forever and My covenant shall be faithful to him.

His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne like the days of heaven.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

then I will punish their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with strokes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
then I shall remove [their kingdom] through the rod [of chastisement] for their offenses, and through plagues for their transgressions [viz. II Samuel 7:14].

Nevertheless I will not utterly take my steadfast love from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

One [(unique)] oath have I sworn in My holiness. Forefend that I lie to David!

His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne shall be like the sun before me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

What man is he that lives, and shall not see death, but shall deliver his soul from the power of She᾽ol? (Sela.)

Lord, where are Thy former oaths of steadfast love which Thou didst make to David in Thy faithfulness?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/89:51)

Remember, Lord, the disgrace of Thy servants: how I bear in my bosom the insults of all the many peoples,

wherewith Thy enemies have insulted, O Lord; wherewith they have insulted the footsteps of Thy anointed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

## Chapter 90

###### Psalms 90:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:1)


תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֢ה אִֽישׁ־הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Prayer of Moshe the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A prayer of Moses, the man [i.e., the prophet] of G d. O L rd, You were an abode [(i.e., a shelter)] to us throughout the generations.


###### Psalms 90:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:2)


בְּטֶ֤רֶם**׀** הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד־ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Before the mountains were brought forth, and before ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Before the mountains were born and the earth and the world were formed, and from [the first] world until [the last] world, You are the Almighty.


###### Psalms 90:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:3)


תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵֽי־אָדָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou turnest man back to dust; and sayst, Return, you children of men.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You turn a man to the crushing point [with afflictions], saying: "Repent, sons of man!"


###### Psalms 90:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:4)


כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For a thousand years in Thy sight are but like yesterday when it is past, and like a watch in the night.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For a thousand years [(a man's life span at the creation)] in Your eyes are as yesterday's day which has [already passed], and [i.e., in addition to] a watch in the night.


###### Psalms 90:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:5)


זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou engulfest them; they are like sleepers; they are like the short lived grass in the morning.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Their flooding [i.e., the "snatching away" of those thousand years of a man's life and condensing them to seventy [(see verse 10)] are like a sleep [(The seventy years of the Babylonian exile are like a sleep [viz. Psalms 126:1)]. [One who is born at night] passes away like the grass [at the end of his "dream"].


###### Psalms 90:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:6)


בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In the morning it flourishes, and fades; by evening it is withered and dry.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And if] in the morning he blossoms, he [immediately] passes away; in the evening he withers and dries up.


###### Psalms 90:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:7)


כִּי־כָלִ֥ינוּ בְאַפֶּ֑ךָ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For we are consumed by Thy anger, and by Thy wrath are we terrified.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[And with all this,] we have been consumed in Your wrath and confounded in Your ire.


###### Psalms 90:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:8)


שַׁתָּ֣ עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have placed our transgressions before You [for retribution], [the sins of] our youth before the ["searching"] light of Your countenance.


###### Psalms 90:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:9)


כִּ֣י כׇל־יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶֽגֶה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath: we spend our years like a tale that is told.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For all of our days have passed in Your wrath. We have consumed our years as a [fleeting] utterance.


###### Psalms 90:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:10)


יְמֵֽי־שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת**׀** שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רׇהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי־גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The days of our years are seventy; or if by reason of special strength, eighty years; yet their pride is but trouble and wretchedness; it is soon cut off, and we fly away.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The days of our years [(in our transgressions and in the sins of our youth)] are seventy years, and (if) with increase, eighty years. And all of their "pride" is toil and vanity, for they quickly pass and we are fled [(in the midst of the wrath)].


###### Psalms 90:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:11)


מִֽי־י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּ֝כְיִרְאָתְךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Who knows the power of Thy anger? even according to Thy fear, so is Thy wrath.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[In these "few days,"] who can [acquire a heart to] know the strength of Your might [and fear You accordingly]? And [You,] as You are fearful, [so is the intensity of] Your wrath!


###### Psalms 90:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:12)


לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵינוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חׇכְמָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So teach us to number our days, that we may get a heart of wisdom.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[As in the beginning, so now,] apprise [us of the increase of] the number of our days, so that we may bring [to our days] a heart of wisdom.


###### Psalms 90:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:13)


שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה עַד־מָתָ֑י וְ֝הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל־עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Return, O Lord, how long? and relent concerning Thy servants.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Turn, O L rd [from Your wrath]. How long [will You rage]? And repent Yourself [to think favorably] of Your servants.


###### Psalms 90:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:14)


שַׂבְּעֵ֣נוּ בַבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וּֽנְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּכׇל־יָמֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O satisfy us in the morning with Thy steadfast love; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Sate us in the "morning" [of the redemption] with Your lovingkindness, and we will sing [Your praises] and rejoice in all [of the afflictions that we suffered in] our [dark] days.


###### Psalms 90:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:15)


שַׂ֭מְּחֵנוּ כִּימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, and the years in which we have seen evil.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Cause us to rejoice [(in the days of the Messiah)] as [the number of] the days of our affliction, as [the number of] years in which we saw evil.


###### Psalms 90:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:16)


יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ פׇעֳלֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲדָרְךָ֗ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let Thy work appear to Thy servants, and Thy glory to their children.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
May Your acts [of redemption] be witnessed by Your servants, and [let] Your glory [repose] upon their children.


###### Psalms 90:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/90:17)


וִיהִ֤י**׀** נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗ינוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽהוּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish the work of our hands upon us; O prosper it, the work of our hands.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And may the pleasantness of the L rd our G d [(His shechinah and His consolations)] be upon us. And establish the work of our hands [(the tabernacle)] upon us [(that the shechinah reside therein)], and the work of our hands [(in our daily lives)] establish it [(that blessing repose upon it)].

that he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

## Chapter 101
