I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of those who turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall not set before my eyes the work of the faithless one. I have hated the working of perversity; it shall not cleave unto me.


###### Psalms 101:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:4)


לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil matter.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The perverse heart shall depart from me; I shall not know evil.


###### Psalms 101:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:5)


(מלושני) [מְלׇשְׁנִ֬י] בַסֵּ֨תֶר**׀** רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֢וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Whoever secretly slanders his neighbour, him I will cut off: him that has a high look and a proud heart I will not suffer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He who slanders his friend in secret, him shall I cut off. The haughty of eye and the broad of heart [i.e., the lustful one], him shall I not endure [(as a friend, so that I not learn from his ways)].


###### Psalms 101:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:6)


עֵינַ֤י**׀** בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֢בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walks in the way of integrity, he shall serve me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My eyes are upon the faithful of the land, to sit with me. He who walks in the way of purity, he shall serve me.


###### Psalms 101:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:7)


לֹֽא־יֵשֵׁ֨ב**׀** בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֢ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹא־יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He that works deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that tells lies shall not remain in my sight.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The worker of deceit shall not sit in the midst of my house. The speaker of lies shall not be suffered before my eyes.


###### Psalms 101:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/101:8)


לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כׇּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵעִיר־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In the mornings [i.e., day by day] I shall cut off all the wicked of the land [(the wicked of Israel who are liable to the death penalty)], to cut off from the city of the L rd all workers of iniquity.



## Chapter 102

###### Psalms 102:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:1)


תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Prayer of the afflicted, when he faints, and pours out his complaint before the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A prayer for the poor one [(Israel in exile)], enwrapped [in woe], and before the L rd pouring out his plaint.


###### Psalms 102:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:2)


יְ֭הֹוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry reach Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, hear my prayer, and let my outcry come to You.


###### Psalms 102:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:3)


אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ**׀** מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֢וֹם צַ֫ר־לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אׇזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hide not Thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline Thy ear to me: in the day when I call, answer me speedily.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not conceal Your face from me. On the day of my distress incline Your ear to me. Quickly, answer me.


###### Psalms 102:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:4)


כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹקֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned like a hearth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For my [happy] days have ended as with smoke, and my bones are dried up as the hearth.


###### Psalms 102:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:5)


הוּכָּה־כָעֵ֣שֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; so that I forget how to eat my bread.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Smitten as the grass and dried up is my heart, for I have forgotten [in my affliction] to eat my bread.


###### Psalms 102:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:6)


מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my skin.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
With the sound of my sighing, my bones have cleaved to my flesh.


###### Psalms 102:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:7)


דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am like an owl of the wilderness: I am like a night flier of the desert.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(In banishment to exile)] I have become like the k'ath [(a wailing bird)] of the desert; I have become like the koss [a bird] of the wasteland.


###### Psalms 102:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:8)


שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I watch, and am like a lonely sparrow upon the house top.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have contemplated myself; I have become like a lone bird on a roof.


###### Psalms 102:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:9)


כׇּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My enemies insult me all the day; and they that are mad against me swear by me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My foes have shamed me all the day; my mockers have sworn by me [(as a byword for affliction)].


###### Psalms 102:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:10)


כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For I have eaten dust as bread, and I have mixed my drink with tears.


###### Psalms 102:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:11)


מִפְּנֵֽי־זַעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
because of Thy indignation and Thy wrath: for Thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Because of Your scorn and Your wrath; for You lifted me [to the heavens] and You cast me down [to the earth].


###### Psalms 102:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:12)


יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My days are like an evening shadow; and I am withered like grass.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My days are like a lengthening [and disappearing] shadow, and I am withered as the grass.


###### Psalms 102:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:13)


וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But Thou, O Lord, sittest enthroned forever; and Thy name endures to all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But You, O L rd, who endure forever, and Your remembrance for all generations, [(and who swore by Yourself to preserve us)] —


###### Psalms 102:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:14)


אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Żiyyon: for it is time to favour her; for the set time is come.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Rise! Have pity upon Zion. For it is time to grace it; for the season has arrived [viz. Deuteronomy 32:36].


###### Psalms 102:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:15)


כִּי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thy servants hold her stones dear, and cherish her very dust.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For Your servants have desired [(even)] her stones, and her dust has found favor with them.


###### Psalms 102:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:16)


וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽכׇל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then, [(when You save Your people)] the nations will fear the name of the L rd, and all the kings of the earth, Your glory.


###### Psalms 102:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:17)


כִּי־בָנָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For the Lord builds up Żiyyon, he appears in his glory.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When [they see that] the L rd has built Zion [and] appeared [there] in His glory.


###### Psalms 102:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:18)


פָּ֭נָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹא־בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He heeds the prayer of the destitute, and does not despise their prayer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He has turned to the prayer of the crier [i.e., he who has cried out], and He did not despise their prayer.


###### Psalms 102:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:19)


תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־יָֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
This shall be written for the generation to come: so that a people yet unborn shall praise the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(Thus will say the seers of the salvation:)] Let this [salvation] be inscribed for the last generation, and let the [newly] created people [(those who have emerged from darkness to light)] praise the L rd.


###### Psalms 102:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:20)


כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם**׀** אֶל־אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For He has looked from the heights of His holiness; the L rd has looked down from heaven to earth [(to see the affliction of His people)].


###### Psalms 102:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:21)


לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
to hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those who are appointed to death;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To hear the groans of the bound; to undo the bonds of [His] dying sons.


###### Psalms 102:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:22)


לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
that men may declare the name of Lord in Żiyyon, and his praise in Yerushalayim;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
So that the name of the L rd be told in Zion, and His praise in Jerusalem.


###### Psalms 102:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:23)


בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
when the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When peoples gather together, and kingdoms to serve the L rd.


###### Psalms 102:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:24)


עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ (כחו) [כֹּחִ֗י] קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(reversion to verse 11)] He [the foe] has straitened my strength in the way [i.e., in exile]; he has shortened my days.


###### Psalms 102:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:25)


אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I say, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thou whose years endure to all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I say [to the L rd: You are] my G d. Do not remove me [from the world] in the half of my days, [(our "days" being)] all the generations of Your years [(see verse 13 and verse 39)].


###### Psalms 102:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:26)


לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of old Thou hast laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of Thy hands.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You founded the earth of yore; the heavens are the work of Your hands.


###### Psalms 102:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:27)


הֵ֤מָּה**׀** יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֢ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall grow old like a garment; Thou shalt change them like a cloak, and they will pass away:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They [(heaven and earth)] will go lost and You shall remain. They will all rot as a garment. You will change them as [one changes his] clothing, and they will be changed.


###### Psalms 102:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:28)


וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
but Thou art the same, and Thy years shall have no end.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
But You are He [(who endures always)], and Your years will never end.


###### Psalms 102:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/102:29)


בְּנֵֽי־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The children of Thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The sons of Your servants [(the patriarchs)] will dwell [in the land]; and their seed will be [eternally] established before You.



## Chapter 103

###### Psalms 103:1

לְדָוִ֨ד**׀** בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְכׇל־קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me bless his holy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[A psalm] of David. Bless the L rd, my soul, and all my innards, the name of His holiness.


###### Psalms 103:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:2)


בָּרְכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאַל־תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כׇּל־גְּמוּלָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Bless the L rd, my soul, and do not forget all of His lovingkindnesses.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who forgives all thy iniquities; who heals all thy diseases;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He forgives all of your sins; he heals all of your ills.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who redeems thy life from the pit; who encircles thee with love and compassion;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He redeems your life from the pit; He crowns you with lovingkindness and mercy.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who satisfies thy old age with good; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord executes righteousness, and judgment for all that are oppressed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd works righteousness and judgment for all who are ravaged.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He made known his ways to Moshe, his acts to the children of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He makes known His ways to Moses; His deeds, to the children of Israel.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in steadfast love.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Merciful and gracious is the L rd, withholding wrath and abundant in lovingkindness.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:9)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Not eternally shall He quarrel; not forever shall He bear a grudge.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:10)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor repaid us according to our iniquities.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Not as our sins did He do unto us; not as our transgressions did He recompense us.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:11)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his steadfast love towards those who fear him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For as the height of heaven over earth, so did His lovingkindness exalt itself over those who fear Him.


###### Psalms 103:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:12)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As east is distant from west, so did He distance our offenses from us.


###### Psalms 103:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:13)


כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל־בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עַל־יְרֵאָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As a father pities his children, so the Lord pities those who fear him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
As a father is merciful to his son, so is the L rd merciful to those who fear Him.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:14)


כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:15)

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and its place knows it no more.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

But the steadfast love of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:18)

to such as keep his covenant, and to those who remember his commandments to do them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

The Lord has established his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom rules over all.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

בָּרְכ֥וּ יְהֹוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Bless the Lord, you angels of his, you mighty ones who perform his bidding, hearkening to the voice of his word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Bless the L rd, His angels, mighty of power, doing His word, heeding the voice of His word.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Bless the Lord, all his hosts; you ministers of his, who do his pleasure.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Bless the L rd all of His hosts, His ministers, the doers of His will.


###### Psalms 103:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/103:22)

Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion. Bless the Lord, O my soul!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 104:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:2)


עֹֽטֶה־א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:3)


הַ֥מְקָרֶ֥ה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

who lays the beams of his chambers in the waters: who makes the clouds his chariot: who walks upon the wings of the wind:

עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who makes the winds his messengers; the flames of fire his ministers:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He makes winds His messengers; a burning fire, His ministers.


###### Psalms 104:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:5)


יָֽסַד־אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:6)


תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־הָ֝רִ֗ים יַ֖עַמְדוּ־מָֽיִם׃

At Thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of Thy thunder they hastened away;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה**׀** יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
they went up the mountains; they flowed down the valleys to the place which Thou didst found for them.

###### Psalms 104:10

הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

###### Psalms 104:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/104:11)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

saying, To thee I will give the land of Kena῾an, the lot of your inheritance:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Saying [(this being the covenant)]: To you shall I give the land of Canaan, the portion of your inheritance.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 106

###### Psalms 106:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/106:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/106:1)


הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ**׀** הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Haleluya; O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hallelukah! Give thanks to the L rd, for He is good; for His lovingkindness endures forever.


###### Psalms 106:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/106:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/106:2)


מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כׇּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can declare all his praise?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Who can relate the mighty acts of the L rd; [Who can] make heard all of His praise?


###### Psalms 106:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/106:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/106:3)


אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכׇל־עֵֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy are they who maintain justice, and do righteousness at all times.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He speaks and raises up a tempest, and it lifts its waves.


###### Psalms 107:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:26)


׆יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They mount up to the sky, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted away because of trouble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They [the mariners] ascend to the skies; they descend to the depths. Their souls melt with ill.


###### Psalms 107:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:27)


׆יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכׇל־חׇ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They break and sway as a drunkard, all of their wisdom swallowed up.


###### Psalms 107:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:28)


׆וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצ֥וּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then they cry to the Lord in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distresses.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They cry out to the L rd in their affliction, and He rescues them from their toils.


###### Psalms 107:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:29)


יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He sets back the tempest to silence, and their waves are stilled.


###### Psalms 107:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:30)


וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then are they glad because they are quiet; and he brings them to their desired haven.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they [the mariners] rejoice when they [the waves] are silenced, and He leads them to the bound of their desires.


###### Psalms 107:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:31)


יוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They shall thank the L rd for His lovingkindness and [relate] His wonders to the sons of men.


###### Psalms 107:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:32)


וִֽ֭ירוֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they shall exalt Him in a congregation of people [(a quorum of ten)] and praise Him in the seat of the elders [i.e., two of the ten must be Torah scholars.]


###### Psalms 107:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:33)


יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He turns rivers into a wilderness, and watersprings into dry ground;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He renders rivers [i.e., the settlements of the idolators] wasteland, and water sources, parchedness.


###### Psalms 107:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:34)


אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
a fruitful land into barrenness, because of wickedness of those who dwell therein.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A fruitful land, salt-land — from the evil of the inhabitants therein.


###### Psalms 107:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:35)


יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He turned the wilderness into a pool of water, and dry ground into watersprings.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He renders the wasteland a pool of water [i.e., He restores it]; dry land, water sources.


###### Psalms 107:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:36)


וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And there he makes the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city for habitation;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And He settles famished ones there, and they establish [it as] a settled city.


###### Psalms 107:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:37)


וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבוּאָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they sow fields and they plant vineyards, and they [the vineyards and fields, respectively,] give forth fruit and produce.


###### Psalms 107:38

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:38](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:38)


וַיְבָרְכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and does not let their cattle decrease.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And He blesses them, and they multiply greatly, and their kine do not dwindle.


###### Psalms 107:39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:39)


וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When they are diminished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
(And they [in the beginning] were reduced and bowed down in the constriction of trouble and sorrow.)


###### Psalms 107:40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:40)


׆שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
he pours contempt upon nobles, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He spills shame upon the stately and leads them in a void which is not a way.


###### Psalms 107:41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:41)


וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
yet he sets the poor on high from affliction, and makes his families like a flock.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And He lifts the pauper from poverty and he [the pauper] makes [his] families like flocks [in abundance].


###### Psalms 107:42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:42)


יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכׇל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The just will see [this] and rejoice, and all [men of] wrong will close their mouths.


###### Psalms 107:43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/107:43)


מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמׇר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Whoever is wise, let them consider these things, and let them observe the loving acts of the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
To him who is wise and takes heed of this, the lovingkindnesses of the L rd will be manifest [(to their understanding)].



## Chapter 108

###### Psalms 108:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:1)


שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Poem, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A song, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 108:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:2)


נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My heart is firm, O God; I will sing, I will give praise; my glory likewise.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My heart is steadfast [with You], O G d; I shall sing and make song — my soul, too.


###### Psalms 108:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:3)


ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Awake the harp and the lyre: I will awaken the dawn.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Awake [me] O psaltery and harp — I shall awake the dawn [(unlike other kings, whom the dawn awakes)].


###### Psalms 108:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:4)


אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים׀יְהֹוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲזַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּלְאֻמִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will praise Thee, O Lord, among the peoples: and I will sing praises to Thee among the nations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall praise You among the peoples, O L rd; I shall sing to You among the peoples.


###### Psalms 108:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:5)


כִּי־גָד֣וֹל מֵעַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד־שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thy steadfast love is great above the heavens: and Thy truth reaches the clouds.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For great above the heavens is Your lovingkindness [(for those who serve for the sake of Heaven)]; Your truth reaches unto the skies.


###### Psalms 108:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:6)


ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and Thy glory above all the earth;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Exalt Yourself over the heavens, O G d; [repose] over all the earth Your glory.


###### Psalms 108:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:7)


לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
that Thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with Thy right hand, and answer me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
So that Your loved ones be rescued. Save [them] with Your right hand, and answer me [(for Your people and all of Your loved are dependent upon me)].


###### Psalms 108:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:8)


אֱלֹהִ֤ים**׀** דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקׇדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shekhem, and measure out the valley of Sukkot.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d spoke [through the prophets] in His holy spirit [that] I would [reign and] rejoice [in His word], [that] I would apportion lots [(from the land of my foes to Israel)], [that] I would mete out the vale of Succoth.


###### Psalms 108:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:9)


לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד**׀** לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Gil῾ad is mine; Menashshe is mine; Efrayim also is the strength of my head; Yehuda is my sceptre;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Mine is Gilad, and mine is Menasheh; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Yehudah, my lawgiver.


###### Psalms 108:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:10)


מוֹאָ֤ב**׀** סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵי־פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Mo᾽av is my washpot; over Edom will I cast my shoe; over Peleshet I will cry in triumph.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Moav is the basin of my washing [i.e., my handservant]. Upon Plesheth I will cast my shoe [i.e., the service of shodding me]. Over Plesheth I will shout [(to affright them)].


###### Psalms 108:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:11)


מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me to Edom?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Who will lead me [in the days of the Messiah] to the fortified city [(i.e., to assail Esav in his fortified cities)]? He who has [already] led me until Edom [(of whom I smote eighteen thousand in the Valley of Salt)].


###### Psalms 108:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:12)


הֲלֹֽא־אֱלֹהִ֥ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאֹתֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Hast Thou not rejected us, O God? so that Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Was not [our discomfiture in the past due to] Your forsaking us, O G d, Your not going out, O G d, among our hosts?


###### Psalms 108:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:13)


הָבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Give us help against the foe: for vain is the help of man.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Give to us succor from the oppressor; for vain is the salvation of man.


###### Psalms 108:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/108:14)


בֵּאלֹהִ֥ים נַֽעֲשֶׂה־חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is who will tread down our enemies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In G d will we be victorious, and He will tread down our oppressors.



## Chapter 109

###### Psalms 109:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/109:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/109:1)


לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Keep not silent, O God of my praise;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, of David, a psalm. G d of my [(Israel's)] praises; do not be silent.


###### Psalms 109:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/109:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/109:2)


כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the mouth of the evil one [(Yishmael)] and the mouth of [the man of] deceit have opened themselves against me. They have spoken with me with lying tongue.


###### Psalms 109:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/109:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/109:3)


וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For they have compassed me about with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They have surrounded me with words of hatred and have warred against me for naught.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In return for my love they are my accusers; whilst I have nothing but prayer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For my loving [You], they have hated me; yet I [always invoke] prayer [for them].

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they have repaid me evil for good, and hatred for my love, saying:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They have set upon me evil in place of good, and hatred in place of my love.

Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to Thy steadfast love:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

וְֽ֭יֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָ֣דְךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽהּ׃

that they may know that this is Thy hand; that Thou, Lord, hast done it.

Let them curse, but bless Thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let Thy servant rejoice.

Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a robe.

## Chapter 110

###### Psalms 110:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:1)


לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Psalm of David. The Lord says to my master, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thy enemies thy footstool.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Of David, a psalm. The L rd said to "my master" [(Abraham, viz. Genesis 23:6)]: Wait for [the salvation of] My right hand, until I make our foes [(Amrafel and his company)] a footstool for your feet.


###### Psalms 110:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:2)


מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הֹוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord shall send thy mighty sceptre out of Żiyyon: rule in the midst of thy enemies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The staff of your strength will the L rd send from Zion. [(When you return, fatigued, from the battle, the L rd will send you Malkitzedek, king of Shalem [Jerusalem] to bring you bread and wine [viz. Genesis 14:18])]. Rule [(in the war)] in the midst of your foes [i.e., with full assurance]!


###### Psalms 110:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:3)


עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֢וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy people offered themselves willingly in the majesty of their holiness, on the day of thy battle; when still the dew of thy youth was upon thee, fresh from the womb of dawn.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your people [will come] willingly [to join you] on the day of [(gathering)] your army [viz. Genesis 14:24] in [the merit of] the resplendent holiness that [was yours almost from the time of your] falling from the womb. Yours [i.e., unto you] will be [reckoned] the dew [i.e., the just ways] of your youth.


###### Psalms 110:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:4)


נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord has sworn, and will not change his mind, Thou shalt be a priest forever, after the manner of Malki-żedeq.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd has sworn [(Genesis 15:1): "Do not fear, Avram, etc."], and He shall not repent [of the good that He has foretold for you, (Avram fearing punishment because of all those he had killed in the war)]. You are a Cohain forever [i.e., from you will now issue the priesthood and the royalty that had been accorded Sh'chem, by word [(viz. Genesis 14:19-20)] of Malkitzedek [(Sh'chem, viz. Rashi, Genesis 14:18)].


###### Psalms 110:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:5)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is at thy right hand, he crushes kings on the day of his wrath.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd [who was] on your right hand [in the war] crushed [the four] kings on the day of His wrath.


###### Psalms 110:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:6)


יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He judges among the nations: their land is full of dead bodies; he will shatter heads over many countries.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
He will mete out justice to the nations [(Egypt, viz. Genesis 15:14)]. [He will make of them] a heap of corpses [viz. Exodus 14:30]. He crushed the head [of Pharaoh, the head] of a great land [(Egypt, which held all the other lands in its sway [viz. Habakkuk 3:12 and Psalms 102:20])].


###### Psalms 110:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/110:7)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He will drink of the brook in the way: therefore will he lift up the head.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From the river [Nile] on the way [(where Pharaoh walked)] did he drink [(having no need of rain water)] — therefore, he raised his head [(in brazen haughtiness, viz. Ezekiel 29:3)]



## Chapter 111

###### Psalms 111:1

The works of the Lord are great, sought out by all who love them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The acts of the L rd are great, [yet] they may be inquired after by all who desire [to know] them.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Glory and beauty are His work, and His righteousness stands eternally.

He has made a remembrance for His wonders, [for] gracious and merciful is the L rd. **The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The works of his hands are truth and justice; all his commandments are sure.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They stand fast for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/111:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/111:10)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they who do his commandments: his praise endures forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is firm, trusting in the Lord.

אֵ֤ל**׀** יְהֹוָה֮ וַיָּ֢אֶ֫ר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
God is the Lord, who has shown us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, to the horns of the altar.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
G d is the L rd, and He has shown us light. Bind the [unblemished] festive offerings with ropes until [they are brought to] the horns of the altar.


###### Psalms 118:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/118:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/118:28)


אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou art my God, and I will praise Thee: my God, I will exalt Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You are my G d, and I shall thank You. My G d, I shall exalt You!


###### Psalms 118:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/118:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/118:29)


הוֹד֣וּ לַיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Praise the L rd, for He is good. For His lovingkindness is eternal.



## Chapter 119

###### Psalms 119:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:1)


אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ הַ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Tora of the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Fortunate are those who walk the path of uprightness, who walk in the Torah of the L rd.


###### Psalms 119:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:2)


אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכׇל־לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy are they who keep his testimonies and seek him with the whole heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Fortunate are those who abide by His testimonies, who seek them out with a full heart.


###### Psalms 119:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:3)


אַ֭ף לֹא־פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Who, though they committed no wrong [were not content therewith], but [actively] walked in His ways.


###### Psalms 119:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:4)


אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast commanded Thy precepts to be kept diligently.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
It is You who commanded Your precepts. How diligently, then, must they be heeded!


###### Psalms 119:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:5)


אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O that my ways were directed to keep Thy statutes!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My prayers are that my ways be established to heed Your statutes.


###### Psalms 119:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:6)


אָ֥ז לֹא־אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝הַבִּיטִ֗י אֶל־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then should I not be ashamed, when I observe all Thy commandments.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Then I shall not be ashamed [(as a transgressor] when I consider all of Your mitzvoth.


###### Psalms 119:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:7)


א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לׇמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I shall give Thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous judgments.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall [be able to] thank You with uprightness of heart when I learn the ways of Your righteousness.


###### Psalms 119:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:8)


אֶת־חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵ֥נִי עַד־מְאֹֽד׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will keep Thy statutes: O do not forsake me utterly.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall heed Your statutes to the utmost — do not forsake me.


###### Psalms 119:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:9)


בַּמֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה־נַּ֭עַר אֶת־אׇרְח֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Wherewith shall a young man keep his way pure? by guarding it according to Thy word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In what manner shall the youth order his path aright? By heeding [Your commandments] because of Your word [and not because of his own predilection].


###### Psalms 119:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:10)


בְּכׇל־לִבִּ֥י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אַל־תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗נִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
With my whole heart I have sought Thee: O let me not wander from Thy commandments.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have sought You with all my heart. Do not make me stray from [an understanding of] Your mitzvoth.


###### Psalms 119:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:11)


בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have secreted Your word in my heart [(not allowing it to be forgotten)], so that I not sin against You.


###### Psalms 119:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:12)


בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blessed art Thou, O Lord: teach me Thy statutes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You are blessed, O L rd [(in having commanded Your mitzvoth)] — teach me Your statutes.


###### Psalms 119:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:13)


בִּשְׂפָתַ֥י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Thy mouth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[For] with my lips I have told all of the judgments of Your mouth.


###### Psalms 119:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:14)


בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥יךָ שַּׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּעַ֣ל כׇּל־הֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
In the way of Your testimonies I have rejoiced, as over an abundance of treasure.


###### Psalms 119:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:15)


בְּפִקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will meditate in Thy precepts, and observe Thy ways.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall converse in Your commandments and I will probe [(them to the end of walking in)] Your ways.


###### Psalms 119:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:16)


בְּחֻקֹּתֶ֥יךָ אֶֽשְׁתַּעֲשָׁ֑ע לֹ֖א אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will delight myself in Thy statutes: I will not forget Thy word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I make Your statutes my occupation [so that] I not forget Your words.


###### Psalms 119:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:17)


גְּמֹ֖ל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ֥ אֶחְיֶ֗ה וְאֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deal bountifully with Thy servant, that I may live, and keep Thy word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Be gracious to Your servant so that I live and heed Your words.


###### Psalms 119:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:18)


גַּל־עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Open Thou my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy Tora.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Uncover my eyes so that I see hidden things through Your Torah.


###### Psalms 119:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:19)


גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I am a stranger on the earth: do not hide Thy commandments from me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I am a stranger in the land. Do not hide from me [the secrets of] Your mitzvoth.


###### Psalms 119:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:20)


גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י לְתַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל־מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ בְכׇל־עֵֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul is consumed with the longing that it has to Thy judgments at all times.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My soul is broken with longing at all times for Your judgments.


###### Psalms 119:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:21)


גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝שֹּׁגִ֗ים מִמִּצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, who wander from Thy commandments.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You have rebuked the accursed, willful ones, who stray from Your mitzvoth.


###### Psalms 119:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:22)


גַּ֣ל מֵ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Remove insult and contempt from me; for I have kept Thy testimonies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Remove from me shame and contempt, for I have abided by Your testimonies.


###### Psalms 119:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:23)


גַּ֤ם יָשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Princes also did sit and speak against me: but Thy servant did meditate on Thy statutes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Though princes [i.e., the kings of the nations] have sat down to mock me [(for studying Torah)], Your servant will [continue to] converse in Your statutes.


###### Psalms 119:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:24)


גַּֽם־עֵ֭דֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy testimonies also are my delight; they are my counsellors.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Your testimonies, too, are my constant occupation. [They are as] my privy counselors.


###### Psalms 119:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:25)


דָּבְקָ֣ה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשִׁ֑י חַ֝יֵּ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul cleaves to the dust: revive me according to Thy word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When my soul is pressed to the dust, grant me life according to Your word [(to Nathan the prophet, viz. II Samuel 7:12)].


###### Psalms 119:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:26)


דְּרָכַ֣י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֗נִי לַמְּדֵ֥נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have declared my ways, and Thou didst hear me: teach me Thy statutes.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I told you of my ways [(my needs and my sins)], and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.


###### Psalms 119:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:27)


דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ הֲבִינֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts: so I shall talk of Thy wondrous works.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Make me understand the ways [i.e., the mysteries of Your commandments], and I will converse in their hidden wonders [with others].


###### Psalms 119:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:28)


דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִתּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗נִי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My soul melts away for heaviness: strengthen me according to Thy word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My soul drips [i.e., expires] from sorrow. Keep me in life, according to Your word.


###### Psalms 119:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:29)


דֶּֽרֶךְ־שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ חׇנֵּֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Remove from me the way of falsehood: and graciously bestow Thy Tora upon me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Remove from me the path of falsehood, and grace me with Your Torah.


###### Psalms 119:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:30)


דֶּֽרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have chosen the way of truth: Thy judgments have I laid before me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have chosen the way of faith. I have embraced Your judgments.


###### Psalms 119:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:31)


דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְעֵדְוֺתֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה אַל־תְּבִישֵֽׁנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have held fast to Thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have clung to Your testimonies, O L rd, do not shame me.


###### Psalms 119:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:32)


דֶּֽרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶ֥יךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽי׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will run the way of Thy commandments, for therein Thou dost enlarge my heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall run upon the path of Your mitzvoth, for [I know that] You will [therefor] expand my heart [in the pleasures of the World to Come].


###### Psalms 119:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:33)


הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Teach me, O Lord, the way of Thy statutes; and I shall keep it to the end.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Teach me, O L rd, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep to it consistently.


###### Psalms 119:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:34)


הֲ֭בִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָ֥ה תוֹרָתֶ֗ךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶ֥נָּה בְכׇל־לֵֽב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Give me understanding, and I shall keep Thy Tora; and I shall observe it with my whole heart.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Make me understand, and I will heed Your Torah, and I will keep it with all [my] heart.


###### Psalms 119:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:35)


הַ֭דְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑יךָ כִּי־ב֥וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Make me to go in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Lead me in the path of Your mitzvoth; for this is what I have desired.


###### Psalms 119:36

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

I have called You. Help me, so that I may keep Your testimonies.


###### Psalms 119:147

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:147](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/119:147)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I rise before dawn, and I cry out: my hope is in Thy word.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have risen before [all] in the night and have cried out. I have hoped for [the fulfillment of] Your word.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My eyes open before the night watches, that I may meditate on Thy saying.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My eyes have preceded [i.e., opened] [two] night watches [in advance of the day] to engage in Your word [Torah].

Hear my voice according to Thy steadfast love: O Lord, revive me according to Thy judgment.

Hear my voice in Your lovingkindness. O L rd, as is Your way [(to bestow lovingkindness)], sustain me.

Thou art near, O Lord; and all Thy commandments are truth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You are near, O L rd [(to those, who go far from Your Torah, if they repent of their ways)].


###### Psalms 119:152

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Concerning Thy testimonies, I have known of old that Thou hast founded them forever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Before [(the thing happened)] I knew [it] from Your testimonies. [(Before Israel inherited the land You commanded them in respect to bikkurim, terumoth, and ma'aseroth. **The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Great are Thy compassions, O Lord: give me life as is Thy wont.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

I behold transgressors, and I am grieved; because they keep not Thy saying,

[Therefore], all the judgments of Your righteousness are eternal.

Let my cry come before Thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to Thy word.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let my supplication come before You. Save me according to Your word [to Nathan the Prophet].

My tongue shall sing of Thy word: for all Thy commandments are just.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let Thy hand help me; for I have chosen Thy precepts.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I long for Thy salvation, O Lord; and Thy law is my delight.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 119:175

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; and let Thy judgment help me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Psalms 119:176

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out Thy servant; for I do not forget Thy commandments.

## Chapter 120

###### Psalms 120:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:1)


שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה בַּצָּרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Ma῾alot Poem. In my distress I cried to the Lord, and he heard me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A song of ascents to the L rd [(recited by the Levites on the fifteen steps descending from the Israelite's court to the women's court [(so that there are fifteen "songs of ascents")]. When I was in distress, I called and He answered me.


###### Psalms 120:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:2)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁ֑קֶר מִלָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, rescue my soul from lying lips [(from those who hunt men with wicked libels)], from deceitful tongue.


###### Psalms 120:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:3)


מַה־יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
What shall be given to thee? or what shall be done to thee, thou false tongue?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
What [additional safeguard (aside from the teeth and the lips)] will He assign to you, and what will He add unto you, O deceitful tongue?


###### Psalms 120:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:4)


חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of the broom tree.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[You are like] the sharpened arrows of a warrior [(killing from afar)], with coals of the broom [(which, though extinguished on the outside, still burn on the inside)].


###### Psalms 120:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/120:5)


אֽוֹיָה־לִ֭י כִּי־גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם־אׇהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshekh, that I dwell in the tents of Qedar!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[(A psalm of David through the Holy Spirit relating to what is destined to transpire with Solomon his son — that on the day he built the Temple he would marry Pharaoh's daughter, viz. Jeremiah 32:31)]

I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, and in his word I hope.

## Chapter 131

שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהֹוָ֤ה**׀** לֹא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּי וְלֹא־רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹֽא־הִלַּ֓כְתִּי**׀** בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Ma῾alot Poem of David. Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: nor do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A song of ascents, of David. O L rd, my heart has not been haughty, and my eyes have not been uplifted, nor have I gone about with grandeurs and glories unbefitting me [(unlike my son Solomon, who disported himself thus)].

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let Yisra᾽el hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Hope, O Israel, to the L rd, from now and forevermore.

## Chapter 135

## Chapter 137

###### Psalms 137:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:1)


עַ֥ל־נַהֲר֨וֹת**׀** בָּבֶ֗ל שָׁ֣ם יָ֭שַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִ֑ינוּ בְּ֝זׇכְרֵ֗נוּ אֶת־צִיּֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
By the rivers of Bavel, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Żiyyon.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
By the rivers of Bavel [(when we went down into exile)], there we sat; we also wept, when we remembered Zion.


###### Psalms 137:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:2)


עַֽל־עֲרָבִ֥ים בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ תָּ֝לִ֗ינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
We hung our lyres upon the willows in its midst.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
On the willows in its midst, we hung our lyres.


###### Psalms 137:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:3)


כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם שְֽׁאֵל֪וּנוּ שׁוֹבֵ֡ינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁ֭יר וְתוֹלָלֵ֣ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֑ה שִׁ֥ירוּ לָ֝֗נוּ מִשִּׁ֥יר צִיּֽוֹן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For there they who carried us away captive asked us for a song; and they who spoiled us asked us for mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Żiyyon.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For there our captors [(Nevuchadnezzar, etc.)] asked song of us [(as they used to sing upon the platform in the Temple)], and our mockers, joy — Sing to us of the song of Zion.


###### Psalms 137:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:4)


אֵ֗יךְ נָשִׁ֥יר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֝֗ל אַדְמַ֥ת נֵכָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a foreign land?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
How can I sing the song of the L rd on a strange land?


###### Psalms 137:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:5)


אִֽם־אֶשְׁכָּחֵ֥ךְ יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח יְמִינִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I forget thee, O Yerushalayim, let my right hand forget her cunning.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I [(Israel)] forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand be forgotten.


###### Psalms 137:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:6)


תִּדְבַּֽק־לְשׁוֹנִ֨י**׀** לְחִכִּי֮ אִם־לֹ֢א אֶ֫זְכְּרֵ֥כִי אִם־לֹ֣א אַ֭עֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֑͏ִם עַ֝֗ל רֹ֣אשׁ שִׂמְחָתִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I do not set Yerushalayim above my highest joy.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let my tongue stick to my palate if I do not remember you, if I do not raise up [remembrance of the destruction of] Jerusalem over the head of [all] my joy.


###### Psalms 137:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:7)


זְכֹ֤ר יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** לִבְנֵ֬י אֱד֗וֹם אֵת֮ י֤וֹם יְֽר֫וּשָׁלָ֥͏ִם הָ֭אֹ֣מְרִים עָ֤רוּ**׀** עָ֑רוּ עַ֝֗ד הַיְס֥וֹד בָּֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Remember, O Lord, against the children of Edom the day of Yerushalayim, when they said, Rase it, rase it, to its very foundations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Remember, O L rd, against the children of Edom, the day of [the destruction of] Jerusalem when they said: Raze it! Raze it! Until its foundation!


###### Psalms 137:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:8)


בַּת־בָּבֶ֗ל הַשְּׁד֫וּדָ֥ה אַשְׁרֵ֥י שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָ֑ךְ אֶת־גְּ֝מוּלֵ֗ךְ שֶׁגָּמַ֥לְתְּ לָֽנוּ׃
