O daughter of Bavel, marked for devastation; happy is he who shall repay thee thy recompense for what thou hast done to us.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O daughter of Bavel, you [who are destined to be] despoiled, happy the one who will pay you your recompense that you paid unto us!


###### Psalms 137:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/137:9)


אַשְׁרֵ֤י**׀** שֶׁיֹּאחֵ֓ז וְנִפֵּ֬ץ אֶֽת־עֹלָלַ֗יִךְ אֶל־הַסָּֽלַע׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy is he who shall seize and dash thy little ones against the rock.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Happy the one who will seize and shatter your young ones on the rock!



## Chapter 138

###### Psalms 138:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:1)


לְדָוִ֨ד**׀** אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכׇל־לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of David. I will praise Thee with my whole heart: before princes I will sing praise to Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[A psalm] of David. I shall praise You with all my heart. Before the princes I will sing of You.


###### Psalms 138:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:2)


אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קׇדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כׇּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will bow down towards Thy holy temple, and praise Thy name for Thy steadfast love, and for Thy truth: for Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I shall bow down to the sanctuary of Your holiness and praise Your name for Your lovingkindness and Your truth. For You have exalted above all of Your names [— "Mighty," "Jealous," "Vengeful" —] Your word [that those who sin against Your majesty will be accepted with repentance].


###### Psalms 138:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:3)


בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
In the day when I cried Thou didst answer me, and didst strengthen me with strength in my soul.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
On the day that I called You answered me. You made me great [by implanting] strength in my soul.


###### Psalms 138:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:4)


יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O Lord, when they hear the words of Thy mouth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They praised you, O L rd, all the kings of the earth, when they heard the words of Your mouth. [(When they heard "You shall not kill," "You shall not commit adultery," they praised You for "I am the L rd your G d," "You shall have no other G d" [viz. 119:160])]


###### Psalms 138:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:5)


וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּֽי־גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they will sing of the ways of the L rd, for great is the glory of the L rd.


###### Psalms 138:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:6)


כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Though the Lord be high, yet he takes note of the lowly: but the haughty he knows from afar.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Though the L rd is exalted, He sees the lowly one, and [though] upraised He chastises [sinners] from afar.


###### Psalms 138:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:7)


אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ**׀** בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou wilt revive me: Thou shalt stretch out Thy hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Thy right hand shall save me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I walk in the midst of affliction, You will rescue me. Because of the wrath of my foes, You will stretch out Your hand [against them] and Your right hand will save me.


###### Psalms 138:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/138:8)


יְהֹוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֢ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הֹוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
May the Lord accomplish his purpose concerning me: Thy steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever: do not forsake the works of Thy own hands.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd will complete [(as He has begun) His lovingkindness] for me. O L rd, Your lovingkindness is forever. Do not leave off the work of Your hands [in the Temple (viz. Exodus 15:16)].



## Chapter 139

###### Psalms 139:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:1)


לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהֹוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O Lord, Thou hast searched me, and known me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor. [a psalm of] David. O L rd, You probed [my thoughts] and You know [them].


###### Psalms 139:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:2)


אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou knowst my sitting down and my rising up, Thou understandest my thought afar off.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You know [the thoughts of] my sitting down and arising.


###### Psalms 139:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:3)


אׇרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽכׇל־דְּרָכַ֥י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast measured my going and my lying down, and Thou art acquainted with all my ways.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You understand from afar [how] to endear [Yourself] to me. You compassed my going and my reclinings [i.e., I can do nothing without Your knowing of it], and You are familiar with all of my ways.


###### Psalms 139:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:4)


כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For no word is yet on my tongue, and lo, O Lord, Thou knowst it all.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
When the word is not yet on my tongue, O L rd, You know all [I am going to say].


###### Psalms 139:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:5)


אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑נִי וַתָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣י כַּפֶּֽכָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid Thy hand upon me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You laid siege to me from the rear and from the front, and You set Your rule over me.


###### Psalms 139:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:6)


(פלאיה) [פְּלִ֣יאָֽה] דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Knowledge [of escape from You] is concealed from me. It is too formidable. I cannot know it.


###### Psalms 139:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:7)


אָ֭נָֽה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Where shall I go from Thy spirit? or where shall I flee from Thy presence?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Where shall I go [to conceal myself] from Your wrath, and where can I run from Your presence?


###### Psalms 139:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:8)


אִם־אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I ascend up into heaven, Thou art there: if I make my bed in She᾽ol, behold, Thou art there.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I ascend to the heavens, You are there, and if I bed myself down in Sheol — here You are!


###### Psalms 139:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:9)


אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I lifted my wings as the morning star and made the far bounds of the sea my abode,


###### Psalms 139:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:10)


גַּם־שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
even there shall Thy hand lead me, and Thy right hand shall hold me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
there, too, Your hand would direct me, and Your right hand hold on to me.


###### Psalms 139:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:11)


וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I say, Surely only darkness shall cover me; and the light be night about me,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And if I said: "But darkness will obscure me, and night will darken [things] for me,"


###### Psalms 139:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:12)


גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹא־יַחְשִׁ֢יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
even the darkness is not dark for Thee, but the night shines like the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
darkness, too, will darken nothing from You, and night will shine [for You] as day. Darkness and light are as one [to You].


###### Psalms 139:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:13)


כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For Thou hast formed my reins: Thou hast knit me together in my mother’s womb.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For You have acquired my reins [(the center of all my thoughts)]. You covered me [with flesh and skin] in my mother's stomach.


###### Psalms 139:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:14)


אוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will praise Thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are Thy works; and my soul knows that right well.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I will praise You because I was fashioned awesomely and wondrously. Your deeds are wondrous and my soul knows [it] well.


###### Psalms 139:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:15)


לֹֽא־נִכְחַ֥ד עׇצְמִ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
My frame was not hidden from Thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
My essence was not hidden from You, though I was fashioned in hiddenness [(the hiddenness of cohabitation)] and tissued in the depths of the earth [i.e., the nethermost part of my mother's womb].


###### Psalms 139:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:16)


גׇּלְמִ֤י**׀** רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־סִפְרְךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֢ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ (ולא) [וְל֖וֹ] אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy eyes did see my unshaped flesh; for in Thy book all things are written: the days also in which they are to be fashioned, and for it too there was one of them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[The unfolding of] my form Your eyes [fore-] saw, and in Your book [(the book of the generations of man that You showed to Adam [viz. Genesis 5:1])], they [(the deeds of all men)] were [all] inscribed, [as if] the days had [already] been created, though none of them [had yet appeared in actuality].


###### Psalms 139:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:17)


וְלִ֗י מַה־יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
How precious also are Thy thoughts to me, O God! how great is the sum of them!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And to me [(the congregation of Israel)], how precious are Your dear ones [(the righteous)], O G d. How great are their numbers [(the numbers of their righteous deeds)].


###### Psalms 139:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:18)


אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I awake, I am still with Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
If I came to count them, [I would find them] more numerous than the sands of the sea. I have [now] come to the end [of the generations that You have allotted from the beginning], and it [(the present generation)] is still with You [and in fear of You].


###### Psalms 139:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:19)


אִם־תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ׀רָשָׁ֑ע וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Surely Thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, you bloody men,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Would that You slew the wicked, O G d! — "Men of blood, get away from me!"


###### Psalms 139:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:20)


אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭מְרוּךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה נָשׂ֖וּא לַשָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who speak against Thee wickedly, and Thy enemies, who take Thy name in vain.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They mention You [i.e., Your name] with wicked intent (attributing Your G dliness to idolatry)]. Your foes have taken [Your name] in vain.


###### Psalms 139:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:21)


הֲלֽוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה׀אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Do I not hate, O Lord, those who hate Thee? and do I not strive with those who rise up against Thee?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Will I not hate Your haters, O L rd? Will I not battle with those who rise up against You?


###### Psalms 139:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:22)


תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I hate them with the utmost hatred: I count them my enemies.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I have hated them to the heights of hatred. I have deemed them my [own] enemies.


###### Psalms 139:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:23)


חׇקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Probe me, O L rd, and know my heart. Examine me and know my thoughts.


###### Psalms 139:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/139:24)


וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־דֶּֽרֶךְ־עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and see if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And see if a way of vexation [(of the L rd)] is within me. [If it is,] then lead me in the way of the world [(to death)].



## Chapter 140

###### Psalms 140:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:1)


לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For the conductor, a psalm of David.


###### Psalms 140:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:2)


חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הֹוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Rescue me, O L rd, from an evil man. Guard me from a man of violence,


###### Psalms 140:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:3)


אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב כׇּל־י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
who devise mischiefs in their heart; continually they stir up wars.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[from those] who plot evil in [their] heart. Let there be wars in their dwellings every day.


###### Psalms 140:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:4)


שָׁ֥נְנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; a spider’s venom is under their lips. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
They sharpen their tongues as a snake. A spider's venom is under their lips always.


###### Psalms 140:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:5)


שׇׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man: who have purposed to trip up my feet.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Protect me, O L rd, from the hands of the evil-doer. Guard me from a man of violence, [from those] who plot to cause my feet to stumble.


###### Psalms 140:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:6)


טָ֥מְנֽוּ־גֵאִ֨ים**׀** פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָׁתוּ־לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set traps for me. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The proud have hid a trap against me; and [with] ropes [(to spring the trap)] they have spread a net beside my path. They have always set snares against me.


###### Psalms 140:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:7)


אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהֹוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I said to the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I said to the L rd: You [have always been] my strength. Listen, O L rd, to the voice of my entreaties.


###### Psalms 140:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:8)


יֱהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast screened my head in the day of battle;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, my L rd, the strength of my salvation, You have always shielded my head in the day of weapons.


###### Psalms 140:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:9)


אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הֹוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked man: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. (Sela.)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Do not grant, O L rd, the desires of the wicked one [(Esav)]. Do not prosper his designs, [for] they always mount.


###### Psalms 140:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:10)


רֹ֥אשׁ מְסִבָּ֑י עֲמַ֖ל שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ (יכסומו) [יְכַסֵּֽימוֹ]׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
As for the head of those who compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The ranks of those [(of Esav)] who would turn me [from You] — may the deceit of their lips envelop them!


###### Psalms 140:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:11)


(ימיטו) [יִמּ֥וֹטוּ] עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּל־יָקֽוּמוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, so that they do not rise up again.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let burning coals collapse upon them [(killing them)]. Let Him cast them into [the] fire [of Gehinnom] and into wars from which they cannot rise.


###### Psalms 140:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/140:12)


אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־יִכּ֢וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Let not a slanderer be established in the earth: let evil hunt the violent man to his overthrow.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Let the slanderer [(Esav)] not be established in the earth. Let the evil of the man of violence hunt him into thrustings [(from one calamity to another)].

Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Thy name: the upright shall dwell in Thy presence.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

A Psalm of David. Lord, I cry to Thee: make haste to me; give ear to my voice, when I cry to Thee.

Set, O L rd, a guard on my mouth [(that my prayers be acceptable to You)]. Guard the door of my lips [i.e., the upper lip].

Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked deeds with men who work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

Let a righteous [prophet] smite me [i.e., chastise me] with ["blows" that are really] lovingkindness, and let him reprove me. As when one cuts and breaks up wood on the earth, so are our bones strewn at the mouth of She᾽ol.

As split [wood] scattered over the earth, so our bones [(those of David and his men)] were scattered over the mouth of Sheol [(because of the evils of these men)].

שׇׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and the traps of the workers of iniquity.

Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, whilst I escape.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And do not enter into judgment with Your servant, for no living being will be found righteous before You.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:9)


הַצִּילֵ֖נִי מֵאֹיְבַ֥י׀יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵלֶ֥יךָ כִסִּֽתִי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Deliver me, O Lord, from my enemies: I flee to Thee to hide me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Rescue me from my foes, O L rd. With You [alone] have I concealed [my tribulations, revealing them to no men].


###### Psalms 143:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:10)


לַמְּדֵ֤נִי**׀** לַ֥עֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֢ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י רוּחֲךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Teach me to do Thy will; for Thou art my God: let Thy good spirit lead me into a level land.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Instruct me to do Your will, for You are my G d. Your goodly will shall lead me on level land.


###### Psalms 143:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:11)


לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓**׀** תּוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Revive me, O Lord, for Thy name’s sake: for Thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
For Your name's sake, O L rd, sustain me. In Your righteousness, free my soul from affliction.


###### Psalms 143:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/143:12)


וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֢ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כׇּל־צֹרְרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And in Thy mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul: for I am Thy servant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And in Your lovingkindness, cut off my foes and destroy all the oppressors of my spirit, for I am Your servant.



## Chapter 144

###### Psalms 144:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:1)


לְדָוִ֨ד**׀** בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה**׀** צוּרִ֗י הַֽמְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣י לַקְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗י לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Of David. Blessed be the Lord my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A psalm of David. Blessed is the L rd, my Rock, who teaches my hands for battle, my fingers for war.


###### Psalms 144:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:2)


חַסְדִּ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִי֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֢י וּֽמְפַלְטִ֫י־לִ֥י מָ֭גִנִּי וּב֣וֹ חָסִ֑יתִי הָרוֹדֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣י תַחְתָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
my gracious one, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdues my people under me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Who does lovingkindness with me, who is my fortress, my stronghold, my rescuer, my shield. And I take refuge in Him, who spreads out peoples beneath Him.


###### Psalms 144:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:3)


יְֽהֹוָ֗ה מָֽה־אָ֭דָם וַתֵּדָעֵ֑הוּ בֶּן־אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ וַֽתְּחַשְּׁבֵֽהוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Lord, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him!


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, what is man [(Paras and Yishmael)] to You that You have known him [to aggrandize him]; the son of man, that You dignify him?


###### Psalms 144:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:4)


אָ֭דָם לַהֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗יו כְּצֵ֣ל עוֹבֵֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Man is like a breath: his days are like a shadow that passes away.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Man is likened to breath. His days are as a passing shadow [(the shadow of a bird in flight)].


###### Psalms 144:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:5)


יְ֭הֹוָה הַט־שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Bow Thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, that they may smoke.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O L rd, lower Your heavens and descend. Strike the mountains [(the gentile kings)] and let them smoke!


###### Psalms 144:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:6)


בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out Thy arrows, and destroy them.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Flash lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows [(thunderbolts)] and confound them.


###### Psalms 144:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:7)


שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗יךָ מִ֫מָּר֥וֹם פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Send Thy hand from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, from the hand of strangers;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Send Your hands from the heights. Free me and rescue me from the multitude of waters, from the hand of strangers.


###### Psalms 144:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:8)


אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Whose mouths speak vanity and whose right hand is the right hand of falsehood [i.e., raised to swear falsely].


###### Psalms 144:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:9)


אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ אָשִׁ֣ירָה לָּ֑ךְ בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּֽךְ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will sing a new song to Thee, O God: upon a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
O G d, I will sing You a new song. With lyre and ten-stringed harp I will sing to You.


###### Psalms 144:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:10)


הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן תְּשׁוּעָ֗ה לַמְּלָ֫כִ֥ים הַ֭פּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדּ֗וֹ מֵחֶ֥רֶב רָעָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
It is he who gives salvation to kings: who delivers David his servant from the hurtful sword.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Who gives salvation to kings [(Saul being saved from killing David, and David, from being killed, viz. I Samuel 23:27)], who frees His servant David from the evil sword.


###### Psalms 144:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:11)


פְּצֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי֮ מִיַּ֢ד בְּֽנֵי־נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭יהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁ֑וְא וִ֝ימִינָ֗ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of strangers, whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(As You did then, so)] free me and rescue me from the hand of strangers, whose mouths speak vanity, and whose right hand is the right hand of falsehood.


###### Psalms 144:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:12)


אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨ינוּ**׀** כִּנְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֢ים בִּֽנְעוּרֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּנוֹתֵ֥ינוּ כְזָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּב֗וֹת תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For our sons are as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner stones, polished after the fashion of a palace:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(For now, too, our generation is worthy of Your providence.)] For our sons are like young plants [unblemished (with sin)], grown up [with the same good name that was theirs] in their youth. Our daughters [are tall and stately], like the perfectly aligned corners of the edifice [-stones] of the sanctuary.


###### Psalms 144:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:13)


מְזָוֵ֣ינוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִזַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל־זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּב֗וֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
our garners are full, affording all manner of store: our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The corners [of our store-houses] are full [of grain], supplying [(ample bread)] from one harvest to the next. Our sheep increase in the thousands and ten thousands in our demesne.


###### Psalms 144:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:14)


אַלּוּפֵ֗ינוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין־פֶּ֭רֶץ וְאֵ֣ין יוֹצֵ֑את וְאֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
our oxen are heavy laden: there is no breach or migration: and there is no loud cry in our streets.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Our leaders are borne [i.e., respected (by their charges), so that] there is no breach [in us] and no [evil report] spread abroad and no outcry [(of the tumult of war)] in our thoroughfares.


###### Psalms 144:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/144:15)


אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֱׁיְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Happy is that people, that is in such a case: happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Fortunate is the people who have it so. Fortunate is the people whose G d is the L rd.



## Chapter 145

###### Psalms 145:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:1)


תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרְכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
A Praise of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O king; and I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
A Tehillah [(praise)], of David. I shall exalt You, O G d, the King, and I will bless Your name forever.


###### Psalms 145:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:2)


בְּכׇל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Every day I will bless Thee; and I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever.


###### Psalms 145:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:3)


גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Great is the L rd and greatly praised; there is no searching out His greatness.


###### Psalms 145:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:4)


דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
One generation shall praise Thy works to another, and shall declare Thy mighty acts.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
One generation to another shall praise Your deeds and recount Your [acts of] strength.


###### Psalms 145:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:5)


הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
I will speak of the glorious splendour of Thy majesty, and of Thy wondrous works.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[(And I, likewise,)] the beauty of the glory of Your majesty and the words of Your wonders shall I relate.


###### Psalms 145:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:6)


וֶעֱז֣וּז נֽוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ (וגדלותיך) [וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ֥] אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And men shall speak of the might of Thy terrible acts: and I will declare Thy greatness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they [(one generation to another)] shall declare the strength of Your awesome deeds, and I [likewise,] shall tell of Your greatness.


###### Psalms 145:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:7)


זֵ֣כֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, and shall sing of Thy righteousness.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The remembrance of the abundance of Your good shall they express, and Your righteousness shall they sing.


###### Psalms 145:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:8)


חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדׇל־חָֽסֶד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of abundant love.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Gracious and merciful is the L rd, withholding wrath and great in lovingkindness.


###### Psalms 145:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:9)


טוֹב־יְהֹוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כׇּל־מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The L rd is good to all, and His mercies are upon all of His creations.


###### Psalms 145:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:10)


יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרְכֽוּכָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
All Thy works shall praise Thee, O Lord; and Thy pious ones shall bless Thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All of Your acts, O L rd, shall praise You, and Your lovingkindnesses shall bless You.


###### Psalms 145:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:11)


כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, and talk of Thy power;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the glory of Your kingdom shall they [(one generation to another)] proclaim, and Your strength shall they declare,


###### Psalms 145:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:12)


לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ**׀** לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
[saying: It is good for us] to make known to the sons of man His strength and the glory of the splendor of His kingdom.


###### Psalms 145:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Psalms/r/145:13)


מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כׇּל־עֹלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשַׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכׇל־דּ֥וֹר וָדֹֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Thy dominion endures throughout all generations.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
